Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1947, LG Corp. is a global conglomerate that operates across a wide array of sectors, including electronics, chemicals, communications, and various service industries, through its numerous subsidiaries. In the electronics domain, LG offers an extensive product range encompassing home appliances, air conditioning systems, entertainment devices, mobile communication products, and automotive components, alongside a diverse portfolio of business-to-business solutions. The company is also a leading manufacturer of display technologies for televisions, mobile devices, IT applications, automobiles, and commercial use, while additionally supplying crucial electronic components such as camera modules, photomasks, tape substrates, and semiconductors. Its chemical division is responsible for developing and producing batteries, advanced materials, life sciences products, and petrochemicals. This segment further extends to consumer goods like personal care items and beverages, as well as specialized industrial materials for construction, automotive parts, and high-performance applications, including methyl methacrylate. Beyond physical products, LG provides a comprehensive suite of communication and service solutions. These include telecommunications, advertising, and marketing services, complemented by end-to-end IT solutions ranging from custom system development and strategic consulting to outsourcing. The company also engages in space solutions, economic analysis, corporate management consulting, professional sports management, and supply chain optimization. Additionally, LG operates in media and connectivity, offering cable TV and internet services, mobile virtual network operations, and local television channels, while also managing the import and export of textiles and household goods.

Korean Reinsurance Company, founded in 1963 and based in Seoul, South Korea, delivers comprehensive life and non-life reinsurance services to clients in Korea and across international markets. Its extensive non-life product suite includes property coverage for risks such as fire, property all risks, inland floater, and museum items. The engineering division handles a broad spectrum of policies, including contractor's and erection all risks, machinery, electric equipment, civil engineering completed risk, contractor's plant and machinery, and comprehensive machinery. Marine reinsurance encompasses hull, cargo, and aviation. Additionally, casualty offerings feature general and professional liability, workers compensation, personal accident, guarantee, and various other specialty insurance options. The company also provides life reinsurance solutions, safeguarding against death and health, among other related products. Further specialization includes agriculture, nuclear, and motor reinsurance lines.

Nongshim Co., Ltd. operates as a prominent food manufacturer and distributor across a wide international footprint, including South Korea, China, the United States, Japan, Canada, Australia, and Vietnam. The firm's comprehensive product line features a diverse array of instant noodles, such as the popular Shin Ramyun, Shin Ramyun Black, Yukejang Bowl Noodle Soup, Udon Noodle Soup, Chapaghetti, Neoguri, Kimchi Ramyun, Shin Cup Noodle Soup, Kimchi Big Bowl, Doongji Cold Noodles, Gomtang Ramyun, Potato Noodle Soup, Uma Cup, Shin Ramyun Red Cup, Zha Wang, and Hot & Spicy Bowl Noodle. Beyond noodles, Nongshim also produces various snacks, including Shrimp Crackers, Onion Rings, and Pawn Snack, alongside beverages like natural water (e.g., Baeksan Artesian Water), juices, and sodas. Furthermore, the company acts as an importer and distributor for established international brands such as Kellogg's cereals, Chupa Chups candies, Tulip products, House Curry, and Vono Soup. Founded in 1965, the enterprise was originally named Lotte Industrial Company before adopting its current identity, Nongshim Co., Ltd., in March 1978. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Seoul, South Korea.

Binggrae Co., Ltd. is a South Korean enterprise dedicated to the production and distribution of a broad spectrum of chilled and frozen food items. Its extensive product range encompasses ice cream, various dairy drinks and cheeses, fermented milk products, an assortment of coffees and other beverages, and a selection of snacks and desserts, all sold under numerous brand names. Beyond its domestic operations, the company also engages in exporting its goods. Additionally, Binggrae operates its own retail establishments, known as Soft Lab and Yellow Café. Founded in 1967, the company was initially named Daeil Co., Ltd. before officially changing to Binggrae Co., Ltd. in February 1982. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Namyangju, South Korea.

Guoco Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, overseeing a range of operations that include principal investments, property development and ownership, hospitality and leisure, and financial services. Its Principal Investment division manages a portfolio comprising debt, equity, and direct investments, as well as treasury operations involving both trading and strategic placements in global capital markets. Through its Property Development and Investment arm, the group constructs residential and commercial properties and maintains an extensive portfolio of income-generating real estate across key Asian markets such as Singapore, China, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Hong Kong. The Hospitality and Leisure division is engaged in the ownership, leasing, and management of hotels, alongside operating gaming and leisure businesses in the United Kingdom, Spain, and Belgium. This segment's hotel portfolio features proprietary brands like Amba, Guoman, Thistle, and Thistle Express, and it also manages the Hard Rock Hotel London under a third-party license. Within the gaming sector, Guoco Group operates Mecca, a prominent bingo provider in Great Britain with 82 physical venues and a digital platform (www.meccabingo.com) offering a variety of games from bingo to slot machines. It also runs Grosvenor Casinos, which includes 52 casinos across Great Britain and one unbranded casino in Belgium, complemented by its online presence at www.grosvenorcasinos.com. Additionally, Enracha delivers a diverse selection of popular games and sports betting through 9 venues in Spain and its digital channels: www.enracha.es, www.yobingo.es, and www.yocasino.es. The Financial Services segment provides a comprehensive array of services, including commercial, consumer, Islamic, and investment banking. It further offers life and general insurance, Takaful insurance, fund and unit trust management, corporate advisory, and stockbroking services. Beyond these primary activities, the company maintains royalty entitlements from Bass Strait's oil and gas production and is involved in the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of health products. Guoco Group Limited is based in Central, Hong Kong, and is a subsidiary of GuoLine Overseas Limited.

Operating throughout South Korea, DB Insurance Co., Ltd. furnishes a wide array of insurance policies and related services. Its product portfolio includes general, automobile, and long-term insurance options, notably under its Promy car and Promy life brand names. Originally known as Dongbu Insurance Co., Ltd., the company officially adopted its present name, DB Insurance Co., Ltd., in November 2017. This enterprise, founded in 1962 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, operates as a component of the larger DB Group.

Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a global technology leader operating across consumer electronics, information technology and mobile communications, and advanced device solutions sectors. Its extensive product portfolio includes a wide array of home appliances, such as refrigeration units, garment care systems, washing machines, dryers, cooking equipment, dishwashers, vacuum cleaners, and climate control devices like air conditioners and purifiers. The company also delivers cutting-edge personal electronics such as televisions, audio systems, smartphones, tablets, display monitors, smart and LED digital signage, smartwatches, and various accessories, alongside advanced memory storage solutions. Beyond this, Samsung extends its reach into medical technology, software engineering and delivery, and provides semiconductor and display panel manufacturing services. Its comprehensive suite of business services encompasses general logistics, financial offerings, marketing and consulting, technology and cloud support, venture capital investments, enterprise automation platforms, connected solutions, network infrastructure deployment and optimization, and digital advertising services. The firm caters to a diverse range of industries, including retail, hospitality, financial services, transportation, education, government, manufacturing, public safety, and healthcare. Established in 1938, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Suwon-si, South Korea.

Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a global technology leader operating across three main divisions: consumer electronics, information technology and mobile communications, and advanced device solutions. The company offers a vast product portfolio, ranging from essential home appliances like refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners, to personal and entertainment devices such as televisions, sound systems, smartphones, tablets, monitors, and smartwatches. It also supplies critical components, including memory storage solutions and display panels. Beyond its hardware offerings, Samsung provides a comprehensive array of services. These encompass medical equipment, software design and development, logistics management, financial services, marketing, consulting, and cutting-edge technology and cloud solutions. The company also engages in venture capital investments, delivers enterprise automation and connected services, handles network device installation and optimization, and manages digital advertising platforms. These diverse offerings serve a broad spectrum of industries globally, including retail, hospitality, finance, transportation, education, government, manufacturing, public safety, and healthcare. Established in 1938, Samsung Electronics maintains its headquarters in Suwon-si, South Korea.

Sun Hung Kai & Co. Limited, an investment holding enterprise, offers a diverse array of financial services across Hong Kong and mainland China. The company structures its operations into several key divisions: Consumer Finance, Private Credit, Mortgage Loans, Investment Management, and Group Management and Support. It provides unsecured lending solutions to individuals and businesses, accessible through both its physical branches and online platforms. Additionally, the firm delivers bespoke funding solutions to corporate clients, investment funds, and high-net-worth individuals. Property owners can obtain both first and second mortgage loans, while real estate investors are offered customized financing options. Beyond its lending activities, the company is actively involved in investments across public markets, alternative assets, and real estate. Its comprehensive suite of services further encompasses secretarial assistance, financial advisory, nominee services, loan guarantees, direct money lending, asset and fund management, property investment, and securities trading. Established in 1969, Sun Hung Kai & Co. Limited is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of AP Emerald Limited.

Samsung Electro-Mechanics Co., Ltd. is a global producer and vendor of a diverse range of electronic components, with operations spanning South Korea, China, Southeast Asia, Japan, the United States, and Europe. The company's business activities are organized into three main segments: Component, Optics & Communication Solution, and Package Solution. Its product offerings encompass multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), power inductors, tantalum capacitors, and chip resistors, as well as camera modules, network modules, package substrates, and semiconductor packaging boards. In addition to its core electronics business, the firm also participates in the real estate market, including property and related software solutions. These components find application in numerous electronic products, such as those for the automotive sector, computers, displays, hard disk drives, mobile phones, networking infrastructure, servers, solid-state drives, tablets, and wearable technology. Founded in 1973, the company was initially named Samsung Electronic Parts Co., Ltd. before officially changing to Samsung Electro-Mechanics Co., Ltd. in February 1987. Its main offices are located in Suwon, South Korea.

Lotte Chemical Corporation, a leading chemical enterprise based in Seoul, South Korea, specializes in the global manufacturing and distribution of a diverse portfolio of polymers, monomers, fundamental petrochemicals, and products designed for emerging market trends. Established in 1976, the company's operations are structured across Monomer, Polymer, Basic Petrochemicals, and an 'Others' division. Its extensive polymer offerings include various grades of polyethylene (such as high-density, low-density, and linear low-density), ethylene-vinyl acetate, and polypropylenes suitable for applications like transparent-impact resistance, injection/blow molding, yarns/fibers, and films. The polymer range further extends to thermoplastic elastomers, adhesive resins, thermoplastic olefins, long fiber reinforced thermoplastics, expanded polypropylenes, polycarbonates, polycarbonate resins, acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) resins, and polyethylene terephthalates. Within its monomer segment, Lotte Chemical supplies ethylene glycols, ethylene oxides, methoxy polyethylene glycols, polyethylene glycols, VPEG (a crucial component for advanced admixtures), glycol ethers, methyl methacrylates, purified isophthalic acids, and purified terephthalic acids. The basic petrochemical division provides benzene, toluene, various xylene isomers (mixed, meta-, para-, and ortho-xylene), as well as isoprene, dicyclopentadiene, piperylene, and styrene monomers. The company also innovates with products like water treatment membranes. Beyond its core chemical activities, Lotte Chemical offers ancillary services including property leasing and labor dispatch. The firm maintains a significant international presence, operating in the Republic of Korea, Malaysia, the United States, Pakistan, China, and other global regions. The company, which was originally founded as Honam Petrochemical Corporation, officially rebranded to Lotte Chemical Corporation in December 2012.

Hyundai Mobis operates as a prominent international supplier of advanced components and systems for the automotive industry. The company's product portfolio is extensive, featuring sophisticated driver-assistance technologies (ADAS) such as lane-keeping assistance, intelligent cruise control, autonomous emergency braking, highway driving aids, and automated parking systems. It also manufactures a variety of lighting solutions, including headlamps, taillamps, smaller illumination units, and their associated electronic controls. Hyundai Mobis plays a significant role in vehicle electrification, producing items like power converters, electric propulsion systems, energy management systems, 48-volt mild-hybrid setups, and components for fuel cell electric vehicles. Safety is another key area, with offerings including airbag modules and their electronic control units. Furthermore, its range extends to advanced cabin technologies, encompassing infotainment systems, central display units, digital instrument clusters, various head-up displays (windshield, combiner, and augmented reality versions), and premium audio systems. Critical chassis components are also supplied, such as the integrated i-MEB master cylinder, the MEB (combining anti-lock braking with an electronic braking system), switch-operated electronic parking brakes (EPB), electronic power steering (EPS), and suspension systems. Beyond original equipment manufacturing, the company provides a comprehensive selection of aftermarket service parts, vehicle accessories, and integrated automotive system solutions. Established in 1977, the firm was initially known as Hyundai Precision Industry Co., Ltd until it officially changed its name to Hyundai Mobis Co.,Ltd in November 2000. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Seoul, South Korea.

Hanwha Aerospace Co., Ltd. is globally active in the design, production, and upkeep of engines for a broad spectrum of platforms, encompassing commercial and military aircraft, helicopters, and marine vessels. The company supplies critical components to original engine manufacturers (OEMs), including various fan parts such as inlet cases, outer guided vanes, and blades; compressor assemblies like blisks, blades, casings, structural elements, and integrally bladed rotors; along with combustor modules, cases, and structures; and low-pressure turbine modules and blades. Beyond manufacturing, it also provides repair, exchange, and commissioning services for these parts. Hanwha Aerospace further develops and delivers advanced aeronautical mechanical systems, including flight control, hydraulic, and fuel systems, for both fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft. For space launch vehicles, its expertise extends to thrust vector control, reaction control, and liquid propellant supply systems. Additionally, the firm offers maintenance services specifically for military aircraft. Established in 1977, its headquarters are situated in Changwon-si, South Korea.

Established in 1977 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, S-1 Corporation is a leading provider of comprehensive safety and security services both domestically and internationally. The company's diverse physical security offerings include alarm monitoring, specialized software for physical security information management, advanced smart video systems, access control mechanisms, optical sensing technologies, and ultra-wideband sensors. S-1 also delivers integrated security solutions, spanning consulting, engineering, procurement, installation, and ongoing maintenance. These solutions cater to a broad spectrum of clients and venues, including office buildings, commercial properties, airports, industrial plants, marine transportation systems, and critical national facilities. Additionally, their services extend to residential security, intelligent traffic signal control, parking management systems, traffic surveillance, automated payment solutions, and CPTED (Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design) security consulting. In the realm of information security, S-1 Corporation offers security control, PC protection, and antivirus software services. Under the S-1 Blue Asset brand, they provide building management solutions encompassing property and facility management, real estate consulting, and the implementation of essential building infrastructure. Further offerings include fleet management and personal safety phone solutions. The corporation also operates call center and telemarketing services.

Kunlun Energy Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, development, production, and sale of crude oil and natural gas in the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Sultanate of Oman, and the Kingdom of Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Natural Gas Sales; Sales of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG); Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Processing and Terminal; and Exploration and Production. It also involved in the processing, unloading, storing, gasification, and entrucking of LNG; trading, distribution, and retail sale of various natural gas products; and wholesale and retail of various LPG products. The company was formerly known as CNPC (Hong Kong) Limited and changed its name to Kunlun Energy Company Limited in March 2010. Kunlun Energy Company Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hong Kong, Hong Kong. Kunlun Energy Company Limited is a subsidiary of PetroChina Hong Kong Limited.

First Pacific Company Limited, established in 1981 and headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, functions as an investment management and holding company. Its diverse portfolio encompasses key sectors such as consumer food products, telecommunications, infrastructure, and natural resources, with its activities extending across the Philippines, Indonesia, Singapore, the Middle East, Africa, and other international regions. In the telecommunications domain, the company delivers a comprehensive suite of digital services, including the management of fiber optic backbone networks, fixed-line communications, and mobile platforms. Its consumer food division is actively involved in manufacturing and distributing a wide array of products like noodles, dairy items, snack foods, food seasonings, nutritional and specialty foods, beverages, wheat flour, and pasta. This segment also undertakes seed breeding, cultivates crops such as oil palm, rubber, and sugar cane, and provides cooking oils, margarines, and shortenings. Within the natural resources sector, First Pacific engages in the exploration, mining, and production of precious metals including gold, copper, and silver, in addition to manufacturing sugar and ethanol. Furthermore, its infrastructure interests involve the operation of gas-fired power plants, the provision of water distribution, sewerage, and sanitation services, and the management of toll roads, hospitals, rail lines, and logistics operations.

Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) operates as a comprehensive electric utility, handling the generation, transmission, and distribution of electrical power both within South Korea and across international borders. Its operations are structured across several key segments: Transmission and Distribution, Nuclear Power Generation, Thermal Power Generation, and other ancillary activities. KEPCO harnesses a diverse array of energy sources to produce electricity, including nuclear, coal, oil, liquefied natural gas (LNG), internal combustion, combined-cycle, and integrated gasification combined cycle (IGCC) technologies, alongside renewables such as hydroelectric, wind, solar, fuel cell, and biogas, among others. By the close of 2021, specifically December 31st, KEPCO's extensive generation infrastructure comprised 763 units, encompassing nuclear, thermal, hydroelectric, and internal combustion facilities, boasting a combined installed capacity of 82,459 megawatts. The company's transmission network, as of the same date, spanned 34,923 circuit kilometers of lines, featuring both 765 kilovolt and other specifications, including high-voltage direct current (HVDC) lines. This network was supported by 892 substations, which together possessed an installed transformer capacity of 344,286 megavolt-amperes. Furthermore, KEPCO's distribution system was characterized by 132,376 megavolt-amperes of transformer capacity, 9,940,440 support units, and an extensive total line length of 532,348 circuit kilometers. Electricity services are supplied to a broad spectrum of consumers, including residential homes, commercial establishments, educational institutions, industrial facilities, agricultural operations, street lighting, and those utilizing overnight power tariffs. Beyond core electricity provisions, KEPCO's service portfolio extends to utility plant maintenance, resource exploration and development, specialized electric power information technology solutions, comprehensive facility maintenance and support, electric meter reading, security services, information and communication line leasing, and the sale of nuclear fuel. Established in 1961, Korea Electric Power Corporation maintains its corporate headquarters in Naju-si, South Korea.

Samsung Securities Co., Ltd. operates as a leading financial investment firm with a significant presence across South Korea and international markets. The company provides a comprehensive suite of services to both individual and institutional clients, encompassing wealth management, digital asset management, and pension planning solutions. Its offerings extend to specialized consulting for investments in equities, fixed-income instruments, and over-the-counter (OTC) products, along with expertise in mergers and acquisitions (M&A), investment finance, and alternative investment strategies. Furthermore, Samsung Securities facilitates derivatives trading, including the supply and exchange of Equity-Linked Securities (ELS), Debt-Linked Securities (DLS), and Exchange Traded Notes (ETNs). The firm also provides fixed income, currency, and commodity services, as well as institutional sales and brokerage. It engages in proprietary trading, allocating capital to stocks and bonds within public markets, and participating in private market ventures like mezzanine financing and Private Equity Fund (PEF) investments, with a focus on generating stable income through rigorous market analysis and risk management. Additionally, the company handles structured product trading, such as KRW and foreign currency products designed to deliver short-term fixed returns. Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1982, Samsung Securities maintains an extensive operational network comprising 44 domestic and 8 other branches, complemented by 5 overseas offices.

Established in 1983 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, Fursys Inc. specializes in the creation, production, and distribution of a wide range of furniture. The company primarily furnishes office and residential spaces, offering items such as desks, modular partitioning systems, executive and lobby seating, complete conference and lecture setups, sofas, coffee tables, and various related accessories. Their portfolio also includes specialized furniture for libraries and student dormitories. Furthermore, Fursys Inc. caters to the healthcare sector, providing dedicated furnishings for areas like medical equipment zones, patient wards, clinical facilities, nursing stations, laboratory environments (including those for primary and secondary science education), staff workspaces, and patient waiting or resting areas. These products are marketed under the distinct brand names FURSYS, iloom, and SIDIZ.

Sa Sa International Holdings Limited, functioning as an investment holding company, is primarily engaged in the retail and wholesale distribution of beauty products across Hong Kong and Macau, mainland China, and Malaysia. The company boasts a comprehensive selection of approximately 600 brands, encompassing skincare, fragrances, makeup, body care, hair care, health and fitness merchandise, alongside modern beauty gadgets. Beyond its primary operations, the firm also handles intellectual property rights, manages property holdings, and supports charitable causes. As of March 31, 2022, Sa Sa operated a total of 234 retail locations. Additionally, it leverages various e-commerce channels for sales, including its proprietary website (sasa.com), a dedicated mobile application, social commerce initiatives, and collaborations with third-party digital platforms. Founded in 1978, the company's headquarters are situated in Chai Wan, Hong Kong.

Keck Seng Investments (Hong Kong) Limited functions as an investment holding firm, engaging in hotel and club management, alongside property investment and development endeavors. The company's operations are structured into three principal divisions: Hotel, Property, and Investment & Corporate. The Hotel segment provides lodging services, offers food and beverages through its restaurant outlets, and oversees slot machine operations. The Property division focuses on leasing out investment assets, predominantly retail, commercial, and office spaces, while also handling the development, sale, and marketing of trading properties, in addition to offering property management services. The Investment & Corporate segment manages both trading and non-trading securities, various financial instruments, and other treasury functions. The company maintains a significant operational footprint across Macau, Vietnam, mainland China, Japan, Canada, the United States, and Hong Kong. Established in 1973, Keck Seng Investments has its headquarters located in Central, Hong Kong.

Uni-President China Holdings Ltd. functions as an investment holding company, directing its operations toward the production, sale, and commercialization of food and beverage items across the Chinese market. The company organizes its diverse business activities into three primary divisions: Beverages, Food, and Others. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a variety of drinks such as tea-based beverages, fruit juices, milk teas, coffee, bottled water, and other canned refreshments. Within the food sector, it manufactures instant noodles and seasonings. Additionally, the firm is involved in the wholesale distribution of pre-packaged foods, dairy items, forage, and fertilizers, as well as the production and sale of mineral water. Further broadening its scope, Uni-President China engages in general trading, property leasing, real estate ventures, catering services, management advisory, and human resources management. Established in 1992, its corporate headquarters are situated in Shanghai, China. Uni-President China Holdings Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Cayman President Holdings Ltd.

Samsung C&T Corporation is a diversified enterprise with extensive operations in engineering and construction, global trading and investment, fashion, and resort management. Its business activities extend across South Korea, the broader Asian region, Europe, and the Americas. The engineering and construction division handles a variety of projects, including commercial and residential buildings, civil infrastructure, and industrial plant construction. Through its trading and investment arm, the company is involved in a broad spectrum of commodities and industrial materials. This includes chemicals like polymers, fertilizers, and methanol; electronic components and precision materials; various steel products (hot-rolled, cold-rolled, stainless); natural resources such as coal, copper, and raw metal; and agricultural goods like palm oil. It also deals in living industrial materials including textiles, food, and wood pellets. This segment further specializes in organizing and developing significant projects, such as power plants, renewable energy initiatives, and infrastructure, alongside managing palm plantations. In the fashion sector, Samsung C&T offers a wide array of apparel. Men's and casual clothing are available under the GALAXY and BEANPOLE brands, while KUHO and LEBEIGE provide women's wear, children's clothing, accessories, and outdoor lines. The company also features the fast-fashion brand, 8seconds. Finally, the resort business encompasses the operation of golf courses, landscaping services, and food and beverage facilities. Founded in Seoul, South Korea, in 1938, the company was previously known as Cheil Industries Inc. until its renaming to Samsung C&T Corporation in September 2015.

Operating as an investment holding entity, BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited is centrally involved in crafting and supplying parts and integrated modules for mobile handsets. Its commercial footprint extends across the People's Republic of China and into international markets. The firm also furnishes high-level assembly solutions. In addition to mobile device components, its extensive product line encompasses various batteries and charging apparatuses, with a particular emphasis on iron phosphate batteries—and their associated components and spare parts—engineered for electric vehicles such as buses, trucks, cars, and industrial forklifts. Diversifying its portfolio, the company also undertakes the development and ongoing maintenance of monorail projects. Established in 1995, BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited's principal office is located in Shenzhen, China, and it functions as a subsidiary of Golden Link Worldwide Limited.

Operating globally through its various subsidiaries, Pan Ocean Co., Ltd. specializes in maritime transport and associated logistics solutions. Its comprehensive operations are structured across four primary divisions: Bulk Carrier, Container, Tanker, and various other specialized shipping services. The company's diverse activities include break-bulk liner services for items such as steel, timber, and heavy machinery, alongside tramp services for a wide array of dry bulk commodities like iron ore, coal, grains, sugar, and minerals. It also utilizes large bulk carriers for significant shipments of grain, coal, and iron ore, complemented by its general container transport solutions. Additionally, Pan Ocean offers extensive tanker services for liquid cargoes, including refined petroleum products such as gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and heavy oils, as well as crude oil, palm oil, and petrochemicals like benzene and caustic soda. Beyond this, its specialized fleet encompasses liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, heavy-lift vessels for oversized equipment and industrial machinery, and a range of marine assets including tugboats, drill ships, and ocean platforms. The company also extends its operations into agricultural product trading and logistics, managing commodities such as corn, soybeans, and wheat. Established in 1966 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, the company adopted its current name, Pan Ocean Co., Ltd., in January 2014, having previously been known as STX Pan Ocean Co., Ltd. It currently operates as a subsidiary under Harim Holdings Co., Ltd.

WH Group Limited operates as an investment holding entity, primarily focused on the end-to-end production, wholesale, and retail sales of meat products. Its extensive operations cover key markets including China, the United States, Mexico, and various European nations. The company's business activities are organized into distinct segments: Packaged Meats, Pork, and an "Others" category. Beyond its core meat processing, the group manages hog farming and is involved in the slaughter, wholesale, and retail of both fresh and frozen pork. Diversifying its portfolio, WH Group also manufactures and sells packaging materials, offers logistics services, operates a chain of retail food stores, produces flavoring ingredients and natural casings, and distributes biological pharmaceutical materials. Additionally, the company engages in livestock breeding and slaughtering, alongside finance and property development ventures. Established in 1958, the company changed its name from Shuanghui International Holdings Limited to WH Group Limited in January 2014 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong.

China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures, distributes, and sells alcoholic beverages in Mainland China. It offers beer and baijiu products. The company was formerly known as China Resources Enterprise, Limited and changed its name to China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited in October 2015. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of CRH (Beer) Limited.

Samsung Card Co., Ltd. is a prominent financial services enterprise operating within South Korea. Its primary business encompasses a diverse array of card payment solutions, such as credit, debit, and pre-paid cards. Furthermore, its portfolio includes both short-term and long-term card loans, as well as installment and lease/rental financing options. Beyond these core offerings, Samsung Card extends into insurance and shopping services, along with specialized provisions for weddings, travel, and various lifestyle requirements. Integral to its operations is also a robust fraud protection service. The company, which was originally established in 1988, changed its name from Samsung Credit Card Co., Ltd. to its current designation, Samsung Card Co., Ltd., in July 1995. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Seoul, South Korea. Samsung Card operates as a subsidiary of Samsung Life Insurance Co., Ltd.

Operating extensively in South Korea, NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. specializes in a comprehensive range of credit-related activities, including credit assessment, background checks, and debt recovery. The company also supplies crucial credit and corporate data, coupled with advisory services. Expanding its portfolio, NICE provides expertise in management consulting and advanced data analytics. Furthermore, it engages in services pertaining to construction and development. Founded in 1985, NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.

KT Corporation, headquartered in Seongnam, South Korea, functions as a comprehensive provider of integrated telecommunications and digital platform services, serving customers both domestically and internationally. The company offers a wide range of communication solutions, including traditional fixed-line telephone services such as local, long-distance, international, and Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) calls, alongside essential interconnection capabilities. Its internet offerings span broadband access, various data communication services like fixed-line and leased line options, and other internet-related provisions. Beyond core connectivity, KT is actively involved in media and content delivery, providing services such as IPTV, satellite television, digital music, e-commerce platforms, online advertising consultation, and digital publications like comics and novels. The corporation also extends its reach into financial services, handling credit card processing and other related activities. The company's broad portfolio further includes information technology (IT) and network services, satellite communications, and the sale of mobile handsets and other telecommunications equipment. Additionally, KT participates in real estate development, selling residential and commercial properties, and manages property rentals. Its diverse operations also cover the maintenance of public telephone systems and a multitude of specialized services, including security solutions, B2C and B2B offerings, investment fund management, software development, data processing, value-added networks, system integration, mobile marketing, cloud system implementation, network infrastructure management, and data center development. Other ventures involve Internet banking solutions, residential construction, sports group management, technology business finance, submarine cable construction and maintenance, and trunk radio systems. As of December 31, 2020, KT proudly served approximately 22.3 million mobile subscribers and 8.8 million IPTV subscribers. Founded in 1981 as Korea Telecom Corp., the company officially adopted the name KT Corporation in March 2002.

Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. operates as an investment holding company, with its primary focus on manufacturing and selling instant noodles, a diverse range of beverages, and convenience food products across the People's Republic of China. The company's business activities are segmented into Instant Noodles, Beverages, and an 'Others' category. Its extensive beverage portfolio includes ready-to-drink teas, fruit juices, milk teas, bottled water, carbonated soft drinks, alongside coffee, functional, and probiotic beverages. Furthermore, Tingyi diversifies its operations by providing property rental and management, logistics, and various management and support services, in addition to producing and marketing meat and bakery products. By the end of 2021, its robust sales infrastructure featured 340 sales offices and 341 warehouses, reaching an impressive 80,726 wholesalers and 256,567 direct retail outlets. Established in 1992, the company maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, PRC.

Operating predominantly in South Korea, LG Uplus Corp. delivers a broad spectrum of telecommunications services. The company provides mobile connectivity to consumers, which includes 5G networks, standard telecommunication, and roaming options. For households, it offers various home media solutions, such as AI and IoT integrations, along with broadband internet, IPTV, homeboy devices, bundled packages, and internet phone services. Additionally, the corporation supports business customers with a comprehensive array of enterprise services. These span drone control systems, dedicated business telecommunications and phone services, internet provision, security, IT solutions, marketing and customer relationship management tools, and industrial IoT applications, as well as facilities, service, and security solutions, and associated products. Beyond these primary activities, LG Uplus is also involved in the sale of mobile handsets, providing telemarketing and other business support, managing investment funds, and engaging in cable television and broadcasting operations. Founded in 1996, LG Uplus Corp. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

PAX Global Technology Limited is an investment holding company primarily engaged in the worldwide development and sale of electronic funds transfer point-of-sale (EFT-POS) systems. Its diverse array of E-payment terminals features advanced smart E-payment solutions, intelligent electronic cash registers, self-service (unattended) solutions, cutting-edge Smart PayPhone and PayTablet devices, as well as conventional E-payment options and related accessories. Beyond hardware, the company also creates specialized software platforms including PAXSTORE, a cloud-based service allowing users to establish and manage their own white-label marketplaces for application distribution; paxRhino, a secure key injection service; and CyberLab, a cloud-native testing environment that offers comprehensive online debugging and evaluation for payment applications. Additionally, PAX Global provides various payment solution services, alongside essential maintenance and installation support. The company was established in 2000 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

Samsung Life Insurance Co., Ltd. is a leading South Korean insurer with a global footprint, primarily operating in the life insurance sector. Its operations span domestic and international markets, encompassing not just insurance but also credit card services, installment financing, and leasing. The company delivers a comprehensive suite of insurance products, including life, term, health, accident, pension, savings, child, and direct policies. Beyond insurance, it provides various financial services such as insurance contract loans, credit loans, mortgage financing, and retirement pension solutions. Additionally, its activities extend to real estate leasing, investment and trust management, specialized credit financing, facilitating collective and real estate investment vehicles, and supporting new technology business ventures. Founded in Seoul, South Korea, in 1957, Samsung Life Insurance maintained a significant operational presence as of December 31, 2021, with 88 local divisions and 590 branches.

KT&G Corporation, a diversified South Korean enterprise that operates alongside its subsidiaries, specializes in a broad array of industries. Its primary business involves the manufacturing and distribution of tobacco products and related materials. Beyond this, the company is a significant provider of health and wellness items, offering red ginseng, various red ginseng-based goods, and other health-focused foods. Its extensive product portfolio also features food and beverage items, along with cosmetic and beauty products. Further diversifying its operations, KT&G offers support services for leaf tobacco cultivation and maintains a presence in the pharmaceutical and medical sectors. This includes the development, production, and supply of pharmaceuticals, encompassing bio-pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter medicines, and a range of medical supplies and equipment. The corporation also holds investments in commercial ventures such as trading, real estate management, property leasing, and housing development. Additionally, it is involved in the development and ongoing management of hotels. Founded in 1987, the company originally operated under the name Korea Tobacco and Ginseng Corporation before officially changing to KT&G Corporation in December 2002. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Daejeon, South Korea.

Vitasoy International Holdings Limited, along with its associated entities, is primarily involved in the creation and distribution of various food and beverage items across key markets, including mainland China, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore. Its comprehensive product range includes soy milk and other plant-based milk alternatives, teas, bottled water, fruit juices, and tofu. Beyond manufacturing, the company also operates catering services and snack kiosks, markets a variety of beverages, exports soy-derived products globally, and holds property investments. Its goods are distributed to consumers through a wide network of distributors and retail outlets. The enterprise was founded in 1940 and its main office is situated in Tuen Mun, Hong Kong.

NAVER Corporation, along with its subsidiaries, is a prominent provider of internet search and mobile messaging platform services, operating across South Korea, Japan, and internationally. Its consumer-facing offerings include the widely-used Naver search engine, featuring diverse content topic boards; the LINE mobile messaging application; Naver Clova, an integrated artificial intelligence platform; and Papago, an automated translation tool. Users can also access the WHALE web browser, Naver Map for navigation, and a range of entertainment platforms such as Webtoon for digital comics, SERIES for premium paid content, and the SNOW camera app. It also facilitates community interaction via BAND and offers audio shows through NOW within the NAVER app. For businesses, NAVER WORKS provides essential collaborative tools such as messaging, email, calendar, and drive functionality. The company further supports enterprises with IT and BIZ platforms, advertising services, and NAVER SQUARE. Creators benefit from platforms like NAVER Webtoon, NAVER Webnovel, NAVER AudioClip, Series, Premium Contents, VIBE, NAVER TV, NAVER Post, Grafolio, and support services such as the NAVER Influencer Center and Creator Advisor. Developers benefit from resources like NAVER D2 Startup Factory, DEVIEW, NAVER D2, NAVER Open Source, and a suite of APIs, including those for CLOVA Platform, NAVER Maps, Papago, and NAVER login. Additionally, NAVER Corporation holds interests in various other sectors, including cosmetics manufacturing, electronic financial services, film production and distribution, real estate rental, investment and information services, and the wholesale and retail of character-related products. Established in 1999 as NHN Corporation, NAVER Corporation maintains its headquarters in Seongnam-si, South Korea.

Luks Group (Vietnam Holdings) Company Limited operates as an investment holding firm, with its primary focus on the manufacture and distribution of cement products for the construction sector throughout Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Mainland China. The company's diverse activities are organized into five key divisions: Cement Products, Property Investment, Hotel Operation, Property Development, and Corporate and Others. It provides KIM DINH brand cement to both construction sites and retail markets, alongside supplying clinkers. Beyond its cement business, the group invests in and leases a varied portfolio of industrial, commercial, and residential properties, and offers associated property management services. Luks Group is also involved in developing and selling real estate. Its hospitality segment manages the 298-room Pentahotel Hong Kong situated in Tuen Mun. Additionally, the company engages in the trading of electronic products, including printed circuit boards and other components, and manufactures and sells plywood. Established in 1975, its headquarters are located in Tokwawan, Hong Kong.

China Gas Holdings Limited operates as a leading gas utility and service provider across the People's Republic of China. The company's core activities involve the investment, construction, operation, and maintenance of comprehensive urban and regional gas pipeline networks, alongside gas terminals, storage, and transportation facilities, and integrated gas logistics systems. It delivers both natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to a wide array of residential, industrial, and commercial customers. Furthermore, China Gas builds and manages compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) refueling stations. Beyond infrastructure, the company is engaged in developing technologies pertinent to natural gas and LPG. Its scope extends to investing in petrochemical storage and transport facilities, as well as the production and warehousing of LPG and chemical products such as propane and butane. The firm also participates in the exploration and production of coal bed methane (CBM) and offers administrative, management, and consultancy services for gas stations. Complementing its primary gas business, China Gas provides treasury, management, consultancy, and procurement services. It markets smart home solutions, functions as a gas insurance broker, and sells "Gasbo" brand gas heaters and kitchen appliances. The company is committed to clean energy development and investment, actively engages in the wholesale and trading of natural gas and liquefied natural gas, and sells electricity. Its product portfolio further includes gas meters, pressure regulators, corrugated pipes, gas alarms, and bottled gas. Additionally, the company is involved in the wholesale and retail of general household equipment, electric appliances, and kitchen appliances. As of March 31, 2022, China Gas served 19,808 industrial, 297,664 commercial, and an impressive 43,095,245 residential customers. At the same date, it managed a network of 533 CNG/LNG refilling stations. Incorporated in 1995, the company is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

Kiwoom Securities Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, serves as a leading provider of online brokerage solutions, reaching clients across South Korea and internationally. Utilizing its advanced online trading platform, the firm enables transactions in international and domestic stocks, various futures contracts (both local and overseas), and foreign exchange margin trading, alongside deals involving equities, futures, and options. Beyond these direct trading functionalities, Kiwoom Securities specializes in broader derivatives and futures trading services. Its comprehensive equity capital market services include initial public offerings (IPOs), corporate recapitalizations, and the origination and underwriting of diverse bond types, such as convertible bonds and bonds with warrants. Furthermore, the company is deeply involved in debt capital markets, performing the underwriting of corporate debt instruments and asset-backed securities, as well as asset liquidation. The portfolio also features structured financing solutions, encompassing alternative investments, shipping finance, and green finance, complemented by extensive investment, risk management, and asset management services. The firm additionally provides in-depth research, offering expert analysis on equity markets and investment strategies. Notably, Kiwoom Securities operates a savings bank, which extends financial services to local residents and small-to-medium sized enterprises. Founded in 2000, Kiwoom Securities Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

Guangshen Railway Company Limited engages in the railway passenger and freight transportation businesses in the People's Republic of China. Its passenger transportation services include the operation of Guangzhou-Shenzhen inter-city express trains, and long-distance trains. The company's freight transportation services comprise the transportation of full load cargos, containers, bulky and heavy cargo, dangerous goods, perishable goods, and oversized cargos. It also provides railway network usage; transportation; locomotive traction, railway lines, and power supply; passenger; and maintenance, loading, and unloading services, as well as sells food, beverages, and products on board the trains and in railway stations. In addition, the company is involved in train repairs, technical upgrades, sales of materials, goods and supplies, sewage collection services, on-board catering services, security and fire protection service, station and passenger service, leasing, and other businesses, as well as transportation equipment and facilities maintenance. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.

Yue Yuen Industrial (Holdings) Limited functions as an investment holding company with extensive operations in the global manufacturing, marketing, and retail of diverse footwear categories, including athletic, athletic leisure, casual, and outdoor styles. The company maintains a significant presence across the People's Republic of China, the wider Asian region, the United States, Europe, and other international markets. It acts as a key original design manufacturer (ODM) and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) for numerous renowned international brands, such as adidas, Nike, Puma, New Balance, Asics, Converse, Decathlon, Merrell, Mizuno, Reebok, Salomon, Saucony, and Timberland. Beyond footwear, Yue Yuen is also engaged in the retail and distribution of sportswear and apparel, and its manufacturing capabilities extend to leather goods, clothing, sports sandals, along with essential soles and components. As of December 31, 2021, its retail network in the Greater China region comprised 4,631 directly operated stores and an additional 3,786 outlets run by sub-distributors. Founded in 1969, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.

China Communications Services Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries provides telecommunications support services worldwide. It offers telecommunications infrastructure services, including planning, design, construction, and project supervision for fixed line, mobile, broadband networks, data centers and supporting systems; construction services of ancillary communications networks; and integrated solutions for informatization, digitalization, and intelligentization. The company also provides business process outsourcing services comprising network maintenance and optimization services that include fiber optic and electric cables, mobile base stations, network equipment, and terminals; general facilities management services for customers data centers, cloud computing bases, commercial and residential buildings, high-speed railway stations, airports, etc.; and supply chain services, including warehousing, transportation, integrated logistics, procurement and tendering, and quality inspection, as well as repair and disposition to domestic telecommunications operators, government and enterprise customers. In addition, it offers applications, content, and other services, such as system integration, software development and system support, value-added, and other services. Further, the company provides submarine cable installation and other related services. Additionally, it involved in the distribution of communication and information products; terminals sales; device distribution services; and distribution and procurement services of IT devices, auxiliary machinery, and equipment. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

business_summary: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of financial solutions and offerings to clients both within South Korea and across the globe. Its operations are structured across six primary divisions: Banking, Credit Card, Securities, Life Insurance, Credit, and a miscellaneous "Others" category. For individual customers, the group furnishes retail banking provisions such as current, savings, and time deposit accounts; checking facilities; various forms of personal lending including mortgages and home equity loans; digital banking platforms; ATM access; and essential transactional services like bill payments, payroll processing, check cashing, foreign currency exchange, and wire transfers. In the corporate sector, it extends a broad spectrum of services, encompassing investment banking, funding for real estate and international development projects, infrastructure and structured finance, equity and venture capital investments, and advisory for mergers and acquisitions. Furthermore, its corporate offerings include securitization and derivatives products, foreign exchange trading, and diverse loan types such as working capital and facilities financing. The group also participates actively in treasury and investment endeavors within global capital markets, engaging in the trading of foreign currency securities, foreign exchange services and transactions, trade finance, international factoring, and conducting overseas banking operations. Complementing these, Shinhan provides trust management, securities brokerage, and asset management services. Its wider portfolio includes leasing and equipment financing, savings bank operations, debt collection and credit reporting, oversight of collective investment schemes, private equity investments, and the development of financial systems. By the close of 2021, its extensive operational footprint comprised 784 service centers, 5,234 automated teller machines (ATMs), 7 cash dispensers, and 85 digital kiosks. Established in 1982, Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.

Established in 1998 and based in Hwaseong-si, South Korea, SFA Engineering Corporation operates as a global producer and vendor of a wide array of specialized industrial machinery. Its extensive product range caters to various sectors, including advanced display manufacturing, where it supplies clean logistics systems, front-end and module equipment, along with tools for flexible panels and glass processing. For logistics, the company provides automated warehousing, factory automation, and comprehensive distribution center systems. SFA Engineering also delivers critical equipment for the semiconductor industry, such as stockers, OHT(S), LBS, EMS, AGV/LGV, and precision laser dicing and drilling machines. Furthermore, it contributes to renewable energy production with sputter systems, wire solder, tabber and stringer units, and complete module turn-key solutions for solar and fuel cells. The firm's portfolio extends to unique industrial applications, encompassing aerospace equipment, thermal vacuum chambers, nuclear fusion chambers, accelerators, and autoclaves, serving both domestic and international markets.

China Overseas Land & Investment Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development, commercial property operations, and other businesses in the People's Republic of China and the United Kingdom. It is involved in the rental of properties; material procurement and supply chain management activities; issuance of guaranteed notes; property consultancy and real estate agency; and construction and building design consultancy activities. The company also provides loan financing and security investment services; operates hotels; and develops and sells properties. In addition, it engages in the investment and financing, land consolidation, regional planning, real estate development, engineering construction, industrial import, and property management businesses. Further, the company offers urban services, including office buildings, flexible working space, shopping malls, star-rated hotels, long-term rental apartments, logistics parks, and architectural design and construction. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. China Overseas Land & Investment Limited is a subsidiary of China Overseas Holdings Limited.

TravelSky Technology Limited, established in Beijing, China, in 1979, specializes in providing comprehensive information technology services to the aviation and travel sectors across the People's Republic of China. The company's principal offerings encompass aviation information technology (AIT), distribution information technology, and essential financial functions like accounting, settlement, and clearing services. Within its AIT segment, TravelSky delivers a suite of electronic travel distribution solutions, including inventory control systems, computer reservation systems, and airport passenger processing systems, alongside various other specialized IT solutions. Furthermore, the company is involved in cargo management services, which includes the sale and implementation of associated information systems. TravelSky's diverse operations also cover the development of computer hardware and software, provision of data network services, and the design and installation of computer system engineering projects. The company is actively engaged in technology development, support, and transfer services, as well as the sale of computers, software, and related equipment. Additional business activities include contracting for computer software and hardware engineering projects, technical consultancy, system integration, real estate development and sales, contracting for its own commercial housing projects, labor service subcontracting, freight management, and trade financing services.

Hyundai Department Store Co., Ltd. manages a portfolio of department stores situated in the Apgujeong-dong and Cheonho-dong areas within South Korea's Gangdong District. Complementing its retail ventures, the company also extends services as a real estate agency. This enterprise was established in 2002, with its principal office located in Seoul, South Korea.

Tencent Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, delivering a broad spectrum of value-added services (VAS) and digital advertising solutions to markets in both Mainland China and internationally. Its operations are structured across key segments, including Value-Added Services, Online Advertising, FinTech and Business Services, and various other ventures. The company's core offerings encompass online gaming, social networking platforms, financial technology solutions, cloud computing services, and digital advertising. Beyond these, Tencent is actively involved in the production, funding, and distribution of films and television content for external entities, alongside managing copyright licensing, merchandising, and other related activities. Its extensive portfolio also includes software development, the creation and operation of online games, comprehensive information technology services, system integration, asset management, online literature platforms, and digital music entertainment. Established in 1998, Tencent Holdings Limited maintains its corporate headquarters in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China.

GS Holdings Corp. is a dynamic conglomerate with extensive operations spanning the energy, retail, and construction sectors, both within South Korea and across international markets. The company's robust energy division encompasses the management of co-generation plants and district heating and cooling networks, alongside natural gas distribution. It generates and supplies electricity, harnessing clean fuels like natural gas and bioenergy, and also participates in coal-fired thermal power. Its interests extend to trading petroleum products, petrochemicals, base oils, and lubricants. Furthermore, GS Holdings is involved in renewable energy initiatives, including the development and operation of wind power facilities and their transmission infrastructure, bioenergy provision, the maritime transport of liquefied petroleum gas and propylene, the production of reclaimed metals, and upstream oil and gas exploration and production activities. In the retail sphere, the corporation operates prominent brands such as GS25 convenience stores, GS Supermarkets, Watsons health and beauty outlets, and the Parnas Hotels chain. Beyond its principal businesses, GS Holdings provides an array of services. These include media development, content creation, advertising, point-of-purchase (POP) solutions, and mobile coupons. It is also active in TV home shopping, mobile commerce, and global trade, covering import/export and cross-border transactions. The company's logistics arm offers comprehensive transport and storage solutions for a wide range of commodities, from steel and metals to petrochemicals, cement, mechanical goods, industrial facilities, and bituminous coal. Additionally, it oversees the management of professional sports teams, specifically a football club and a volleyball team. Its construction and engineering segment undertakes projects in architecture, civil engineering, housing development, industrial plants, environmental solutions, and power plant infrastructure. The company also delivers specialized operation and maintenance services to the oil, gas, petrochemical, power generation, and environmental sectors, and provides telecommunication services. Rounding out its diverse portfolio, GS Holdings manages the Elysian resort, featuring condominiums, a golf course, and a ski slope. Founded in 2004, GS Holdings Corp. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.

IGG Inc functions as an investment holding company, focusing on the creation and management of mobile and online games across global markets, including Asia, North America, and Europe. The company provides a wide array of online games for mobile platforms, web browsers, personal computers, and client-based systems, supported in 23 languages. Additionally, IGG Inc is involved in licensing online games and supplying comprehensive customer and technical support services. The firm was established in 2006 and its headquarters are located in Singapore.

FILA Holdings Corporation, operating through its various subsidiaries, markets and distributes a broad spectrum of products both domestically in Korea and internationally. This extensive range includes textiles, apparel, footwear, leather goods, timepieces, beauty products, and golf equipment, primarily under the FILA brand. The company also manufactures and sells golf-related items, such as balls, clubs, and accessories, which are branded Titleist. A key part of its business involves licensing FILA-branded merchandise and exporting its diverse product lines. Established in 1991, the company was formerly known as FILA Korea Ltd. before adopting its current name, FILA Holdings Corporation, in January 2020. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Seoul, South Korea.

Hi Sun Technology (China) Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It operates through the following segments: Payment and Digital Services, Fintech Services, Platform Operation Services, and Financial Solutions. The Payment and Digital Services segment refer to payment processing. The Fintech Services segment includes micro-lending, supply chain financing, factoring, and credit assessment. The Platform Operation Solution is involved in telecommunication and mobile payment platforms. The Financial Solutions segment pertains to information system consultancy. The company was founded on May 31, 2001 is headquartered in Hong Kong.

China Water Affairs Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the water supply, environmental protection, and property businesses in the People's Republic of China. It operates through City Water Supply, Pipeline Direct Drinking Water Supply, Environmental Protection, Main Contractor Construction, and Property Development and Investment segments. The City Water Supply segment is involved in the provision of water supply operation and construction, installation and maintenance, and other services. Its Pipeline Direct Drinking Water Supply segment is involved in the provision of pipeline direct drinking water supply operations and construction, installation and maintenance services, and other services. The Environmental Protection segment engages in sewage treatment, drainage operation, construction services, solid and hazardous waste, environmental sanitation, and water environment management businesses. Its Main Contractor Construction segment is involved in the provision of municipal public construction services. The Property Development and Investment segment develops, sells, and invests in properties. It also involved in the development and infrastructure of sightseeing area; provision of water environmental renovation infrastructure; construction and operations in urban water treatment business, remediation and rural water improvement; and investment, construction, and operation of water conservation and hydropower related projects, as well as energy conservation and environmental protection and hotel operations. In addition, the company offers warehousing, storage, trading and distribution of oil related products. The company was formerly known as China Silver Dragon Group Limited and changed its name to China Water Affairs Group Limited in December 2004. China Water Affairs Group Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

Hyundai GLOVIS Co., Ltd. engages in the freight transport brokerage, agency and other supporting transport services. It operates through the following business areas: Logistics, Shipping and Complete Knock down (CKD), Used Car and New Growth. The Logistics business provides international, domestics and military logistics, logistics consulting services. The Shipping business offers overseas shipment for finished vehicles and bulk export and import. The CKD business provides CKD distribution and packing. The Used Car business offers auction house and wholesale. The New Growth business offers distribution of recycled resources for automobiles, resource development and distribution, product trading. The company was founded on February 22, 2001 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

Established in 1995 and headquartered in North Point, Hong Kong, China Medical System Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company with a primary focus on the development, marketing, and distribution of a wide array of pharmaceutical products throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's extensive portfolio addresses numerous therapeutic areas. Its cardiovascular offerings include Plendil for hypertension and stable angina, XinHuoSu for acute heart failure, and Imdur for coronary heart disease, chronic heart failure, and myocardial infarction prevention. For mental health and neurological support, it provides Deanxit to treat mild-to-moderate depression and anxiety, along with Parlodel tablets for endocrine and neuro system indications. Digestive and liver conditions are managed with products such as Ursofalk for gallstones and cholestatic liver disease, Salofalk for ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, Bioflor for diarrhea, Combizym for dyspepsia, and Ganfule capsules for primary liver cancer, plus MOVICOL for chronic constipation. The company also markets Augentropfen Stulln Mono eye drops for senile macula degeneration and asthenopia, Hirudoid for blunt trauma and superficial phlebitis, Elcatonin injection for osteoporosis, and Lamisil tablets for fungal infections. Respiratory issues are addressed by YiNuoShu, while infectious diseases benefit from DanShenTong capsules (for various infections like acne, tonsillitis, and boils) and YinlianQinggan granules for hepatitis. XiDaKang, a protein hydrolysate oral solution, is also part of its offerings. Beyond its pharmaceutical endeavors, the group is also actively involved in agriculture and livestock operations. China Medical System Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Treasure Sea Limited.

Hana Financial Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services through its subsidiaries. It provides management and financial support to its subsidiaries including Hana Bank, Hana Securities, Hana Card, Hana Capital, Hana Life, and Hana Non-Life Insurance. The company was founded in June 1971 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily involved in the production and distribution of diverse glass products, such as automotive, construction, and float glass, catering to industrial and commercial requirements. Its operations are structured into three main divisions: Float Glass, Automobile Glass, and Architectural Glass. Beyond its core glass manufacturing, the company has diversified its ventures to include the production of automotive rubber and plastic components, electronic glass, and engagement in glass trading and research. Its broader portfolio encompasses offering logistics and supply chain services, operating a wind farm for electricity generation, and fabricating automatic machinery for solar and other glass-related industries. The company also holds and manages properties and car parks. Xinyi Glass serves a broad spectrum of clients, from automotive manufacturers and repair services to construction, engineering, and various wholesale and distribution businesses within the glass and related industries. The company boasts a significant global presence, distributing its products across approximately 140 countries and regions worldwide, including mainland China, Hong Kong, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and numerous markets throughout Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas. Established in 1988, Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.

SJM Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily involved in the ownership, development, and operation of casinos and their related facilities. Its business footprint spans Macau, Hong Kong, and various international markets. The company's operations are divided into two main segments: Gaming Operations, and Hotel, Catering, Retail and Leasing. Within the Gaming Operations segment, activities encompass high-stakes (VIP) gaming, mass-market table games, slot machines, and various other gambling ventures. The Hotel, Catering, Retail and Leasing segment focuses on managing hotels, providing food and beverage services, conducting retail sales, and handling property leasing, along with related services. Beyond these core areas, SJM Holdings also delivers a comprehensive suite of support services. These include marketing and promotional efforts, property development, casino operations management, specialized dredging, gaming promotion, human resources, project management, treasury functions, and broader hospitality provisions. Established in 2006, the company maintains its headquarters in Central, Hong Kong. SJM Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sociedade de Turismo e Diversões de Macau, S.A.

Operating as an investment holding firm, Zhongsheng Group Holdings Limited primarily engages in the retail and servicing of motor vehicles. The company operates an extensive network of 4S dealerships, representing a broad spectrum of automotive brands. This encompasses luxury marques such as Mercedes-Benz, Lexus, Audi, Jaguar, Land Rover, Porsche, and Volvo, as well as popular mid-to-high-end brands including Toyota and Nissan. Beyond vehicle sales, the group provides a full range of after-market services, offering spare parts, vehicle accessories, repair and maintenance work, detailing services, and various other car-related products. As of December 31, 2021, Zhongsheng Group managed 412 automobile dealerships across the People's Republic of China, with 254 dedicated to luxury brands and 158 to mid-to-high-end brands. These operations reached approximately 110 cities within 25 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. Founded in 1998, Zhongsheng Group Holdings Limited maintains its corporate headquarters in Dalian, People's Republic of China.

Huaneng Power International, Inc., along with its affiliated entities, primarily generates and distributes electricity to regional and provincial grid companies both within the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company's core operations involve the conceptualization, construction, management, and ongoing operation of power generation facilities and related infrastructure. It leverages a diverse array of energy sources for electricity production, including gas turbines, hydroelectric systems, wind power, solar photovoltaics, coal-fired plants, and biomass. Beyond its primary function, Huaneng Power International offers a comprehensive suite of ancillary services. These include the development and construction of solar power projects, the sale of power generation by-products such as coal ash and lime, and the trade of raw and processed coal. The company is also a provider of thermal heating, steam, hot water, and desalinated water services, alongside offering broader thermal and cold energy solutions. Its extensive infrastructure activities encompass port operations, cargo handling, storage, logistics, as well as the establishment and upkeep of electricity distribution and heating pipeline networks. Furthermore, the company undertakes power equipment repair and maintenance, plumbing services, energy engineering construction, and various transportation services. Its expertise extends to environmental engineering, industrial water and waste management, and the provision of information technology and management consulting. As of December 31, 2021, the company reported a total controlled generating capacity of 118,695 megawatts, with an equity-based installed capacity amounting to 103,875 megawatts. Huaneng Power International, Inc. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China.

China Suntien Green Energy Corp., Ltd. engages in the natural gas sales business and wind power generation business. It provides gas transmission, gas distribution, gas system management, gas network maintenance, and other services. The company was founded on February 9, 2010 and is headquartered in Shijiazhuang, China.
long_name: China Suntien Green Energy Corporation Limited

business_summary: Lenovo Group Limited, an investment holding company, develops, manufactures, and markets technology products and services. It operates through Intelligent Devices Group, Infrastructure Solutions Group, and Solutions and Services Group segments. The company offers commercial and consumer personal computers, servers and workstations, and smartphones, as well as laptops, desktops, tablets, monitors, and accessories and software. It also provides consulting, deployment, managed, support, and security services. In addition, the company manufactures and distributes IT products, computers, computer hardware, and peripheral equipment; and offers IT, business planning, management, supply chain, finance and accounting, administration support, procurement agency, data management, intellectual property, and investment management services.
