Additionally, NS Solutions is involved in the creation, manufacturing, and sale of software and hardware products, alongside offering IT outsourcing solutions. Its service portfolio further extends to data center and cloud computing provisions, specialized solutions such as ERP, management visualization, system integration and workflow management, and tools for production and sales control. The company also furnishes essential support for IT infrastructure and international business expansion. NS Solutions serves a broad spectrum of sectors, including manufacturing, retail, distribution, transportation, finance, telecommunications, and government entities.

Yageo Corporation, established in 1977 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a global manufacturer and supplier of passive electronic components with a significant market presence across China, Europe, the United States, and the broader Asian region. The company's comprehensive product lineup includes a diverse array of chip resistors, such as specialized types for automotive use, current sensing, anti-sulfuration, thin and thick film precision, high voltage, and general applications, alongside array/network, surge, and lead-free variants. Yageo also provides various multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs) catering to general purpose, automotive, high-frequency, soft termination, miniaturization, array, and low inductance requirements. Its extensive portfolio further encompasses numerous through-hole resistors, including carbon film, metal film, MELF, metal glazed film, metal oxide film, zero and low ohmic types, jumper wires, cement, aluminum-housed, and wire-wound resistors. For wireless communication, the company offers antennas, LTCC filters, and X2Y components. Additionally, Yageo supplies different electrolytic capacitors, such as screw terminal, surface mount, snap-in, and radial options, along with a selection of inductors and coils like chip beads, multilayer and wire-wound chip inductors, and power inductors. The company is also a key provider of circuit protection solutions, addressing both overvoltage (e.g., TVS, MOV, GDT, ESD) and overcurrent (e.g., PPTC, NTC) scenarios. Beyond manufacturing, Yageo offers value-added logistics and electronic data interchange services. These essential components are critical for a vast range of modern applications, including aerospace, automotive systems, 5G and telecommunications, industrial equipment, medical devices, IoT, power management, green energy initiatives, and computer peripherals. Yageo serves a broad customer base, including electronic manufacturing services (EMS), original design manufacturers (ODM), original equipment manufacturers (OEM), and distributors.

Tohokushinsha Film Corporation functions as a multifaceted Japanese media enterprise, involved in the creation of a diverse array of entertainment and commercial content. This includes the development and production of television programs, feature films, drama series, animated productions, video games, web-based and digital content, as well as corporate, event, and television commercial videos. Beyond content generation, the company provides a suite of media services such as commercial and promotion planning, broadcasting, streaming, content localization, and intellectual property licensing and merchandising. Its operations also extend to various other ventures, including the sale of video equipment, the import of interior fabrics, the management of gourmet supermarkets, sake production, and the training and representation of voice actors and screen translators. The company was established in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) specializes in the comprehensive production cycle of integrated circuits and various semiconductor devices, including their fabrication, assembly, rigorous testing, and worldwide distribution. The company's global reach extends significantly across Taiwan, mainland China, Japan, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Utilizing advanced complementary metal oxide silicon (CMOS) wafer fabrication techniques, TSMC engineers a diverse portfolio of semiconductors, encompassing logic, mixed-signal, radio frequency, and embedded memory solutions. Beyond manufacturing, they also offer extensive client support, dedicated account management, and specialized engineering expertise, in addition to producing critical masks. Their innovative components are fundamental to a wide range of applications, including mobile communications, high-performance computing systems, automotive electronics, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things (IoT) sector. Founded in 1987, the enterprise is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

Weichai Power Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of diesel engines, vehicles, and a wide array of automotive components. The company organizes its extensive operations across three key segments: Engines, Automobiles and Automobile Components, and Intelligent Logistics. Its comprehensive business scope covers the full lifecycle — from design and development to manufacturing, sales, repair, and international trade — for a variety of products. These include engines and their auxiliary systems, automobile axles and components, gearboxes, hydraulic pumps, motors, and valves, as well as gears, gear transmission devices, and casting products for hydraulic components. Beyond these, Weichai Power also provides internal combustion engines, energy powertrain systems, and related ancillary items. Complementing its manufacturing, the company extends its services to technical consultation, technical support, property leasing, and business management. It also supplies steel, forklift trucks, and advanced warehousing technology and supply chain solutions. The company's prominent brands include Weichai Power Engine, Fast Gear, Hande Axle, Shacman Heavy Truck, and Linder Hydraulics. Founded in 2002, Weichai Power Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Weifang, People's Republic of China.

Pacific Basin Shipping Limited, an investment holding entity, specializes in providing dry bulk shipping solutions worldwide. The company extends its operations to include a range of maritime support services such as shipping consultancy, ocean transportation, crew management, administrative assistance, agency representation, and full ship management. Furthermore, it engages in the ownership and chartering of vessels, as well as the issuance of convertible bonds. As of February 28, 2022, its fleet comprised 130 Handysize and 124 Supramax vessels. Established in 1987, the firm is headquartered in Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong.

Accton Technology Corporation specializes in the innovation, production, and global distribution of advanced network communication solutions. Operating across the United States, Europe, Taiwan, the wider Asian region, and other international markets, the company delivers a comprehensive suite of products. These include complete computer network systems, featuring essential hardware, system and network application software, and dedicated network workstations. Accton's product lineup also encompasses wired and wireless local area network (LAN) devices, such as network switches and wireless base stations, alongside customer premises equipment (CPE). The company is a key provider of optoelectronic communication subsystems, which integrate optical networks, optoelectronic communication modules, and fiber optic repeaters. Its expertise extends to wireless local area networks (WLAN) and wireless user's loop systems. In the realm of the Internet of Things (IoT), Accton offers complete systems, including IoT gateways/controllers, a variety of sensors, applications, and hybrid-cloud servers, complemented by smart network interface cards. Further expanding its portfolio, Accton provides millimeter-wave access points (APs), bridges, and CPE, as well as cutting-edge 5th generation cellular and enterprise small cell base stations. Enterprise-grade Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN) offerings and virtual/universal CPE are also part of their core business. Beyond hardware and systems, Accton offers technical consulting and engineering design services, alongside information software, technology services, e-commerce applications, and advertising services. The company's extensive range also features switching hubs, high-end network switches, and specialized data center switches. Accton delivers tailored solutions such as carrier access, software-defined wide-area networking, IoT integration, campus networking, and cloud data center solutions. Established in 1988, Accton Technology Corporation maintains its headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

Realtek Semiconductor Corp., along with its affiliated entities, is dedicated to the design, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of integrated circuits (ICs) and their accompanying software. Its business reach extends across Taiwan and international markets. The company's diverse product portfolio features a comprehensive array of communication network ICs. These encompass broadband access, gateway, network interface, and high-speed bridge controllers, alongside digital home hub components, PHYceivers, switch controllers, and chips for wireless LANs and DTV demodulation. Realtek also delivers solutions for Bluetooth, GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System), and Internet of Things applications. Furthermore, Realtek supplies integrated circuits tailored for computer peripherals. This category includes audio codecs for both personal computers and general consumer use, card reader solutions, Class-D audio amplifiers, PC camera controllers, Type-C Power Delivery (PD) controllers, and USB hubs. Multimedia ICs represent another significant offering from the company. Beyond its core chip operations, Realtek is involved in the production and installation of computer hardware. The firm conducts both wholesale and retail trade of electronic materials and software, providing related support services. Additionally, it furnishes consulting, information, and technical assistance. Founded in 1987, Realtek Semiconductor Corp. is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

Sunny Optical Technology (Group) Company Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily dedicated to the entire lifecycle of optical and related products, as well as scientific instruments. This encompasses their design, research, development, manufacturing, and sales. The company's offerings are structured into three main divisions: 1. Optical Components: This segment manufactures various types of lenses, including spherical and aspherical glass lenses, along with specialized lens sets for mobile devices, automotive applications, and security surveillance systems. 2. Optoelectronic Products: This division provides camera modules for handsets, vehicle systems, three-dimensional optoelectronic solutions, and other integrated optoelectronic modules. 3. Optical Instruments: Here, the company delivers precision tools such as microscopes and intelligent inspection equipment. Sunny Optical's advanced optoelectronic products are extensively utilized across diverse sectors, including mobile phones, digital cameras, automotive imaging and sensing systems, security surveillance, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR) platforms, and robotics. Their sophisticated functionality stems from an intricate integration of optical, electronic, algorithmic, and mechanical technologies. Beyond its core manufacturing and sales, the company is also involved in the research and development of infrared and semiconductor technologies. Additional operations include the trading of optical instruments and optoelectronic goods, property leasing, technology development and consulting services, financial services, and import/export agency services. The company maintains a significant operational footprint, predominantly in the People's Republic of China, with a broad reach extending throughout the rest of Asia, Europe, North America, and other international markets. Founded in 1984, its corporate headquarters are situated in Yuyao, China.

United Integrated Services Co., Ltd. delivers a wide array of engineering and construction services across Taiwan. The company's expertise includes contracting for water infrastructure, instrumentation control, and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems. They also specialize in the installation of cleanroom facilities and related operations, alongside the design and implementation of engineering toll collection systems and control apparatus for computer rooms. Their offerings extend to engineering services for traffic surveillance and control systems, as well as providing technical advisory services for project planning and design. Furthermore, the company develops and deploys factory computer control monitoring systems and engineering environment monitoring systems. They undertake electrical and mechanical engineering contracts, particularly for power transmission and distribution. United Integrated Services also handles the design, installation, maintenance, and trade of advanced computerized automatic engineering monitoring systems, and imports specialized telecom radio frequency equipment. Additionally, they are involved in contracting for computer and communication system integration projects, and in the manufacturing and commercialization of associated software and hardware.

Doosan Bobcat Inc. designs, manufactures, markets, and distributes compact construction equipment in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Oceania. It offers compact equipment, including compact loaders and excavators, telehandlers, compact tractors, zero-turn mowers, utility products, light compaction, articulating tractors, turf renovation equipment, and attachment products. The company also provides material handling products, such as internal combustion pneumatic and cushion forklifts, high capacity and electric counterbalance forklifts, and warehouse equipment; and portable power products comprising air compressors, generators, light towers, and industrial air products. It sells its products under the Bobcat, Doosan, and Geith brand names. The company serves construction, landscaping, agriculture, grounds maintenance, utility, and mining industries. Doosan Bobcat Inc. was formerly known as Doosan Infracore Bobcat Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Doosan Bobcat Inc. in January 2015. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.

MediaTek Inc., established in Hsinchu, Taiwan, in 1997, is a global leader in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of integrated circuits (ICs). Its comprehensive array of semiconductor solutions caters to multimedia, computer peripheral, consumer electronics, and various other application segments worldwide. The company engineers chipsets for mobile communication devices, tablets, and advanced automotive systems, alongside wireless technologies such as Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. Offerings extend to artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) device System-on-Chips (SoCs), global positioning satellite (GPS) chips, smart home connectivity solutions, and optical storage chipsets for devices like DVD and Blu-ray players. MediaTek also designs digital television controller chips, alongside diverse power management and USB Power Delivery (PD) Type-C controller chips essential for a wide range of electronics. Its extensive wireless communication chipsets are vital components in smartphones, tablets, Chromebooks, and feature phones. NFC (Near Field Communication) and wireless charging solutions are integrated into a broad spectrum of products, including mobile phones, smart wearables, IoT devices, routers, televisions, set-top boxes, gaming consoles, notebooks, and portable navigation systems. The firm also provides digital TV decoder and demodulator chips, which enable the reception and decoding of digital TV signals from satellite, terrestrial, or cable sources, as well as facilitating video-on-demand services via Ethernet and Wi-Fi. Additionally, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) are supplied for both consumer and enterprise electronic applications. Networking solutions include xDSL chipsets for DSL and fiber-optic modems, wired DSL routers, and integrated access device (IAD) gateways. For the automotive sector, MediaTek develops specialized SoCs for eCockpit platforms, telematics, and mmWave radar systems. Beyond hardware, MediaTek delivers a wide range of services, encompassing software and hardware design, development, testing, maintenance, repair, and technological consultation. The company is also involved in the import and export of its products, the sale and licensing of patents and circuit layout rights, and various investment activities. Further services include research, marketing, technology provision, and intellectual property rights management.

ELAN Microelectronics Corporation, a leading semiconductor manufacturer, specializes in the development and sale of advanced human-machine interface (HMI) solutions. These products are designed for a wide range of applications, including notebook PCs, smartphones, tablets, and various consumer electronics, serving markets across Taiwan, Mainland China, Hong Kong, and the United States. The company's offerings prominently feature an array of fingerprint sensors, which encompass biometric smart cards, pad and button modules, keycap-integrated sensors, biometric USB dongles, under-display recognition technology, and sensors incorporating specialized coatings or cover glass. Additionally, ELAN provides facial recognition systems tailored for personal computers and mobile devices. Its product portfolio further extends to microcontrollers, suitable for general computing, touch key functions, PC peripherals, calculators, and telecommunication applications. ELAN also delivers pen and touch input technologies for laptops and mobile devices, alongside integrated pointstick and touchpad solutions. Beyond hardware, the corporation furnishes clients with essential technical support, information services, and comprehensive after-sales assistance. ELAN Microelectronics was founded in 1994 and its corporate headquarters are located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Infomart Corporation operates a specialized online business-to-business (B2B) e-commerce platform designed for the Japanese food sector. Established in 1998, this platform provides a comprehensive suite of services, including vendor-buyer matching, order processing, access to a standards database, streamlined invoicing and quotation tools, contract management, and a dedicated portal for industry news and data.

Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1876, Sapporo Holdings Limited operates as a diversified enterprise with a global presence, focusing on alcoholic beverages, food and soft drinks, restaurant operations, and real estate. The company organizes its business into distinct segments: Alcoholic Beverages, Food & Soft Drinks, and Real Estate. Within its extensive portfolio, Sapporo produces and distributes a wide array of alcoholic products, including beer (marketed under popular brands such as Black label, Yebisu, GOLD STAR, and Mugi to Hop), wine, shochu, and various other spirits. The Food & Soft Drinks division is responsible for an assortment of offerings, ranging from lemon-based flavors, soft drinks, and soups to soybeans, chilled products, ice cream, miso, instant miso soup, and freeze-dried items. This segment also encompasses the import, processing, and sale of spices, herbs, and dehydrated vegetables, in addition to managing factories, vending machines, and a chain of cafés. In the hospitality sector, Sapporo Holdings operated 163 restaurant outlets as of March 31, 2021. Its real estate activities include the development, leasing, rental, and sale of properties, alongside providing utility services. Furthermore, the company offers comprehensive logistics solutions, covering consigned freight forwarding, cargo handling, warehousing, packaging, and distribution services.

Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. is a Japanese conglomerate that globally produces and distributes a wide array of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, along with various food products. The company's business activities are structured across several divisions: Alcohol Beverages, Soft Drinks, Food, Overseas operations, and an "Others" segment. Its alcoholic product range includes imported and non-alcoholic beers, a selection of wines, shochu, whiskey, ready-to-drink options, happoshu, and spirits. For non-alcoholic refreshment, Asahi offers ciders, sparkling waters, coffees, teas, lactic acid drinks, bottled waters, sports drinks, and fruit juices. The food sector encompasses confectionery, health supplements, yeast extracts, infant formula and baby foods, skincare items, and an extensive line of freeze-dried meals such as miso, soups, porridges, and curries. These diverse goods are marketed under numerous well-known brands, including Asahi Super Dry, Mitsuya Cider, Wonda, Calpis, Peroni Nastro Azzurro, and Pilsner Urquell, among many others. In addition to manufacturing, the group operates restaurants and engages in the production of fertilizers, as well as microbiological and biochemical products. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1889 as Asahi Breweries, Ltd., the company officially changed its name to Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. in July 2011.

T.S. Lines Ltd. specializes in providing container shipping and related logistics services. The company manages an extensive shipping network, operating both independently and in partnership with other carriers through arrangements such as joint services, slot exchanges, and slot charters. Founded on March 2, 2001, by Teh Sheng Chen and Chuang Chuang Li Chen, its corporate headquarters are situated in Hong Kong.

Prince Housing & Development Corp. is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily focused on the construction sector. The company's activities encompass the development, leasing, and sale of various property types, including residential units, commercial complexes, and parking facilities such as lots and multi-story towers. Additionally, it creates and manages leisure and recreational destinations, like amusement parks and aquatic centers. Beyond its core construction work, Prince Housing & Development Corp. maintains a diverse portfolio that includes hospitality services (hotels and catering), plywood manufacturing, comprehensive real estate management, property trading and leasing, apartment administration, and utility maintenance for electrical and plumbing systems. The firm also engages in broader investment initiatives and offers security solutions. Founded in 1973, the company's main office is located in Taipei City, Taiwan.

BOC Aviation Limited, along with its affiliated entities, functions worldwide as a company specializing in the operating lease of aircraft. It delivers a comprehensive array of services to airlines and aircraft owners, which include direct operating leases, sale and leaseback arrangements, and the management of third-party assets. The firm also offers aircraft remarketing and technical oversight services to a diverse client base, such as airlines, financial institutions, and other investors. Additionally, BOC Aviation facilitates debt funding and various other financial solutions for airlines and aircraft investors, and is involved in the direct sale of aircraft. As of December 31, 2021, its extensive fleet consisted of 521 aircraft, comprising those it owned, managed, and had on order. Established in 1993, the company maintains its principal office in Singapore and operates as a subsidiary of Sky Splendor Limited.

KRAFTON, Inc. is a global entertainment company primarily engaged in the creation, development, and distribution of video games. The firm's offerings encompass games for personal computers, mobile platforms, and gaming consoles, serving both domestic South Korean and international markets. Established in 2007, the company, originally known as Bluehole Studio Inc., officially adopted the name KRAFTON, Inc. in November 2018. Its corporate headquarters are located in Seongnam, South Korea.

China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides insurance products to in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Life and Health Insurance, Property and Casualty Insurance, Asset Management, and Other Business segments. The company offers life, health, automobile, liability, agricultural, property and casualty, commercial property, and accident insurance products; pension and annuity insurance products; investments with insurance funds, etc.; and reinsurance products. It also provides real estate and property management, consulting, medical and health consulting, insurance agency, fund management, seniors and disabled care, elderly, nursing, real estate development and operation, technical and seniors care consulting, technical, cloud computing, bid data, business, hospital management, and medical services; and senior living property investment, construction, and management services. In addition, the company offers investment management, pension fund and insurance asset management, private equity investment fund management, and non-residential real estate leasing services. China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
long_name: China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd. Class H

business_summary: ORION Corp. operates internationally as a confectionery company, boasting a diverse product portfolio that includes a wide array of sweet treats such as pies, snacks, biscuits, candies, jellies, gums, and chocolates, frequently marketed under the Orion Power brand. The company also provides healthier options like whole wheat biscuits, bars, and beverages through its Dr.You line, alongside gourmet items such as brownies, crackers, cheese chips, and various chocolate products under the Market O brand. Specialized desserts are available under the Chocopie House brand, and ORION also distributes mineral water sourced from Jeju yongamsoo. Beyond its food endeavors, the corporation holds interests in film production and distribution and is the owner of a professional basketball team. Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1956, the company was initially known as Tongyang Confectionery Corporation before officially changing its name to Orion Corporation in 2003.

Cuckoo Homesys Co., Ltd. focuses on the manufacturing, sale, and rental of various home appliances. Their product range, available for both purchase and lease, includes water purifiers, bidets, air purifiers, and water softeners. Established in 2017, the company is based in Siheung, South Korea. It's important to note that Cuckoo Homesys Co., Ltd. has been operating independently from Cuckoo Holdings Co., Ltd. since January 12, 2018.

Greentown Service Group Co. Ltd. offers extensive residential property management services across China, Australia, and Hong Kong. Their primary responsibilities encompass essential tasks such as security, cleaning, landscaping, and general repair and maintenance. The company also operates as a consultant, guiding real estate developers through various phases, from initial project planning and design to construction oversight and marketing strategies. Furthermore, they extend broader management consulting expertise to both developers and other property management companies. For property owners and residents, Greentown provides a diverse range of community-centric offerings, including solutions for everyday living, enhancement of shared communal areas, property asset administration, and cultural and educational programs. Beyond these, the group boasts a comprehensive portfolio of supplementary and specialized services. These include various lifestyle and community support functions like nursery care, recreational activities, and community leasing and sales. They also deliver a wide spectrum of business and management support services, covering hotel management, general business and education consultancy, property management training, financial and information technology outsourcing, supply chain management, education software development, advertising design, equipment maintenance, and wholesale and retail operations. The company additionally manages exhibition and market promotion initiatives. Established in 1998, Greentown Service Group is headquartered in Hangzhou, People's Republic of China.

Shenzhen Inovance Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of industrial automation and control solutions. The company boasts an extensive product portfolio that encompasses various advanced technologies. This includes industrial automation equipment such as AC drives, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine interfaces (HMIs), power automation for computer numerical control (CNC) systems, sensors, industrial internet tools, and specialized drive and control systems. Additionally, Inovance develops motion control components like servo drives, servo motors, and robot motion controllers. Its offerings also extend to powertrain systems for both passenger and commercial vehicles, the manufacturing of industrial robots and their constituent parts, mechanical modules, and comprehensive railway traction and control systems. Beyond its core product lines, Inovance delivers bespoke OEM solutions tailored for numerous sectors. These applications span areas like elevators and escalators, general manufacturing automation, cranes, textile printing and dyeing machinery, rubber and plastics processing equipment, metal product and cable production, various industrial machinery, air compressors, printing and packaging equipment, construction material manufacturing, industrial robotics, and machine tool solutions. The company's expertise further caters to diverse industries including rubber, construction, petroleum and petrochemicals, electric power generation, iron and steel metallurgy, chemicals, municipal utilities, and electric vehicle production. Established in 2003, the company maintains its headquarters in Shenzhen, China.

Tofflon Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd., originally established in 1993 as Shanghai Tofflon Science and Technology Co., Ltd. and headquartered in Shanghai, China, serves as a global purveyor of sophisticated equipment for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors. The company's diverse offerings encompass specialized machinery for injectable drug manufacturing, including automated systems for solution preparation, aseptic filling lines tailored for ampoules, vials, syringes, and powders, along with freeze dryers featuring automatic loading capabilities, barrier systems, and plastic packaging machines. Beyond equipment, Tofflon also supplies active pharmaceutical ingredients and provides essential quality control systems such as visual inspection, leak detection, and integrated combination units. Furthermore, Tofflon is a significant provider of bio-process equipment and comprehensive integrated systems. These solutions cover various stages, from medium and buffer preparation to cell/microbial cultivation, harvesting, diafiltration/ultrafiltration (DF/UF), purification, and final filling processes. The company also offers specialized laboratory services for lyophilization of injectables.
long_name: Tofflon Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd.

business_summary: Sungrow Power Supply Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, research and development of solar photovoltaic (PV) inverters. Its products include PV grid-connected inverters, string inverters, central inverters, energy storage systems, monitoring systems and optional parts. The company was founded by Ren Xian Cao on November 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.

Sinocare Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of rapid diagnosis testing products primarily in the People’s Republic of China. It offers blood glucose and pressure monitors; point of care testing products; digital management tool solutions; non-invasive screening products; and PTS and Trividia products. The company provides its products for the patients with chronic diseases and diabetes, as well as for healthcare professionals. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Changsha, the People’s Republic of China.

Operating both within China and across international markets, Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. conducts comprehensive activities including the research, design, development, production, and sale of advanced intelligent equipment. A core part of its product portfolio comprises specialized motor stator coil winding machinery, which is vital for manufacturing motors utilized in diverse applications such as domestic electrical appliances, various small to medium-sized industrial motors, vehicle alternators, and the propulsion units for new energy automobiles. Furthermore, the company furnishes optical communication transceiver modules to clients in critical sectors like data centers, data transmission, long-haul telecommunications, and wireless network infrastructure. Founded in 1987, the enterprise was formerly known as Shandong Zhongji Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. until its official rebranding to Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. in September 2017. Its main operational base is situated in Longkou, China.

SonoScape Medical Corp. is engaged in the global development and production of medical devices, originating from its base in China. Its comprehensive portfolio includes a diverse range of ultrasound diagnostic systems, encompassing cart-based color Doppler, handheld color Doppler, black and white ultrasound units, and specialized veterinary ultrasound apparatus. The company further provides endoscopy solutions, such as sophisticated image processing equipment, illumination tools, and products tailored for gastroenterological examinations. Beyond its hardware offerings, SonoScape extends crucial support services, including expert technical assistance, component provision, educational programs, system upgrades, and direct field intervention. Established in 2002, SonoScape Medical Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Shenzhen, China.

Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL) is a global enterprise dedicated to the manufacturing and global distribution of advanced battery systems for electric vehicles and energy storage. Their innovative battery solutions are deployed across a broad array of applications. This includes powering various modes of road transport, ranging from passenger cars to heavy-duty trucks, as well as light commercial vehicles such as trucks, minibuses, and minivans utilized for express, supermarket, and fresh food delivery services. Furthermore, CATL's technology is vital for specialized vehicles like electric washing and sweeping machines, garbage trucks, forklifts, and slag trucks. It also extends to two-wheeled vehicles for commuting and deliveries, marine vessel electrification, and other bespoke vehicle solutions. Beyond production, the company is also involved in battery recycling services. CATL maintains a significant strategic partnership with BASF SE. The firm was established in 2011 and its primary corporate headquarters are situated in Ningde, China.

Imeik Technology Development Co.,Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of biomedical materials. The company's diverse product portfolio caters to both the medical aesthetics field and general skincare needs. Within its medical beauty offerings, Imeik provides a range of recognized brands including Moisten Angel, IFRESH, Yimei, Hearty, Bonita Bonita, and Tightly. Additionally, its comprehensive skincare line features hydrating lotions, anti-aging and firming serums, concentrated essence creams, revitalizing facial masks, restorative chitosan B5 sprays, and clarifying and illuminating liquids. Established in 2004, the company's operations are based in Beijing, China.

Asia Vital Components Co., Ltd. (AVC) is a global supplier of sophisticated thermal management solutions. Their extensive portfolio of cooling components includes direct current (DC), electronically commutated (EC), and slim centrifugal fans, in addition to integrated fan arrays. They also provide a variety of heat dissipation devices such as far-end, standard, and compressor radiators, along with heat sinks and advanced heat transfer technologies like heat pipes and vapor chambers. Beyond thermal products, AVC also engages in the design and production of complete personal computer casing systems. The company further supplies camera modules, durable hinges, and responsive touch panel displays. Additionally, AVC manufactures motherboards and provides specialized services in system integration and comprehensive machine cooling programs. These diverse offerings are vital for numerous sectors, finding applications across computing, telecommunications infrastructure, energy systems, automotive, transportation, and various other industrial cooling needs. Founded in 1991, Asia Vital Components Co., Ltd. operates from its headquarters located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

Established in 1997 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, Novatek Microelectronics Corp. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and sale of integrated circuit solutions. The company's comprehensive product line includes display driver ICs, which are crucial components for a vast array of devices such as LCD panels, televisions, personal computers (laptops and desktops), various camera systems, tablets, automotive displays, smartphones, and wearable technology. Additionally, Novatek designs sophisticated System-on-Chips (SoCs) utilized in digital and smart TVs, mobile computing platforms, desktop monitors, handheld devices, tablets, and diverse camera applications, ranging from security and dashcams to automotive backup cameras and advanced safety assistance systems, as well as general multimedia and mobile camera modules. Beyond its core chip manufacturing, Novatek also provides trading and consulting services, supplies electronic spare parts, and offers specialized expertise in the design, development, modification, and testing of multimedia VLSI software. The company's operational reach extends across Taiwan, the broader Asian market, and international territories.

J. Front Retailing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates department stores. The company operates through Department Store Business, Shopping Center (SC) Business, Developer Business, and Payment and Finance Business segments. The Department Store Business segment operates Daimaru and Matsuzakaya stores, as well as sells clothing, miscellaneous goods, household goods, food, etc. The SC Business segment develops, manages, and operates shopping centers. The Developer Business segment develops, manages, and operates interior decorating work of real estate. The Payment and Finance Business segment issues and operates credit cards. The company also engages in the product testing and quality control services; parking lot business; outsourcing of administrative processing and leasing business; information services; prepaid specific trading business; and e-sports team management services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Fujibo Holdings, Inc., a diversified Japanese enterprise founded in 1896 and based in Tokyo, operates across several core sectors. The company manufactures advanced polishing pads, including its POLYPAS series, which are vital for the precision finishing of silicon wafers, a variety of semiconductor materials, metals, and glass. This segment also supplies specialized non-woven fabrics, functional films, and polyester non-wovens. In its chemical division, Fujibo produces fine chemical intermediates that serve as foundational raw materials for pharmaceuticals, agricultural products, electronic components, and various functional chemicals. Additionally, the company contributes to the textile industry by offering a wide array of fiber materials, functional fibers, yarns, and fabrics. Another significant area of its business involves the precision injection molding of components for sophisticated products such as digital cameras and medical equipment.

Teikoku Sen-i Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells disaster prevention products and equipment in Japan. It offers fire hoses and fire-fighting systems; rescue and special purpose vehicles; rescue and search equipment; and anti-CBRNE terrorism and HazMat equipment consisting of detection, decontamination, protection, monitoring, and other equipment. The company also provides firefighting and specialized protective clothing products; industrial rubber goods and tents; and linen yarns, fabrics, and other materials. It sells its products through sales agencies; and its own marketing department that directly promotes business to government organizations. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

C-MER Medical Holdings Limited specializes in offering both medical treatments and therapeutic services for a variety of eye conditions. Its business activities are segmented into two primary areas: the delivery of ophthalmological services and the retail of vision-enhancing products. Established by Shun Chiu Lam on February 1, 2016, the organization's corporate headquarters are situated in Hong Kong.

Seven & i Holdings Co., Ltd. is a multifaceted enterprise engaged in the retail, food service, financial, and information technology sectors, with operations spanning Japan, North America, and various international markets. Its business is structured into seven distinct segments: Domestic Convenience Store operations, Overseas Convenience Store Operations, Superstore Operations, Department Store Operations, Financial Services, Specialty Stores Operations, and Others. The company's domestic convenience store division manages both directly operated corporate stores and franchised outlets. Internationally, its convenience store segment integrates retail services with gasoline sales. The superstore operations focus on providing daily life necessities, such as groceries and other household goods. Department store operations offer a broad array of merchandise. Through its financial services arm, the company delivers banking, leasing, and credit card solutions. Specialty retail stores constitute another operational area. Lastly, the 'Others' segment encompasses real estate and various other ventures. Seven & i Holdings maintains an extensive global presence, operating approximately 22,500 stores in Japan and a substantial 71,800 locations internationally. The company was established in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Teijin Limited, a Japanese conglomerate established in Tokyo in 1918, operates on a global scale across diverse sectors. Its core businesses encompass advanced materials, including fibers, films and sheets, and composites, as well as significant operations in healthcare and information technology. The company's materials division provides a comprehensive range of products such as high-performance aramid, carbon, and oxidized PAN fibers, along with various polyethylene materials. This segment also offers specialized items like polytrimethylene telephthalate products, artificial leather materials, polyester nanofibers, and recycled polyester fibers. Its offerings extend to polycarbonate, high-density polyethylene porous, and microporous films and sheets, in addition to PC and polyphenylene sulfide resins, molded parts, and additives. Teijin is also a specialist in composite materials, notably developing lightweight glass and carbon fiber reinforced solutions designed for the automotive industry. In the healthcare sector, Teijin develops pharmaceuticals aimed at treating bone and joint, respiratory, and cardiovascular and metabolic diseases, among others. Furthermore, it supplies an extensive array of medical devices and services, including home oxygen therapy equipment, non-invasive positive pressure ventilation systems, rehabilitation tools, and devices for sleep-disordered breathing. The company also provides a sonic accelerated fracture healing system, community-based integrated care systems, orthopedic implantable devices, and functional food ingredients. Within its IT operations, Teijin offers innovative solutions such as Recopic, a radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology tailored for efficient inventory management. Beyond its product lines, the company is actively involved in engineering solutions, tackling critical global challenges related to environmental pollution, ensuring energy supply stability, and addressing the impact of an aging workforce population.

Kuraray Co., Ltd. operates internationally, manufacturing and distributing a broad array of products, including various resins, chemicals, fibers, activated carbon, and sophisticated membrane systems. Its Vinyl Acetate division focuses on developing and marketing functional resins and films, notably PVA, PVB, and EVAL. The Isoprene segment is dedicated to the production and sale of SEPTON thermoplastic elastomer, related isoprene products, and GENESTAR. Within the Functional Materials sector, the company develops and supplies methacrylic resin, medical goods, and carbon materials. The Fibers and Textiles division creates and sells synthetic fibers, textiles, CLARINO manmade leather, non-woven fabrics, and similar items. Furthermore, the Trading segment's core activity involves processing and selling synthetic fibers and artificial leathers. Founded in 1926, the company maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

eMemory Technology Inc. is a company dedicated to the research, development, production, and distribution of a range of semiconductor solutions. Their offerings include flash memory integrated circuits (ICs), intellectual property (IP) for embedded flash memory ICs, memory card controllers for input/output, and various products related to memory cards and digital film. Among its portfolio, eMemory provides NeoBit, a versatile programmable logic device. This technology can be seamlessly integrated into a wide array of CMOS processes, encompassing logic, mixed-mode, bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD), analog, radio frequency (RF), and high-voltage (HV) applications. Another key offering is NeoFuse, a compact logic non-volatile storage solution. It serves critical functions such as identity (ID) verification, production record keeping, encryption code storage, and ROM replacement. Additionally, NeoFuse is utilized for analog trimming, function selection, and setting parameters. Its applications extend to various consumer electronics and industrial components, including set-top boxes, digital televisions, CMOS imaging sensors, application and baseband processors, LCD drivers, and power management integrated circuits. eMemory further delivers NeoEE, an embedded memory device based on single-poly technology. This solution finds use in diverse areas, such as storing user preferences in IC cards, housing code within microcontrollers (MCUs) and RFICs, configuring NFC controllers, acting as fuse devices in memory redundancy architectures, and performing parameter trimming for analog, RF, HV, and BCD circuits. The company also offers NeoMTP, another single-poly embedded memory technology tailored for applications like USB Type-C interfaces, wireless chargers, touch panels, P-Gamma adjustments, and microcontrollers, among others. EcoBit is presented as an embedded logic multiple-time programmable solution. It is ideal for use in passive RFID tags, low-power sensors, battery-efficient mobile ICs, and various other Internet of Things (IoT) chips. Beyond these, eMemory's portfolio includes NeoPUF, a hardware security technology device designed for Internet of Things (IoT) applications, along with related PUF-based solutions. They also provide ReRAM, an embedded memory combining EEPROM and flash capabilities. The Green Platform is offered for storing code in microcontrollers or speech integrated circuits, while MagnaChip EEPROM, an IP block, serves for code storage in microcontrollers and RFICs, as well as parameter trimming in analog, RF, and high-voltage circuits. eMemory's client base spans semiconductor foundries, integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), and fabless design houses, serving both domestic Taiwanese and international markets. Established in 2000, eMemory Technology Inc. maintains its headquarters in Jhubei City, Taiwan.

Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the retail of pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and daily good products in Japan. The company offers vitamin and diet supplements; and first aid and health care supplies. It also offers facial cleanser, body soap, shampoo, and toothpaste, etc. In addition, the company provides baby products, such as diapers, nursing care, sanitary products, detergent, and household products, as well as clothing products, such as socks, underwear, and home appliances.
long_name: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd.

business_summary: KOMATSU MATERE Co., Ltd. operates as a global producer and distributor of a diverse range of textiles, serving both domestic and international markets. The company's portfolio encompasses fashion and high-performance technical fabrics, environmentally friendly architectural materials, and specialized product dyeing services. A notable innovation is its production of CABKOMA, an advanced thermoplastic carbon fiber composite. These materials are extensively utilized across numerous sectors. In the apparel industry, they are incorporated into a wide variety of clothing items, such as coats, jackets, shirts, blouses, T-shirts, dresses, skirts, trousers, and formal wear. For active lifestyles, KOMATSU MATERE's textiles are vital for outdoor clothing and footwear, specialized gear for skiing and snowboarding, warm-up garments, training wear, sauna suits, golf attire, climbing apparel, swimwear, fishing and marine wear, and riders' outfits. Beyond garments, the company's fabrics also find use in accessories like gloves, bags, shoes, hats, and headphone covers, as well as nonflammable garments, barber cloths, pouches, and room partitions. Their diverse product offerings further extend to healthcare and hygiene applications, including bed covers for nursing care, adult diapers, infant sheets, corsets, and adhesive plasters. Within the electronics field, KOMATSU MATERE supplies materials for electromagnetic shielding, wave absorption, and organic EL sealing. For the automotive sector, their products enhance car seats, floor mats, and ceiling linings. Furthermore, they contribute to home furnishings through bedding, curtains, sofa and chair upholstery, cushions, and wallpaper. The company's commitment to sustainability is evident in its ecological products, which include greening adjuvants, ceramic solutions for roof and wall greenery, and water purification agents. Beyond manufacturing fabrics, KOMATSU MATERE is also involved in the research, development, and production of resins and various chemicals. The firm offers comprehensive construction services, encompassing design, execution, and project management. It also specializes in creating interior materials for automobiles and unique industrial-grade materials. The company's processing capabilities include dyeing polyester and nylon textiles, manufacturing composite membrane fabrics, and applying specialized fabric coatings. Additionally, it operates storage facilities for a range of woven, knitted, and raw fabrics, as well as finished goods, and provides associated distribution services. Established in 1943, the company, originally known as KOMATSU SEIREN Co.,Ltd., adopted its current identity, KOMATSU MATERE Co., Ltd., in October 2018. Its corporate headquarters are located in Nomi, Japan.

Wacoal Holdings Corp. specializes in the design, production, and distribution of a wide array of products, including lingerie, innerwear, outer garments, athletic wear, and various other textile items and fashion accessories. Its market presence spans across Japan, Asia, Oceania, the Americas, and Europe. The company's operations are structured into four distinct segments: Wacoal Business (Domestic), Wacoal Business (Overseas), Peach John Business, and Other Businesses. Wacoal provides women's essential undergarments, such as brassieres and girdles, alongside lingerie like slips, bra-slips, and women's briefs. Furthermore, it manufactures nightwear, children's underwear, hosiery, and a host of other apparel and fabric goods. Beyond its primary textile endeavors, the company also manages restaurant operations, engages in cultural and service-related activities, undertakes store construction and interior design projects, and produces and sells mannequins. Established in 1946, Wacoal Holdings Corp. maintains its headquarters in Kyoto, Japan.

Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd., along with its subsidiaries, stands as a prominent global supplier of safety glass and various accessories for the transportation industry, serving both Chinese and international markets. The company's activities span the entire product lifecycle, from design and manufacturing to sales and after-sales service, covering automotive-grade float glass, vehicle glass, and locomotive glass. It also provides automotive accessories such as luggage racks and vehicle window trims, complemented by relevant support services. Fuyao's innovative glass portfolio includes specialized types like head-up display, semi-tempered laminated, acoustic, heating, hydrophobic, dimming, antenna-integrated, heat-insulating, lightweight, and ambient glasses. Beyond glass, the company offers photovoltaic and panoramic sunroofs, exterior decorative components, flush styling windows, and comprehensive encapsulated and sliding window assemblies. Founded in 1987 as Fujian Yaohua Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd., the company officially became Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd. in June 1992, maintaining its headquarters in Fuqing, China.
long_name: Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd.

business_summary: Operating primarily within India, 360 One Wam Limited specializes in comprehensive wealth and asset management services. The firm conducts its business through two distinct divisions: Wealth Management and Asset Management. Its wealth management arm delivers a wide array of services, encompassing financial product distribution, expert advisory, equity and debt brokerage, estate planning, financial product oversight, various lending options, and diverse investment solutions. Additionally, its asset management segment provides solutions such as mutual funds, alternative investment vehicles, customized portfolio management, and related support services. The company serves a distinguished clientele, including high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and institutional investors. Established in 2008 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, the company officially rebranded to 360 One Wam Limited in January 2023, having previously been known as IIFL Wealth Management Limited.

Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Company Limited, encompassing its various affiliates, specializes in the production, distribution, and direct sale of traditional Chinese medicine and wellness items, catering to both corporate distributors and individual consumers. Its operations are geographically segmented across Hong Kong, Mainland China, and international markets. Additionally, the company provides traditional Chinese medical consultations and therapeutic services. The firm maintains a network of 23 retail stores throughout Hong Kong, complemented by 46 international outlets located across Asia, Oceania, North America, and Europe. All its offerings are sold under the well-recognized Tong Ren Tang brand. Established in 1669, the company's main office is situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
long_name: Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Company Limited

business_summary: TIS Inc. provides information technology (IT) services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Offering Service Business, Business Process Management, Financial IT Business, Industrial IT Business, and Wide-area IT Solutions segments. The Offering Service Business segment provides knowledge-intensive IT services, including digital marketing, healthcare, and business management information. The Business Process Management segment offers outsourcing, contact center, and system configuration services, as well as DX support paralleling use of IT solutions. The Financial IT Business segment supports business progress using expert business and operating know-how to the finance industry. The Industrial IT Business segment provides services for client’s operations, including projects for members of energy, and processing- and assembly-based manufacturing and engineering sectors, as well as ERP consulting and modernization services to clients. The Wide-area IT Solutions segment offers IT professional services and collects and develops this know-how as the source of solutions to support efforts to address issues and promote business activities. The company is also involved in the provision of consulting services related to IT management; development of IT systems; and development and maintenance of systems using business packages to address client-side management and business issues, as well as offers on-demand IT resources using SaaS and other categories of cloud computing, including system operation through company-run data centers. In addition, it engages in the sale and maintenance of hardware, such as servers and network equipment, and software. It serves clients in the credit card, banking, insurance and other financial, manufacturing, distribution, service, public, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as IT Holdings Corporation and changed its name to TIS Inc. in July 2016. TIS Inc. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

China Yongda Automobiles Services Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a passenger vehicle retailer and service provider for luxury and ultra-luxury brands in the People’s Republic of China. It operates through Passenger Vehicle Sales and Services; and Automobile Operating Lease Services segments. The company offers automobiles; and after-sales, automobile operating lease, and repair and maintenance services. It also distributes automobile insurance and financial products. In addition, the company provides pre-owned vehicles and automobile rental services, as well as offers services through its 4S dealerships, including sales, spare parts, service, and survey. China Yongda Automobiles Services Holdings Limited was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
long_name: China Yongda Automobiles Services Holdings Limited

business_summary: Fraser & Neave Holdings Bhd functions as an investment entity with core activities focused on manufacturing and distributing a diverse array of soft drinks, dairy products, and various food items. Its commercial footprint spans across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, China, and other international regions. The company manages its operations through distinct segments, namely Food & Beverages Malaysia, Food & Beverages Thailand, Property, and an 'Others' division. Its extensive product line encompasses numerous dairy options, including sweetened condensed, evaporated, liquid, pasteurized, UHT, canned, flavored, and sterilized milk, alongside a range of juice products, isotonic and carbonated beverages, teas, and different types of water such as mineral, sparkling, and drinking water. Prominent beverage brands in its portfolio include 100PLUS, F&N Fun Flavours, F&N SEASONS, F&N ICE MOUNTAIN, BORNEO, OYOSHI, est Cola, and Ranger. Dairy offerings are marketed under names like F&N, TEAPOT, Gold Coin, Carnation, Ideal, Cap Junjung, F&N Magnolia, FARMHOUSE, F&N Fruit Tree Fresh, Sunkist, and Bear. The company also offers ketupat and sauces through its NONA brand. Beyond production, the firm is involved in distributing its soft drink and dairy lines, renting out dispensers, providing management services encompassing financial, treasury, and property management, and engaging in property development and investment ventures. Founded in 1883 and based in Shah Alam, Malaysia, Fraser & Neave Holdings Bhd is a subsidiary of Fraser and Neave, Limited.

Meituan manages a comprehensive online platform that facilitates a diverse range of services. Its operations are organized into three principal segments: Food Delivery; In-store, Hotel & Travel; and New Initiatives and Others. The Food Delivery division enables customers to conveniently order prepared meals from numerous vendors. Meanwhile, the In-store, Hotel & Travel segment allows patrons to acquire local consumer services from various in-store businesses or to book reservations for hotels and tourist attractions. The New Initiatives and Others division covers sales from its B2B food distribution and Meituan grocery services, alongside an assortment of other ventures such as Meituan Instashopping, community e-commerce, shared bicycles and electric mopeds, and micro-lending facilities. Established in 2003, Meituan is headquartered in Beijing, China. The company rebranded to its current name, Meituan, in October 2020, having previously operated as Meituan Dianping.

ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd., established in 1984 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, operates as a prominent global provider of semiconductor packaging, testing, and electronic manufacturing services. The company serves clients across the United States, Taiwan, the wider Asian region, Europe, and other international markets. Its extensive service portfolio includes a broad array of packaging solutions, from conventional options like various BGA, CSP, QFP, and QFN packages, to advanced techniques such as flip chip BGA, fan-out wafer-level packaging, and 2.5D silicon interposer technology. ASE also specializes in stacked die solutions, copper and silver wire bonding, the development of system-in-package (SiP) products and modules, and the provision of interconnect materials, including the assembly of automotive electronic components. Its comprehensive testing capabilities span front-end engineering, wafer probing, and final testing for diverse devices including logic, mixed-signal, RF modules, SiP, MEMS, and discrete components. Beyond its core semiconductor operations, the company is involved in a variety of other ventures, such as real estate development and management, substrate production, information software, equipment leasing, investment advisory, warehousing management, and the processing and trade of computer, communication peripherals, and electronic components.

DL E&C Co., Ltd. is a global construction firm specializing in comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions. The company executes diverse projects across several key areas: industrial plant works, including refinery, gas, petrochemical, energy, and environmental facilities; civil engineering infrastructure like roads, bridges, ports, water resources, railroads, and tunnels; commercial and institutional building construction such as offices, cultural venues, sports complexes, hotels, resorts, educational and healthcare facilities, and logistics centers; and housing developments encompassing apartments, mixed-use residential/commercial properties, and office-hotel accommodations. Established in 1939, its headquarters are located in Seoul, South Korea.

Pharmaron Beijing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmaceutical research and development service platform in North America, Europe, the Mainland China, Asia, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Laboratory Services; Chemical and Formulation Process Development and Manufacturing Services; Clinical Research Services; Macromolecule and Cell and Gene Therapy Services; and Others. The company offers laboratory chemistry and biological science services, including small molecule chemical drugs, oligonucleotides, peptides, antibodies, antimicrobial agents, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), and cell and gene therapy products; small molecule CDMO services, such as API process development and production, material science and preformulation, formulation development, and analytical development. It also provides clinical research services; macromolecular and cell and gene therapy services comprising drug discovery, development and production services, cell and gene therapy laboratory services, and gene therapy drug development and production services. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of technology development, technology transfer, technical consultation, technical services, and technical training; import and export of goods and technologies. Pharmaron Beijing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

GungHo Online Entertainment, Inc. engages in the planning, development, operation and distribution of smartphone applications and online computer games and also engages in the planning, development and sale of console games. The users purchase items that can be used in-game, and collect usage fees through credit card payments, prepaid card payments, or payment through mobile phone carriers through content distribution companies. The company was founded on July 1, 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

LX Holdings Corp. is a diversified South Korean conglomerate that, through its various subsidiaries, engages in a broad spectrum of industries. Its operations span energy, palm oil production, living resources, logistics, living spaces, and advanced materials and solutions. Within the energy sector, the company is involved in electricity generation, utilizing both combined heat and power and hydroelectric facilities, as well as coal mining and supply. It also produces crude palm oil. Its living resources segment provides plastic resins and chemical products, alongside medical equipment such as COVID-19 test kits and diagnostic services. The logistics division offers comprehensive supply chain solutions, including vendor inventory management, global freight forwarding (sea and air), warehousing, distribution, and express/e-commerce delivery. In the living space domain, LX Holdings manufactures automotive fabrics, standard and lightweight components, and decorative films for furniture, windows, home appliances, buildings, and advertising. This segment also produces plastic and aluminum windows and doors, functional glass, and interior finishing materials like flooring, wall coverings, insulation, engineered stone, and solid surfaces. Furthermore, the company is a key player in advanced materials and components. It supplies LCD/OLED displays and related components for televisions, as well as displays for smartphones, smartwatches, and augmented/virtual reality devices. Its offerings extend to driver ICs and chips for automotive infotainment systems, microcontrollers (MCUs) for household appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners, and a variety of monomers and polymers for diverse industrial applications. Founded in 1947, LX Holdings Corp. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, is a leading provider in the railway transportation sector, engaging in the comprehensive research, development, design, manufacturing, and sale of equipment, in addition to offering related services. The company primarily serves markets in Mainland China and internationally. Its extensive product range features crucial components such as traction converter systems for rail vehicles, railway engineering machinery, and communication signal systems. The offerings also include propulsion and control mechanisms for both trains and electric vehicles, advanced signaling solutions, diverse power supply technologies, platform screen doors, and specialized rail maintenance vehicles. Additionally, the company develops marine engineering apparatus and a broad spectrum of component products, including semiconductors, resistors, reactors, radiators, sensors, power capacitors, and heatsinks. Its contributions to rolling stock and railways encompass systems for EMUs, locomotives, and mass transit. For the energy and industrial fields, they provide marine engineering solutions, electric vehicle systems, various inverter and converter systems, and machinery for railway maintenance and construction. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Wanchai, Hong Kong, the company was formerly known as Zhuzhou CSR Times Electric Co., Ltd. before its rebranding in March 2016. It operates as a subsidiary of CRRC Zhuzhou Institute Co., Ltd.
long_name: Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd.

business_summary: Alongside its subsidiaries, China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive range of banking and financial services. Its operations are structured into Wholesale Finance, Retail Finance, and Other Business segments. Customers can access a variety of account types, including checking, savings, time deposits, call accounts, notice accounts, and Renminbi accounts. The bank's extensive lending portfolio encompasses personal loans for housing, vehicles, consumption, commercial real estate, education abroad, and micro-businesses, as well as equipment and various guarantee-backed mortgages. For corporate clients, it provides financing for working capital, fixed assets, vessel purchases, bank acceptances, and discounts. Beyond traditional banking, its offerings extend to credit cards, insurance, and open-ended funds. It also facilitates commercial bill transactions (discounting, guarantees, redemption) and delivers comprehensive financial advisory services, including debt and equity financing underwriting, merger and acquisition financing, and assistance with enterprise listings. Further services include forfeiting, risk participation, escrow, cross-border RMB clearing, and interbank operations. The bank also specializes in risk and financial management, international factoring, trade finance, and both cross-border RMB and overseas financing solutions. Additional specialized services cover financial leasing and guarantees, investment and wealth management, forex and gold trading (including options and express trading), international, offshore, and private banking, as well as custody, pension, and electronic banking services. As of December 31, 2021, its extensive domestic network in Mainland China comprised 143 branches, 1,770 sub-branches, a branch-level operation center, 2,812 self-service centers, 6,592 self-service machines, a representative office, and 14,746 visual counters. Globally, the bank maintains a presence in key financial hubs such as Hong Kong, New York, London, Singapore, Luxembourg, Sydney, and Taipei. Established in 1987, China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd. has its headquarters in Shenzhen, China.

Oriental Holdings Berhad, an investment holding firm founded in 1963 and based in Penang, Malaysia, operates a diverse portfolio of businesses across several key sectors internationally. Its Automotive and Related Products division is involved in the retail and distribution of motor vehicles, the production of engines, seats, and other vehicle components, and the trading of spare parts and accessories. The Plastic Products segment specializes in the manufacturing, assembly, and distribution of plastic components, alongside producing technical and industrial plastic goods and various plastic articles. Through its Hotels and Resorts segment, the company manages and operates a collection of hotels. Its Investment Holding activities encompass investments in shares and bonds, property rentals, and company leasing. The Plantation segment is dedicated to the cultivation of oil palms. Within Investment Properties and Trading of Building Material Products, the company undertakes property development, manufactures wire nettings, meshes, barbed wires, nails, and concrete products, and distributes cement. In the Healthcare sector, Oriental Holdings manages a medical center, a nursing college, and an integrated lifestyle retail pharmacy. Beyond these core operations, the company provides a range of additional services, including money lending and leasing, management, marketing, advertising, central reservation services, land reclamation, and insurance. It also produces steel wires, leases parking facilities, plant, and equipment, manufactures polypropylene compounds, offers after-sales support, deals in used motor vehicles, rents and leases vehicles, designs and sells prototype plastic models, offers consultancy and employment services, and grants loans. The company maintains a significant global presence, with operations spanning Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, the United Kingdom, and other international markets.

SK Square Co., Ltd., a South Korean entity, serves as an investment vehicle concentrating on semiconductor and information and communication technologies. The company is actively involved in the production and distribution of both memory and system semiconductors. Beyond hardware, its expansive portfolio encompasses a lifecare platform, designed to enhance quality of life through cyber and physical security, security convergence, and comprehensive safety and care solutions. In the digital realm, SK Square operates online retail portals; offers the T map mobile navigation service alongside T map taxi and designated driver platforms; delivers N-screen content; provides marketing platforms and business intelligence tools; and supports music streaming and video advertising. Its content distribution arm handles gaming and mobile applications, narrative content, and various music and digital media. Further technological offerings include audio players, AI-powered speakers, media representation services, and network infrastructure platforms, alongside specialized rapid analysis of minimal quantity samples. For businesses, the company extends its expertise to logistics Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), comprehensive office space management and shared office solutions, and cutting-edge cryptocurrency services. The firm maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.

Kanto Denka Kogyo Co., Ltd., founded in Tokyo, Japan, in 1938, is an international manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of chemical products, segmented into two main divisions: Fundamental Chemicals and Fine Chemicals. The Fundamental Chemicals division produces inorganic compounds like caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, and aluminum chloride, which are essential for pulp and paper production, soap and detergent manufacturing, various chemical syntheses, aluminum electrolytic capacitors, and as intermediates for pharmaceuticals and agricultural products. These chemicals also play key roles in water treatment, metal surface preparation, as food additives, sterilizers, bleaching agents, oxidizers, and catalysts for reactions such as Friedel-Crafts. This division also provides organic compounds, including trichloroethylene, perchloroethylene, vinylidene chloride, and cyclohexanol. These are utilized in cleaning metal parts, the synthesis of hydrofluorocarbons, the creation of pharmaceutical and agricultural intermediates, the production of fire-resistant fibers and resins for food packaging, as organic solvents, and in processes like oil refining catalyst regeneration and dry cleaning. The Fine Chemicals division specializes in advanced chemical products. Its ferrochemicals, such as reprographics carriers and magnetite, are crucial for printers, reprographic systems, and environmentally friendly carrier solutions. Additionally, this division manufactures an extensive array of fluorochemicals, encompassing compounds like sulfur hexafluoride, carbon tetrafluoride, trifluoromethane, hexafluoroethane, nitrogen trifluoride, octafluoropropane, tungsten hexafluoride, silicon tetrafluoride, chlorine trifluoride, octafluorocyclobutane, hexafluoro-1,3-butadiene, iodine pentafluoride, and lithium hexafluorophosphate. These high-performance substances are vital for industries involved in semiconductors, liquid crystals and their displays, modern rechargeable batteries, optical fibers, and high-capacity transformers. Kanto Denka Kogyo further supplies lithium tetrafluoroborate and hexafluorophosphate, which are critical components for electrolytes and additives in lithium-ion rechargeable batteries.

Operating across Saudi Arabia, United International Holding Company and its affiliates deliver a suite of digital financial solutions to consumers. These primarily involve personal loans, installment payment options, and credit card facilities. Beyond its consumer-facing activities, the company also offers a variety of support services to financial institutions and other businesses. These B2B offerings include managing processing operations, providing remote technical assistance, ensuring data backup, facilitating card payments, and supplying general technical expertise. Additionally, they handle call center operations, application processing, and comprehensive IT support for their corporate clients. Established in 2021, United International Holding Company is headquartered in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, and functions as a subsidiary of United Electronics Company.

Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation manages a comprehensive gas business with widespread operations across Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. Its activities are organized into five primary divisions: dedicated gas businesses in Japan, the U.S., Europe, and the Asia and Oceania region, alongside a specialized Thermos Business segment. The company supplies a broad range of industrial gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, and acetylene. Furthermore, it offers gases and associated equipment for diverse applications such as welding, cutting, general gas supply, and medical purposes, in addition to air separation and electronic material gases, and installation services for refining and distribution equipment. Beyond its core gas activities, the firm manufactures and distributes household products like stainless-steel vacuum-insulated bottles, tumblers, and fry pans. Founded in Tokyo, Japan, in 1910, the company officially changed its name to Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation in October 2020, having previously been known as Taiyo Nippon Sanso Corporation. It operates as a subsidiary of the Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation.

Stella Chemifa Corporation, a Japanese company established in 1916 and headquartered in Osaka, specializes as a global manufacturer and supplier of inorganic fluorine compounds. Formerly known as Hashimoto Chemical Corporation until its rebranding in 1997, the company offers a comprehensive product portfolio tailored for diverse industrial applications worldwide.
