For the electronics sector, Stella Chemifa provides essential materials such as hydrofluoric acid, buffered hydrofluoric acid, and various etching solutions used in the production of semiconductors, liquid crystal displays, and solar cells. It also supplies a range of metal fluorides, including calcium, aluminum, and lithium fluoride, crucial for optical applications, alongside lithium hexafluorophosphate for battery manufacturing. Its offerings extend to numerous boron trifluoride compounds, serving as vital reactive catalysts across different chemical processes. Additionally, the company produces anhydrous hydrofluoric acid and 55% hydrofluoric acid, utilized in surface treatment and as more environmentally conscious alternatives to CFCs. Stella Chemifa also supports the nuclear energy industry with potassium fluoroborate and boric acid, and provides tin fluoride (II) USP for products requiring GMP compliance. Beyond these specialized compounds, the company's extensive catalog includes a broad array of other fluorochemicals, such as fluorosilicic acid, various fluorosilicates, fluoroboric acid, diverse fluoroborates, and a selection of ammonium, sodium, and potassium fluorides. Complementing its manufacturing operations, Stella Chemifa offers logistics services for the transportation of specialized chemical substances, high-pressure gases, and hazardous materials. Demonstrating a commitment to innovation, the company is also actively involved in the development of Boron Neutron Capture therapy for cancer treatment.

Established in 2005 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation operates globally, offering a vast array of products and specialized services. The company's diverse portfolio includes advanced performance materials, fundamental chemicals, industrial gases, and a comprehensive suite of healthcare solutions. Its performance materials segment features specialty chemicals, functional food ingredients, inorganic compounds, electronic and electrical components, molded and processed goods, various films and sheets, synthetic and carbon fibers, alongside a wide range of equipment and systems. This division also provides materials for industrial applications, construction, civil engineering, and water-related projects, as well as consumer goods for leisure, sports, and everyday use. Within the healthcare sector, the corporation delivers pharmaceuticals, drug formulation substances, and innovative drug discovery solutions. It also supplies diagnostic reagents, medical instruments, and offers extensive support services spanning medical care, nursing assistance, general health support, and clinical examinations. Furthermore, Mitsubishi Chemical Group provides essential industrial materials like basic chemicals, carbon products, synthetic resins, and a variety of industrial gases. Complementing its product offerings, the company's service capabilities are robust, covering engineering, information technology, analysis, inspection, packaging, logistics, surveying, consulting, transportation, and warehousing.

Operating both domestically in Japan and across global markets, KH Neochem Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and distribution of a wide array of petrochemical goods. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses various chemical compounds, including alcohols, esters, ketones, glycol ethers, synthetic fatty acids, aldehydes, diols, hydrocarbons, and functional monomers. Among their offerings are fundamental chemical substances like butyl alcohol, butyl acetate, 2-ethylhexyl alcohol, and isononyl alcohol, which find application in manufacturing paints, inks, thinners, detergents, and serve as raw materials for plasticizers and resins. Furthermore, they supply high-performance materials such as 2-ethylhexanoic acid, isononanoic acid, diacetone acrylamide, and 1,3-butylene glycol, essential for products ranging from lubricants and water-based paints to cosmetics. The company's specialized electronic materials segment includes propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate-P and propylene glycol monomethyl ether-P, vital components for the production of LCD panels and semiconductors. Established in 1966, KH Neochem Co., Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Visional, Inc. is a Japanese enterprise specializing in human resources platform solutions. The company's operations are divided into two primary divisions: HR Technology and Incubation. Within its HR Technology segment, Visional offers various platforms including BizReach for professional talent acquisition, HRMOS as a cloud-based human capital management system, CareerTrek designed for recruiting young professionals, a BizReach campus network for alumni engagement, and BINAR, which focuses on recruiting highly skilled engineers. The Incubation division provides services such as BizReach Succeed, an online platform for M&A matching; Trabox, an online logistics matching service; BizHint, a B2B lead generation tool; and Yamory, a management solution for open-source software vulnerabilities. Visional, Inc. was established in 2020 and has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Sekisui Jushi Corporation, established in Osaka, Japan, in 1941, specializes in materials developed through advanced composite technology, serving diverse markets. Its extensive product portfolio includes items for infrastructure and outdoor environments, such as road marking materials, various types of signage (road signs, general signs, signboards), soundproofing barriers, traffic safety equipment, and electronic systems. They also provide protective and amenity structures like pedestrian and wind/snow fences, car stops, modular sidewalks, balustrades, park materials, shelters, solar lighting, and synthetic wood. For sports facilities, the company offers specialized watering and high-speed drainage systems for artificial turf fields. Within the construction and residential sectors, Sekisui Jushi supplies mesh products (including soundproof versions), vertical lattice fences, bicycle storage solutions, decorative building materials, and handrail systems. Furthermore, their industrial and agricultural division provides a comprehensive range of packaging and binding supplies, such as bands, films, general packing materials, and packing machines, alongside specialized agricultural and facility gardening materials. Other innovative offerings include heat-shielding pavement solutions, systems to prevent concrete delamination, aluminum-resin composite panels, modular assembly pipe systems, digital picking systems, and various automotive components.

Established in Singapore in 1986 as a subsidiary of IPS Technologies Pte. Ltd., IPS Securex Holdings Limited specializes in providing integrated security solutions and products. The company caters to a broad clientele, including commercial enterprises, government bodies, and agencies, operating primarily through its Security Solutions and Maintenance and Leasing segments. IPS Securex addresses a wide array of security requirements, from checkpoint management and law enforcement support to the protection and monitoring of buildings and vital infrastructure. Its homeland security portfolio includes advanced items such as acoustic warning systems, cargo and vehicle scanning technologies, CBRNE (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives) equipment, non-lethal defense mechanisms, and surveillance radar systems. Beyond specialized homeland security, the company offers general security products like access control solutions to prevent unauthorized entry and regulate access to sensitive zones. It also provides video monitoring systems for incident investigation and deterrence, alongside mass notification tools for public announcements and emergency evacuations. Additional enhancements include background music and hearing assistance technology. Complementing its product offerings, IPS Securex delivers extensive services, encompassing customer support, ongoing maintenance, project management, repairs, technical assistance, and training, as well as supplying spare parts. The company maintains a significant international presence, operating across Singapore, the People's Republic of China, South Korea, Japan, and numerous Southeast Asian nations, including Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Brunei, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Timor-Leste.

Established in 1952 and headquartered in Osaka, Japan, Fuso Chemical Co.,Ltd. operates globally, specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse portfolio spanning life science, electronic material, and functional chemical products. The company's life science division offers a comprehensive array of organic acids and their derivatives, including malic, citric, L-tartaric, lactic, and gluconic acids, as well as ascorbic, isoascorbic acids, and amino acid compounds. This segment also provides industrial solutions such as water-soluble rust-preventive agents and grinding/cutting fluids. For the electronics industry, Fuso Chemical produces ultra-high purity colloidal silica and high-purity organosilica sol. Additionally, its functional chemical offerings encompass various oxidation-reduction agents and benzoic acid derivatives.

Adeka Corporation operates across three core business segments: chemicals, food products, and life sciences. Its extensive chemicals division offers a broad portfolio of specialized products. These include polymer additives such as antioxidants, UV stabilizers, nucleating agents, metal deactivators, flame retardants, and various epoxy-based stabilizers and processing aids like plasticizers. Adeka also manufactures light and thermal curing materials, encompassing initiators, polymerizable substances, resist materials, thermal paper components, and essential materials for semiconductors and circuits. The company’s chemical offerings further extend to functional polymers, including water-borne, epoxy, and urethane resins, as well as surface specialties like general-purpose and functional surfactants, cosmetic ingredients, and lubricant additives. Other key chemical products range from propylene glycol, peroxygen chemicals, and metal soaps to inorganic compounds, alongside specific materials for civil engineering and construction, such as joint fillers and sealing compounds. These chemical solutions cater to a diverse array of sectors, including electronics, IT, plastics, rubber, personal care, industrial manufacturing, liquid crystal displays, automotive, building and construction, and the paints, coatings, and adhesives industries. Beyond chemicals, Adeka is a prominent producer of food products, sold under the RISU BRAND. Its culinary offerings feature margarines, shortenings, oils and fats for chocolate, frying oils, whipping and concentrated milk creams, various fillings, frozen pie doughs, mayonnaise, dressings, and functional foods. The corporation also diversifies its operations into other key services. These include plant facility design, construction, and management, alongside facility maintenance, logistics, warehousing, vehicle leasing, real estate, and insurance agency activities. Established in 1917, the company was initially known as Asahi Denka Co., Ltd., before officially changing its name to Adeka Corporation in May 2006. Adeka is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kao Corporation is a multifaceted enterprise engaged in the development and sale of a broad spectrum of products, encompassing cosmetics, skin and hair care items, human health solutions, household cleaning and fabric care goods, and various chemical products. The company's operations are strategically divided into five core business segments: Hygiene and Living Care, Health and Beauty Care, Life Care, Cosmetics, and Chemicals. Within the Hygiene and Living Care segment, Kao provides essentials such as laundry detergents, fabric care products, and a variety of kitchen, paper, and general household cleaning supplies, alongside sanitary napkins and baby diapers. Its Health and Beauty Care division encompasses offerings like skin and hair care formulations, specialized professional hair care lines, bath additives, and both oral hygiene and thermal products. The Life Care segment focuses on delivering health beverages and commercial-grade hygiene solutions. In its Cosmetics Business, the company supplies both advised and self-service cosmetic items. Finally, the Chemical Business segment produces an extensive array of industrial ingredients, including oleochemicals, fat and oil derivatives, surfactants, fragrances, water-reducing admixtures, casting sand binders, plastics additives, process chemicals, toners and toner binders, inkjet ink colorants and inks, fine polishing agents and cleaners, and other specialized materials and process chemicals. Established in 1887, this Tokyo, Japan-headquartered entity initially operated as Kao Soap Co., Ltd., before adopting its current name, Kao Corporation, in 1982.

SOFT99corporation operates globally, manufacturing and distributing a diverse array of specialized chemical products designed for both automotive and household applications, originating from its base in Japan. Its comprehensive automotive catalog addresses various aspects of vehicle care, encompassing exterior body treatments like coatings, waxes, cleaners, shampoos, and washing tools, as well as specific coating and cleaning solutions for external components. For optimal visibility, the company offers glass and mirror treatments, including water repellents, wipers, cleaning agents, and anti-fog formulas. The product line further extends to dedicated care for tires, wheels, seating, and vehicle interiors. Beyond routine upkeep, SOFT99 supplies various paint products, such as brushes and sprays, alongside essential car repair tools like putties, compounds, sandpaper, adhesives, tapes, rust treatments, muffler repair kits, products for rubber and unpainted plastics, radiator and belt care, and general cleaning and degreasing agents. Additionally, the company provides a range of car maintenance and accessory items, such as wiper refills and blades, tire chains, TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitoring System) solutions, engine bay chemicals (e.g., radiator and oil-related products), air fresheners, deodorizers, seat covers, steering wheel covers, and comfort cushions. In the household sector, SOFT99 offers a wide selection of cleaning and repair products suitable for various domestic areas, including kitchens, bathrooms, leather items, and general interiors. This segment also includes specialized coating and cleaning solutions for electronic devices, window cleaning agents, and a broader spectrum of coating, cleaning, repair, and rust removal products. Furthermore, the company caters to eyewear maintenance, providing cleaning and anti-fog solutions for glasses, along with practical rain repellents and other convenient products. SOFT99corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Medley, Inc., a company based in Japan, develops and manages digital platforms for both the recruitment and medical industries. Its operations are structured into three primary segments: HR Platform Business, Medical Platform Business, and New Services. The firm's portfolio of offerings includes JobMedley, a human resources recruitment system specifically for medical, healthcare, and related sectors; CLINICS Telemedicine, a system enabling virtual consultations between patients and healthcare providers; CLINICS, a cloud-based platform for medical facility support; Pharms, which provides support systems for pharmacy front-desk operations; MEDLEY, a service offering medical information to patients; and Kaigo-no Honne, an online portal for searching nursing care facilities. Additionally, Medley, Inc. undertakes proof-of-concept testing for its Pharms solutions. The company was established in 2009 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited is a global biopharmaceutical enterprise engaged in the discovery, development, manufacturing, marketing, and out-licensing of various medical products. The company's operations span Japan, the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Russia, and other regions across Asia and internationally. Takeda concentrates its efforts on key therapeutic areas such as gastroenterology, rare diseases, plasma-derived therapies, oncology, and neuroscience. Its extensive product range includes well-known brands like Entyvio, Takhzyro, Velcade, and Vyvanse. To advance its pipeline and innovation, Takeda actively fosters numerous collaborations, in-licensing agreements, research partnerships, and strategic alliances with a diverse array of organizations, including academic institutions like the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center and biotech firms such as Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc. and Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals Inc. Established in 1781, the company maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Astellas Pharma Inc., a venerable Japanese pharmaceutical enterprise established in 1923 and headquartered in Tokyo, operates globally in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of a diverse range of medications. Its extensive product lineup addresses critical health needs, including various oncology treatments such as XTANDI for prostate cancer, XOSPATA, an FLT3 inhibitor for specific relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia, and PADCEV for advanced urothelial cancer. For urological conditions, Astellas offers Betanis/Myrbetriq/BETMIGA to manage symptoms of overactive bladder, mirabegron for neurogenic detrusor overactivity in children, and Vesicare for OAB. Other notable pharmaceuticals include Eligard for prostate cancer, Harnal/Omnic for benign prostatic hyperplasia, Evrenzo for anemia associated with chronic kidney disease, and the immunosuppressants Prograf/Advagraf/Graceptor/ASTAGRAF, vital for preventing organ transplant rejection. The company also markets Funguard/MYCAMINE, an antifungal agent. Astellas actively fosters innovation through numerous strategic collaborations and partnerships. These include clinical trial agreements with pharmaceutical giants like Merck & Co., Inc. and CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. Demonstrating a broader approach to health, they collaborate with BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment Inc. on developing a smartphone exercise support application. In the realm of scientific discovery, Astellas maintains a research alliance with Harvard University for joint therapeutic and technological advancements. Further research initiatives involve Actinium Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to advance targeted radiotherapies leveraging their Antibody Warhead Enabling platform, an agreement with Zenith Epigenetics Ltd. to evaluate ZEN-3694, and a collaboration with Cytokinetics, Incorporated. A significant strategic alliance and license agreement exist with Minovia Therapeutics Ltd. to research, develop, and commercialize cell therapies for mitochondrial dysfunction.

Eiken Chemical Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer and distributor specializing in clinical diagnostic products and medical equipment. The company excels in developing diagnostic solutions for diverse medical fields, encompassing biochemical analysis, immunology, serology, dry chemical assays, and automated diagnostic systems. A significant offering is the OC-SENSOR, an automated immunochemical fecal test designed to identify gastrointestinal bleeding linked to conditions such as colorectal cancer, polyps, and diverticulitis. Its comprehensive product portfolio further includes real-time turbidimeters, temperature-controlled equipment, various amplification and fluorescence detection reagents for research applications, and general detection kits. Eiken Chemical also produces a variety of microbiology-related products, alongside additional immunological and serological reagents. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1939, the company initially operated as Nihon Eiyokagaku Co., Ltd. until its rebranding to Eiken Chemical Co., Ltd. in 1969.

Nxera Pharma Co., Ltd., established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1990, is a biopharmaceutical enterprise focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of pharmaceutical solutions. The company's operations extend across multiple international markets, including Japan, Switzerland, the United States, Bermuda, and the United Kingdom. Its array of commercially available products encompasses respiratory treatments like Ultibro/Breezhaler and Seebri/Breezhaler for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, as well as Enerzair and Breezhaler to manage asthma. Other marketed therapeutics include ORAVI, a unique formulation addressing oropharyngeal candidiasis, and PIVLAZ, prescribed for cerebral vasospasm. The firm boasts a robust pipeline of investigational medicines, featuring HTL0039732 for immuno-oncology, HTL0048149 for schizophrenia, Daridorexant targeting insomnia, and HTL0016878 for both schizophrenia and other neuropsychiatric conditions. Additional compounds under development include PF-07081532 for Type 2 diabetes mellitus and obesity, PF-07054894 for inflammatory bowel disease, PF-07258669 for anorexia, and PF-06954522 for metabolic disorders. The pipeline also contains NBI-1117569 for various neurological diseases and NBI-1117570 for central nervous system ailments. Furthermore, Nxera Pharma is advancing a GPR35 agonist in the preclinical stage for inflammatory bowel disease and other gastrointestinal conditions, alongside other early-stage drug candidates. The company maintains significant strategic collaborations with industry leaders such as AbbVie, Biohaven, Genentech Inc., GSK, Pfizer Inc., Neurocrine Biosciences Inc., Novartis International AG, and Verily.

Based in Tokyo, Japan, and founded in 1923, KYORIN Holdings, Inc. is a pharmaceutical enterprise engaged in the discovery, development, production, and worldwide distribution of both innovative prescription drugs and generic equivalents. Its diverse therapeutic catalog features medications such as Flutiform for asthma; Desalex, an antiallergic agent; and treatments like Beova, Uritos, and Imidafenacin KYORIN for overactive bladder. The company also offers Lasvic, a quinolone antibacterial; Pentasa for managing ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease; Nasonex and Kipres for allergic rhinitis; and Mucodyne, a mucoregulating compound. Further pharmaceutical products include Montelukast KM, prescribed for bronchial asthma and allergic rhinitis. Beyond drugs, KYORIN Holdings markets specialized items like the GeneSoC real-time PCR system, disinfectant solutions such as Rubysta and Milton, over-the-counter remedies, diagnostic tools, industrial chemicals, and various reagents and intermediates. The company extends its services to include contract drug manufacturing and actively participates in early-stage research, including identifying and assessing candidate compounds, analyzing competitor technologies, and collecting data from clinical trials.

Nippon Paint Holdings Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacture of paints and advanced chemical products. Its extensive paint portfolio encompasses coatings for vehicles, including bumpers and plastic components; architectural paints for homes, commercial buildings, and infrastructure like bridges; and industrial finishes utilized across a variety of products such as construction and farming machinery, exterior building materials, office equipment, and household appliances. The company also produces marine paints, notably fuel-efficient antifouling types, alongside paints for automotive refinishing, DIY projects, and road markings. Beyond paints, Nippon Paint offers sophisticated chemical solutions, including hydrophilic and eco-friendly surface treatment agents, as well as specialized fine products like functional interlayer coatings and display film coatings. With a global footprint, the company operates across Japan, Asia, the Americas, Oceania, and other international markets. Established in 1881, Nippon Paint Holdings is headquartered in Osaka, Japan, and adopted its current name in October 2014, having previously been known as Nippon Paint Co., Ltd.

Kansai Paint Co., Ltd. operates as a worldwide manufacturer and supplier of paints and coatings, with a substantial presence across Japan, India, the broader Asian region, Africa, Europe, and various other international markets. The company's extensive product offerings include aesthetic and protective finishes for both exterior and interior architectural applications, specialized automotive paints for production and repair, and a wide array of industrial coatings. These industrial solutions serve diverse sectors such as construction machinery, commercial vehicles, metal furniture, external building materials, electronics, and even the internal and external coatings for beverage cans. Additionally, Kansai Paint provides resilient marine coatings. Beyond its primary paint operations, the firm is engaged in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of coating application equipment. It also oversees and carries out painting contracts and offers professional color scheme development services. Founded in 1918, Kansai Paint Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Taiyo Holdings Co., Ltd., operating globally through its subsidiaries, primarily focuses on the electronics materials industry. Its extensive product portfolio includes materials for various printed wiring boards: for rigid boards, it provides liquid solder resist, legend ink, plating resist, and etching resist; for PKG boards, both liquid and dry film solder resists are offered; and for flexible printed circuit boards, it supplies liquid and dry film solder resists along with dry film photoimageable coverlay. The company also manufactures build-up materials, FPD materials, anisotropic conductive adhesive, photoimageable interlayer insulating materials, stretchable conductive paste, and photo-imageable white dry film solder products. Beyond its core electronics business, Taiyo Holdings is involved in diverse sectors. It produces and distributes prescription pharmaceuticals, manufactures and markets dyes, pigments, and other chemical products, and operates solar power plants. Additionally, the company provides systems engineering services, develops various systems, and engages in food-related enterprises. Founded in Tokyo, Japan, in 1953, the company was known as Taiyo Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. until its name change to Taiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2010.

Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of a diverse range of coating materials, including organic and inorganic water-based formulations, synthetic resin paints, and inorganic coating and building materials. The company also offers contract services for specialized finishing works. Its operations extend to manufacturing and selling heat insulation, fireproof coatings, and fire-resistant paints, complemented by fireproof insulation contracting and various chemical products. Their comprehensive product portfolio encompasses exterior and interior finishes, top coats, roof and iron paints, specialized flooring coatings, rooftop waterproofing, base preparation materials, and fireproof covering and insulation solutions. Established in 1955 and headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan, the company was initially known as Shikoku Kaken Industry Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name, Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd., in April 1991.

Fuji Media Holdings, Inc., a Japanese conglomerate, operates through numerous subsidiaries with a primary focus on broadcasting. Its business activities are segmented into Media & Content, Urban Development, Hotels & Resorts, and various other operations. The Media & Content division encompasses a broad spectrum of services, including television (both terrestrial and satellite) and radio broadcasting, streaming platform management, content creation, gaming, music production, advertising, publishing, and direct marketing. Within its Urban Development segment, the company is responsible for the construction, leasing, and administration of office buildings, the operation of commercial centers and dining establishments, and the sale and rental of residential apartments. The Hotels & Resorts segment oversees the management of hospitality properties and marine leisure facilities. Additionally, the company's diverse portfolio extends to IT system architecture, human resources solutions, global business expansion, media and lifestyle market intelligence, and the incubation of novel ventures. Founded in 1957 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was previously known as Fuji Television Network, Inc.

BML, Inc. is a Japanese corporation specializing in a comprehensive range of laboratory diagnostics and related services. The company conducts standard analyses such as biochemical and hematological screenings, in addition to advanced specialized tests including radioimmunoassay (RIA), cellular diagnostics, immunology, and DNA analysis. It also provides microbiological assessments for medical and pharmaceutical organizations, along with diagnostic services covering critical areas like oncology, infectious diseases, metabolic disorders (diabetes, hypertension), allergies, and genetic studies. To optimize laboratory operations, BML develops proprietary automation systems, Frontier and Symphony, designed to streamline processes from initial sample sorting and dispensing through to subsequent testing. The firm also supports medical information networking via electronic health records and offers preventative healthcare solutions. BML's extensive service portfolio includes food safety and environmental health. Its food division provides comprehensive hygiene control and processing support, encompassing contractual microbiological testing for raw ingredients, prepared, and processed foods. This extends to environmental hygiene assessments for food facilities and kitchens, general microorganism testing, and the evaluation of genetically modified organisms. Environmental services comprise drinking water and wastewater analysis, occupational health management (measuring airborne substances like ethylene oxide, formaldehyde, organic solvents, and dust), comprehensive indoor environmental monitoring (identifying contaminants and other variables), and biological dioxin surveillance. Moreover, BML performs analyses for residual agricultural chemicals, offers dental diagnostics for caries and periodontal diseases, provides consulting for pharmaceutical product approvals, conducts investigative analyses for drug manufacturers, and performs gene expression analysis, specifically identifying genes linked to infectious disease susceptibility. Founded in 1955, BML, Inc. is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

USS Co., Ltd., alongside its affiliated companies, specializes in the operation and management of used vehicle auction venues across Japan. The company facilitates the sale and distribution of pre-owned automobiles through 19 physical auction locations, in addition to utilizing satellite and online platforms. Beyond its core auction activities, USS offers a variety of services, including heavy vehicle transportation, financial solutions, and export services for second-hand cars. It also engages in the recycling of end-of-life automobiles and other goods, and is involved in the acquisition and sale of both used and accident-damaged vehicles. Furthermore, the company manages a network of used car purchasing centers operating under the 'Rabbit' brand. Originally incorporated in 1969 as Aichi Automobile General Services Co., Ltd., the firm adopted its current name, USS Co., Ltd., in March 1995. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Tokai, Japan.

Operating from its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, OBIC Business Consultants Co., Ltd. has specialized since its establishment in 1980 in creating and distributing business and information technology solutions across the Japanese market. The company's portfolio includes off-the-shelf software applications designed for various business systems, alongside comprehensive services for maintenance and implementation guidance.

Established in Tokyo in 1980, Business Engineering Corporation, formerly Toyo Business Engineering Corporation, specializes in the worldwide planning, development, sale, and leasing of advanced information and communication systems. The company offers a comprehensive suite of software products, including mcframe, a business package designed for managing production, sales, and costs; mcframe GA, an ERP system tailored for Japanese companies expanding globally; mcframe RAKU-PAD, which digitizes handwritten forms for tablet data entry; GLASIAOUS, a global accounting service facilitating international business growth; and Global MES, a multi-site manufacturing execution system. Additionally, their innovative offerings extend to mcframe MOTION Human-Tracking, converting human movements into three-dimensional data; mcframe MOTION VR-learning for immersive training solutions; and mcframe SIGNAL CHAIN, which provides monitoring and analytical capabilities for manufacturing equipment operations and maintenance. Beyond its proprietary software, the company delivers SAP solutions that address a broad range of client business processes, including SCM and BI. Business Engineering also provides expertise in computer network development and offers consulting services for corporate management and IT infrastructure. Its diverse clientele includes industries such as pharmaceuticals, electrical equipment, electronics, oil, chemicals, and machinery, as well as the trading, logistics, information, and service sectors.

ASKA Pharmaceutical Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japanese enterprise that operates through its subsidiaries in three primary areas: pharmaceuticals, animal healthcare, and hormone testing services. The company's pharmaceutical division is dedicated to the research, development, production, and commercialization of medications, with a specific focus on endocrinology, obstetrics and gynecology, and urology. Within its animal health segment, ASKA manufactures, sells, imports, and exports a broad spectrum of veterinary products, such as medicines, medical equipment, animal feed and supplements, laboratory reagents, agricultural chemicals, industrial chemicals, hygiene products, and food items along with their raw materials. Beyond these activities, the company also performs clinical and biological testing and offers medical devices. Founded in 1920, ASKA Pharmaceutical Holdings Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Konica Minolta, Inc. is a global technology company with extensive operations across Japan, the United States, Europe, China, other Asian nations, and broader international markets. The firm operates through several core business divisions: digital workplace solutions, professional printing, healthcare technology, and industrial applications. In its digital workplace and professional printing segments, Konica Minolta is responsible for the design, production, and distribution of multi-functional peripherals, sophisticated digital printing systems, and their accompanying supplies. It also delivers comprehensive IT and printing solutions, along with associated services. Within the healthcare sector, the company provides advanced systems such as digital X-ray diagnostic imaging and diagnostic ultrasound. It further supports the medical field with digitalization, networking capabilities, tailored solutions, and offers specialized genetic diagnostic and drug discovery support services. The industrial portfolio is diverse, encompassing precision measuring instruments, innovative functional film displays, organic light-emitting diode (OLED) lighting products, specialized industrial inkjet printheads, and high-quality lenses for industrial and professional use. Additionally, it offers cutting-edge imaging-IoT and visual solutions. Established in 1873, Konica Minolta, Inc. maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Shiseido Company, Limited is a global manufacturer and distributor of cosmetic products, operating both within Japan and across international markets. Its diverse portfolio includes perfumes, various makeup items, a comprehensive range of skincare and body care essentials, and an array of hair care and styling products. Additionally, it provides professional hair color and perm solutions specifically for salon use. Beyond cosmetics, Shiseido extends its operations into the hospitality sector, encompassing restaurant and food services, as well as retail ventures, and manages a network of beauty salons. The company further demonstrates its commitment to the beauty industry by operating and providing support for SABFA, a renowned training institution for professional hair and makeup artists. Shiseido's offerings are distributed through multiple retail channels, including major department stores, specialized boutiques, and drugstores. Established in 1872, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Milbon Co., Ltd. is a Japanese firm dedicated to the creation, production, and distribution of professional-grade hair care products, primarily targeting the salon industry. Their comprehensive product line for stylists includes a variety of items such as hair colorants, styling solutions, perming agents, shampoos, specialized hair treatments, and medicinal formulations to promote hair growth. The company also offers a selection of skincare and cosmetic products. Although its main operations are within the Japanese domestic market, Milbon additionally exports its goods internationally. The company was founded in 1960 under the name Yutaka Beauty Chemicals Co., Ltd., before adopting its current name, Milbon Co., Ltd., in January 1965. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Tokyo, Japan.

T. Hasegawa Co., Ltd. produces, sells, imports, and exports fragrances, flavors, aromatic chemicals, food additives, and foods in Japan, China, the rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company provides flavors for use in various processed foods, such as beverages and confectionaries; and fragrances for use in fine fragrances, cosmetics, and household items. T. Hasegawa Co., Ltd. was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Parade Technologies, Ltd. operates as a semiconductor company focused solely on design and development, without owning manufacturing facilities. The firm specializes in the research, development, marketing, and sales of integrated circuit (IC) chips. These chips are designed for high-speed data interfaces, touch control, and display processing, serving a wide array of products including personal computers, consumer electronic devices, and display panels. Its comprehensive product offerings include: High-speed interface ICs: Supporting key standards like PCI Express/SATA, USB, DisplayPort, and HDMI, along with various protocol converters. Integrated display and touch system ICs: Such as timing controllers (TCONs) with embedded touch functionality and source drivers, gate level shifters for touch, embedded DisplayPort timing controllers, combined display panel source drivers with touch capabilities, TCONs featuring integrated source drivers, and unified touch and display driver products, alongside DisplayPort controllers for LCD monitors. TrueTouch touchscreen controllers: Dedicated solutions for touch input. Automotive ICs: Integrated circuits specifically engineered for the automotive industry. Parade Technologies maintains an international presence, conducting business in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Japan, and other global regions. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells OTC pharmaceuticals, guasi-drugs, deodorizing air fresheners, and sanitary products in Japan, the United States, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers Ammeltz, an anti-inflammatory pain relief medicine; Dent, an effervescent denture cleaning agent; Ekitai Bluelet Okudake, a toilet bowl cleaner; Naicitol, a Chinese herbal medicine that promotes the breakdown and metabolism of fat; BreathCare, an oral breath freshener capsule; Netsusama sheet, a cooling gel sheet; and deodorizing air fresheners, lens cleaners, and oral hygiene products. It also manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, fragrances, deodorants, cosmetics, health food, synthetic resin processed products, paper products, and hand warmers; and sells daily necessities. In addition, the company engages in transportation, real estate management, advertising planning and production, sales promotion and market research, promotional goods production and sales, and asset management activities, as well as in pharmacy, retail, and cleaning industries. Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells precious metal plating chemicals for electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company provides gold electrolytic plating formulation for semiconductor applications, as well as PWB, connector, contact, and soldering applications; strike gold plating formulation for lead frame applications; flash gold plating formulation for leadframe uses; and palladium electrolytic formulation for connector and lead frame uses. It also offers gold plating formulation for soldering and wire bonding; electroless palladium plating formulation for wire bonding and soldering uses; and electrolytic and electroless silver plating formulations. In addition, the company provides anti bacterial agents for plating tanks and drag-out tanks; and impurity removal resin that removes Cu ions dissolved in Au and palladium plating formulation. Additionally, it offers surface treatment chemicals and stripping agents. Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Dexerials Corporation is a Japanese enterprise that develops and markets a wide array of electronic components, bonding solutions, optical materials, and other specialized products. Its extensive product catalog features anisotropic conductive films, various industrial adhesives, double and single-sided tapes, and thermal management sheets. The company also supplies architectural window films, optical elasticity resins, inorganic wave plates, diverse optical films including inorganic diffusers, polarizers, and anti-reflection films, alongside UV-curable resins tailored for optical disk manufacturing. Furthermore, Dexerials produces surface-mounted fuses, water treatment agents for inorganic effluents, and conductive films essential for solar cell photovoltaic modules. Established in 1962, the company operated under the name Sony Chemical & Information Device Corporation until its rebranding as Dexerials Corporation in September 2012.

Nichireki Co., Ltd., founded in 1943 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of diverse paving materials, primarily serving the Japanese market. The company's main product lines include various asphalt emulsions crucial for both road construction and the recycling of pavement, as well as a selection of modified asphalts. Additionally, Nichireki offers a broad spectrum of construction-related products, such as materials for waterproofing bridges and their decks, sealing cracks, filling potholes, correcting surface irregularities, and enhancing landscapes. Their offerings extend to cement concrete materials, crack repair solutions, pavement mixtures, and various supplementary paving items. Furthermore, the company develops specialized materials for critical infrastructure applications, including airfield aprons, railway tracks (especially for high-speed trains), agricultural water channels, dams, rivers, sewers, reservoirs, and tank base foundations. Nichireki also provides jointing and grouting materials. Beyond product manufacturing, the company offers comprehensive maintenance and management services for roads and paved surfaces.

Bridgestone Corporation, along with its subsidiaries, operates as a global manufacturer and vendor of tires and diverse rubber products. The company's business activities are segmented into two core divisions: Tires and Diversified Products. Under its Tires segment, Bridgestone offers a wide array of tires and inner tubes for an extensive range of vehicles, including passenger automobiles, commercial trucks and buses, heavy construction and mining equipment, industrial and agricultural machinery, aircraft, motorcycles, and scooters. This division also covers automotive components, retreading materials and services, vehicle maintenance and repair, tire raw materials, and other related offerings. The Diversified Products division encompasses vehicle parts, polyurethane foam and associated items, electronic precision components, various industrial materials, civil engineering and construction equipment and supplies, and commercial roofing materials. Additionally, this segment provides sporting goods like golf balls and clubs, bicycles and cycling accessories, as well as financial and other support services. Bridgestone further provides specialized solutions, including maintenance, IT, and sensing technology, to the mining, fleet, and agricultural sectors. The company boasts a significant global presence, with operations spanning Japan, the United States, China, the Asia Pacific, Europe, Russia, the Middle East, Africa, and Oceania. Founded in 1931, Bridgestone Corporation is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Founded in 1901 and based in Tokyo, Japan, FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. is a manufacturer and distributor primarily focused on industrial rubber components throughout the country. The company boasts a diverse portfolio that includes various industrial materials such as pneumatic controllers, anti-vibration mounts, and related peripherals. They also provide printing materials, electrical and electronic equipment, and essential rescue and life-saving gear. Furthermore, FUJIKURA COMPOSITES produces carbon shafts for golf clubs and offers residential systems for managing gas and water. Their product line extends to rubber packings, sealing materials, and admixtures vital for connecting and branching communication cables. Other key offerings include fire prevention sheets and rubber blankets for numerous offset printing applications, including books, magazines, newspapers, and packaging, which are marketed under the Fujikura Graphics brand. The company also supplies audio cone material. Previously known as Fujikura Rubber Ltd., the organization officially changed its name to FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. in April 2019.

Okamoto Industries, Inc. operates globally and domestically from Japan, specializing in the manufacturing and sale of a broad spectrum of industrial and consumer products. Its industrial offerings are extensive, encompassing various plastic films for applications like housing wallpaper, decorative purposes, moldable ABS and acrylic sheets, and synthetic leather for furniture. This division also produces automotive materials, agricultural films, work-related supplies, and food sanitation products such as wrapping films, dehydrant/absorbent sheets, and protective gloves. Furthermore, they supply adhesive tapes, rubber bands, and flexible container bags. For the medical and welfare sectors, products include wound dressings, medical gloves, autoclaves, masks, and other sanitary provisions. Specialized industrial solutions also feature cleanroom gloves, adhesive entrance mats, partition films, and safety footwear. For the consumer market, the company provides a wide assortment of household goods. These range from personal care items like condoms, lubricants, various heating aids (patches, pads, hot water bags), and general health products, to portable sanitary goods and gloves. Household maintenance items include dehumidifiers, pest control solutions, and cleaning agents. Kitchen essentials consist of absorbent/dehydrant sheets, food wrapping films, and cooking sheets. Apparel and footwear options extend to boots, short boots, and safety shoes for work or outdoor activities, alongside rainwear and windbreakers for professional settings. In addition to its manufacturing endeavors, Okamoto Industries is also engaged in the solar power generation business. The company was established in 1934 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Operating in Malaysia, AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad specializes in providing a diverse array of financial solutions to individual consumers. Its primary services include Sharia-compliant easy payment and personal financing schemes, in addition to issuing payment cards under both Visa and MasterCard brands. The company's extensive portfolio also features credit and prepaid cards, the AEON Wallet mobile application, and a variety of financing options such as hire purchase for motor vehicles, as well as loans for motorcycles, automobiles, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and 'objective financing,' alongside insurance brokerage services. A range of other related financial services further completes its offerings. Customers can access these services through an extensive network of physical branches, cash deposit machines, and e-money kiosks. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad functions as a subsidiary of AEON Financial Service Co., Ltd.

Taiheiyo Cement Corporation is a Japanese enterprise with a global presence, specializing in cement production, natural resource extraction, environmental services, and construction materials manufacturing. Its Cement division manufactures a variety of cement products, including standard Portland cement and specialized blends, along with soil stabilization compounds and ready-mix concrete. The Mineral Resources segment supplies limestone aggregates, such as coarse and fine aggregates utilized in ready-mixed concrete and civil engineering projects, as well as sandstone and andesite for similar applications. This segment also produces quicklime, hydrated lime, various fillers, silica, and silica powder. Additionally, it offers distinct materials like hollow ceramics, sepiolite, wollastonite, and kaolin, and processes surplus construction soil for reuse. Taiheiyo Cement's Environmental operations encompass the recycling of a wide array of waste materials, including used tires, plastics, paper sludge, industrial refuse, municipal waste, and different types of sludge (e.g., from water purification, sewage, and dredging). The company also provides CFC treatment, constructs waste processing facilities, and develops advanced recycling technologies, such as ash washing and specialized kiln systems. Furthermore, it supplies flue gas desulfurization agents like calcium carbonate to coal-fired power plants, and trades in slag powder, other inorganic substances, various fuels (coal, heavy oil), chemicals, and gypsum. The Construction Materials unit manufactures precast concrete components, urban infrastructure products like promenades and interlocking paving blocks, concrete housing elements, noise-reducing acoustic panels, and fire-resistant lining materials for tunnels. Other business activities include real estate development and leasing for diverse purposes such as office buildings, retail spaces, leisure facilities, and warehouses, alongside developing land for residential housing. This segment also covers data processing, logistics (transportation and warehousing), engineering services, chemical product manufacturing, and sports-related ventures. Established in 1881, Taiheiyo Cement Corporation maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Westports Holdings Berhad operates as an investment holding company primarily engaged in the development and oversight of port operations. It notably manages the Westports terminal in Port Klang, Malaysia. The company provides a comprehensive suite of services, including container handling, various conventional cargo types such as dry bulk, break bulk, liquid bulk, cement, and roll-on/roll-off, alongside essential marine services. These offerings are supported by its actively managed terminal facilities. Established in 1993, Westports Holdings Berhad's main office is situated in Port Klang, Malaysia.

Noritake Co., Limited operates globally as a producer and distributor of a diverse range of products across industrial, ceramic and material, tabletop, and engineering sectors. Its industrial division furnishes solutions such as abrasive wheels, coated abrasives, diamond and CBN tools, and other grinding and polishing related items, catering to the automotive, steel, and bearing industries. The company's ceramics and materials portfolio encompasses electronic pastes for multilayer ceramic capacitors and various electronic components, thick film circuit boards designed for automotive, medical instrument, and LED applications, alongside vacuum fluorescent displays and ceramic cores. Additionally, Noritake develops and manufactures specialized engineering equipment, including mixers for combining ingredients in chemical, medical, and food processing, filtration systems essential for grinding and polishing processes, and heating apparatus tailored for the automotive, electronic component, and energy-related industries. Furthermore, it provides tabletop products, primarily consisting of dining tableware. Noritake Co., Limited was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Maruwa Co., Ltd., founded in 1973 and based in Owariasahi, Japan, is a key manufacturer and distributor of ceramic and electronic products. The company's diverse ceramic offerings include ceramic and advanced metalized/multilayer ceramic substrates, fillers, pressed ceramic items, ceramic hermetic seals, and SiC components. Its electronic components division supplies antennas, EMC and RF parts, inductors, and capacitors. Additionally, Maruwa produces quartz glass products and a variety of LED lighting solutions, such as modules and individual components. These high-performance products are integral to numerous sectors and applications, including mobile and network infrastructure, LED technology, automotive electronics, RF systems, power electronics, IT and consumer electronics, semiconductor equipment, medical devices, 5G technology, TIM and TPH applications, and general insulation needs. The company was previously known as Maruwa Ceramic Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name in 1999.

Tenaga Nasional Berhad engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and sale of electricity in Malaysia, the United Kingdom, Kuwait, the Republic of Ireland, Australia, and internationally. It operates and maintains thermal and hydroelectric power plants; and operates and manages the National Grid that is connected to Thailand's transmission system, as well as Singapore's transmission system at Senoko. The company also supplies fuel and coal for power generation; generates, distributes, supplies, deals in, and sells various energy sources, as well as provides related technical services; develops district cooling systems; operates and maintains co-generation works; manufactures, sells, and repairs distribution, power, and earthing transformers; and owns, develops, and manages dry bulk terminals. In addition, it provides turnkey contracting services to transmission substations; repair and maintenance services to heavy industries and other related services; operation and maintenance services to telecommunication equipment and data centres; higher education, telecommunication, and IT infrastructure solution and services; research and development services in the areas of engineering, information technology, business, accountancy, and liberal studies; and training courses. Further, the company offers insurance and reinsurance, technical and laboratory, consultancy, and other services; manufactures and distributes power and general cables, and aluminum rods; operates an integrated district cooling systems for air conditioning systems of office buildings; assembles, manufactures, tests, reconditions, and distributes high and medium voltage switchgears and control gears for transmission and distribution of electric power; and operates wind assets. It primarily serves commercial, industrial, and residential customers. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Sercomm Corporation, established in 1992 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, operates as a leading global provider specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of advanced networking and communication equipment and software. The company serves a wide international market, including North America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a variety of cutting-edge solutions. For instance, Sercomm delivers advanced LTE/5G mobility solutions, such as small cells, CBRS technology, private LTE systems, LTE-M/NB-IoT modules, and 5G/LTE terminals. In the realm of broadband access, its offerings span DOCSIS, FTTx, and xDSL solutions, alongside a comprehensive range of broadband routers and residential LTE/5G gateways. The company also excels in Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, featuring IP cameras, IoT gateways, mobile IoT devices, low-power IoT sensors, and integrated IoT cloud platforms. Furthermore, Sercomm provides essential enterprise equipment, including WiFi access points, business-grade routers, network switches, and IP phones. For residential users, its offerings extend to home connectivity and entertainment products like WiFi mesh repeaters, G.hn adapters, over-the-top set-top boxes, and smart speakers. Beyond its core hardware and software offerings, Sercomm delivers comprehensive consultation and customer support services for its communication products. The company also diversifies its operations through the sale of IT products and software, providing investment services, and engaging in real estate property leasing.

Osaka Steel Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies a diverse array of steel products throughout Japan, catering to the construction, industrial, and civil engineering sectors. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses structural steel shapes like equal and unequal angles, channels, and I-beams. The company also produces round and deformed reinforcing bars, along with specialized mechanical joints and other connectors for various steel profiles. Furthermore, it supplies railway and elevator guide rails, pre-finished colored angles and channels, flat and square bars, billets, and a variety of other semi-finished steel goods. Established in 1978, Osaka Steel maintains its headquarters in Osaka, Japan, and operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Steel Corporation.

Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, Acter Group Corporation Limited delivers a broad spectrum of engineering services throughout Taiwan, Mainland China, and other Asian regions. The company's expertise spans the design, construction, and maintenance of essential infrastructure, including advanced air conditioning systems, environmental control facilities, ventilation networks, and specialized clean rooms. Acter also provides cutting-edge energy technology services and executes complete turnkey solutions. Beyond its core engineering activities, the group is engaged in the trading and wholesale of various equipment, such as ice water machines, energy storage devices, electronic and chemical apparatus, and clean room components. Its capabilities extend to the installation of freezing and electronic equipment, diverse air conditioning units, electronic protection systems, and central air conditioning. Additionally, Acter designs and manufactures air and liquid containers, undertakes general construction projects, and offers specialized services like piping engineering, cable installation, and automatic control system engineering.

OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd., established in 1952 in Amagasaki, Japan (and formerly known as Sumitomo Titanium Corporation until its name change in 2007), specializes in the production and distribution of various titanium products. The company's extensive range includes foundational forms such as titanium sponges, ingots, and both pure and aqueous titanium tetrachlorides, alongside ferro-titanium. Additionally, they manufacture advanced materials like high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide, photocatalysts, and specialized titanium powders, including gas-atomized and hydride-dehydride types. These versatile materials are crucial across a multitude of sectors: they supply components for aircraft engines, power generation facilities, petrochemical processing, and seawater desalination plants. Their titanium sheets are also vital for heat exchangers in marine vessels and liquefied natural gas (LNG) production. Furthermore, their products find applications in the medical field (e.g., medical parts), packaging, battery components (negative electrode materials), sintered parts, and extensively within the electronics industry for items such as personal computers, tablets, smartphones, LCD televisions, digital home appliances, semiconductors, and other high-tech materials.

UACJ Corporation is a global manufacturer and distributor of diverse aluminum products, operating both within Japan and across international markets. Its extensive range of offerings includes various flat-rolled aluminum goods. These consist of alloy sheets for applications such as beverage containers, automotive body panels and structures, closures, and railway rolling stock. The company also provides specialized sheets for aircraft, moss LNG tanks, lithographic printing, and lithium-ion battery housings and seals. Other notable flat-rolled products encompass foil feedstocks, brazing sheets, high-thermal-conductivity fin stocks for heat exchangers, high-performance coated sheets, various thick plates, bright and high-gloss sheets, checkered plates, and aluminum panels, alongside materials designed for thermal conductivity and general material substitution. The company further manufactures a variety of extruded aluminum items. This category features high-precision drawn pipes (such as MS Drum uncut pipes for photoconductor drums), ultra-precision extruded tubes (like MF Tube), continuously drawn pipes, and general aluminum alloy extrusions. Additional offerings include free-cutting aluminum alloys (both standard and lead-free variants), precision extruded materials for pneumatic systems, aluminum alloy pipes and rods, intricate micro shapes, and aluminum alloys specifically formulated for forging processes. UACJ's foil division supplies both raw aluminum foils and a range of processed foils, including those that are printed, coated, or laminated with other substances. Its production extends to cast and forged aluminum components. Examples include cast compressor wheels for turbochargers, forged parts for vacuum device chamber walls, specialized aluminum forgings for the aerospace sector, axle bearing housings for high-speed trains, and friction-resistant components used in compressors. Additionally, UACJ produces precision-machined items, such as components for the automotive industry, heat exchangers, plant machinery, and various other industrial parts and materials. Established in 1897, UACJ Corporation maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Chailease Holding Company Limited functions as an investment holding entity, offering a diverse array of financing and leasing solutions. Its operations span across Taiwan, mainland China, ASEAN nations, and other international markets. The company's leasing portfolio encompasses a broad spectrum of assets, including transportation vehicles, industrial machinery, medical equipment, information technology and office solutions, and even aircraft. Beyond leasing, Chailease facilitates installment sales for both corporate clients—spanning industries such as transportation, storage, communications, wholesale, retail, and construction—and individual consumers. Its financial services further extend to import/export factoring and direct lending facilities for both businesses and private individuals. For financial institutions, it provides comprehensive debt collection and management services, which include the appraisal of debt and collateral, asset auctions, and the administration of past-due accounts receivable. The company also diversifies its operations into life and property insurance brokerage, the recovery of delinquent accounts, wholesale gasoline distribution, and full lifecycle management of solar power plants (encompassing investment, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, and maintenance). Additionally, it engages in real estate development. Complementing these, Chailease offers residential property leasing and management, financial consulting and trading activities, mortgage solutions, and cloud-based software products. Established in 1977, Chailease Holding Company Limited is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd., a Tokyo, Japan-based enterprise founded in 1955 (and known as Japan Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. until April 1970), specializes in the production and distribution of a comprehensive array of shutters and building components throughout Japan. The company's extensive product line features numerous shutter variations, including electric wide-grill, transparent panel, horizontal panel, fire-resistant, smoke-control, high-speed, residential window, and flat garage models. They also supply a wide selection of doors, such as water barrier doors, steel doors (some with opening assistance), insulating over sliding doors, sound insulation doors, lightweight steel entrance doors, specialized sliding doors for elderly housing, and hollow stainless steel frames for glass fronts. Beyond shutters and doors, Bunka Shutter provides movable partitions (available in aluminum stud and steel variants), shop and home awnings, stainless steel joinery, PVC curtains, dock shelters, and outdoor steel stairway/corridor units. Their innovative offerings also extend to fire-prevention apparatus with heat-resistant glass, eco-friendly recycled wood/plastic composite materials, and specialized toilet booths. Complementing its manufacturing capabilities, the company offers a robust suite of services, encompassing inspection and maintenance, new building construction and replacement, and comprehensive remodeling and refurbishment projects for both residential and commercial properties.

Noritz Corporation operates on a global scale, focusing on the design, production, and distribution of residential appliances and associated support services. Its extensive portfolio encompasses heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) solutions such as water heaters, hydronic heating systems, gas-powered fan heaters, co-generation systems, specialized water storage units for fuel cells, solar water heaters, and industrial photovoltaic power generation systems. For kitchens, the company supplies built-in and countertop gas cookers, gas ovens, and extractor hoods. Beyond its product lines, Noritz provides a range of services including repairs, installation, post-purchase customer support, and inspections for safety and regulatory compliance. Established in 1951, the corporation's main offices are located in Kobe, Japan.

Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd., established in Shimonoseki, Japan, in 1950, is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of residential and commercial appliances. The company boasts a diverse portfolio, including a comprehensive range of water heating solutions such as oil-fired, gas-fired, and electric water heaters, as well as oil and gas boilers. Their offerings extend to bath and kitchen essentials, featuring bath units, kitchen units, and bathtubs. Chofu Seisakusho also produces climate control systems, including air conditioners and various heating appliances. Demonstrating a commitment to sustainability, they develop eco-conscious technologies like co-generation systems, CO2 heat pump water heaters, and solar energy equipment. Products are distributed to consumers both directly through company showrooms and via an expansive network of authorized dealers.

Sany Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of construction equipment. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses heavy machinery for concrete applications, excavation, hoisting, pile driving, and road construction. This includes specific items such as concrete pump trucks, trailer pumps, mixing trucks, various cranes, drilling rigs, road rollers, pavers, graders, and asphalt mixing equipment. In addition to its machinery offerings, Sany also extends financial solutions, including mortgage services, to assist buyers of its equipment. The company was established in 1994 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, delivers a comprehensive array of banking solutions and financial services. Its operations are organized into three primary divisions: Wholesale Finance, Retail Finance, and Other Business activities. The institution offers diverse account types, including checking, savings, term deposits, and notice accounts, available in Renminbi. Its lending portfolio encompasses a wide range of credit facilities, from personal loans such as those for home purchases, vehicle financing, education abroad, and small businesses, to corporate credit including working capital, fixed asset, and vessel loans, as well as various guarantee-backed financing options. Beyond traditional banking, China Merchants Bank provides credit card products, insurance offerings, and open-ended investment funds. It facilitates commercial transactions through bill discounting, guarantees, and redemption services. The bank also extends advisory services covering financial consultation, underwriting for debt financing, merger and acquisition funding, and support for equity financing and company listings. Furthermore, its extensive service suite includes international trade and treasury solutions like forfeiting, risk sharing, escrow, cross-border RMB clearing, interbank dealings, international factoring, and trade finance. Customers can also access specialized financial tools such as foreign exchange options, gold and forex express trading, financial leasing, guarantees, investment and wealth management, alongside bespoke international, offshore, and private banking services, custody, pension schemes, and modern electronic banking platforms. As of December 31, 2021, the bank maintained a substantial domestic network across Mainland China, comprising 143 branches, 1,770 sub-branches, numerous self-service centers and machines, and visual counters. Globally, it has a footprint in key financial hubs including Hong Kong, New York, London, Singapore, Luxembourg, Sydney, and Taipei. Established in 1987, China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd. is based in Shenzhen, China.

Jiangsu Hengrui Medicine Co., Ltd. is a global biopharmaceutical firm engaged in the full spectrum of pharmaceutical operations, from the initial discovery and development of medications to their manufacturing and worldwide distribution. The company is actively advancing a substantial pipeline of drug candidates, which includes Apatinib, Pyrotinib, Mecapegfilgrastim, SHR3680, SHR3162, SHR9549, SHR2554, SHR1459, SHR-1309, SHR-A1201, Camrelizumab, Famitinib, SHR-1316, SHR-1501, SHR-1603, SHR-1701, SHR-1702, and SHR-A1403. These prospective treatments are aimed at a diverse range of medical conditions, primarily focusing on oncology, metabolic disorders, pain management, and autoimmune diseases, among others. The enterprise was founded in 1970 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Lianyungang, China.

Zhejiang Longsheng Group Co.,Ltd. primarily focuses its operations on the chemical industry, providing a broad selection of products including textile chemicals, fine chemical intermediates, construction chemicals, and inorganic chemicals. In addition to its core chemical activities, the company is actively involved in the automotive sector, where it designs, produces, and sells a wide range of auto parts. These components encompass various body panels, structural elements like engine boards and longerons, and interior fittings such as floor and door plates. The group has also diversified its business portfolio to include logistics services, the distribution of steel products, real estate development, and investments in finance and equity. Founded in 1970 and based in Shaoxing, People's Republic of China, Zhejiang Longsheng Group boasts a global presence, supplying its products to approximately 50 countries and regions around the world.

Jiangxi Hongcheng Environment Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company primarily engaged in water utilities. Its operations include the provision and distribution of water, as well as managing facilities for wastewater treatment. The company officially adopted its current name in February 2021, having previously been known as Jiangxi Hongcheng Waterworks Co.,Ltd. Its headquarters are located in Nanchang, China.

Kweichow Moutai Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily involved in the production and global distribution of various wine and distilled spirit products. The company's main offerings revolve around Maotai liquor, presented in categories such as vintage, standard, and other distinct selections. Established in 1999, the firm's operational headquarters are located in Renhuai, China.

Shandong Pharmaceutical Glass Co., Ltd (SPG), headquartered in Zibo, China, is a manufacturer and supplier specializing in pharmaceutical glass packaging and related butyl rubber products. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a diverse range of glass packaging solutions. This includes essential items like molded injection vials, tubular glass vials, and ampoules, alongside various borosilicate glass products. SPG also supplies specialized containers such as amber, cobalt blue, and green bottles, as well as clear cosmetic and food-grade bottles. Beyond glass, SPG produces critical components like butyl rubber stoppers (including Teflon-coated variants), various plastic and aluminum caps, and dropper caps. They also provide prefilled syringes and plastic bottles. These offerings primarily cater to the pharmaceutical, food, and cosmetic packaging sectors. While maintaining a significant presence in the domestic Chinese market, SPG also extends its reach globally, exporting to numerous international markets such as Europe, the United States, Russia, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia. Established in 1970, the company boasts a long history in the industry.

Xiamen Faratronic Co., Ltd., founded in 1955 and based in Xiamen, China, is a manufacturer and global supplier of film capacitors and metallized coating materials. The company offers a comprehensive selection of film capacitors designed for various applications, including models for printed circuit boards (PCBs) such as SMD, polyethylene naphtalate, polyester, polypropylene, interference suppression, precision, and capacitive divider A.C. capacitors. Additionally, their product portfolio extends to specialized film capacitors for power electronics, AC motor systems, and lighting devices. They also produce metallized polyester and polypropylene films.

ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd., headquartered in Langfang, China, since its establishment in 1992, is a comprehensive energy provider. The company's core business operations in China encompass the wholesale and retail distribution of natural gas, alongside engaging in energy chemical and general chemical trading, and the mining and washing of coal. Beyond commodity sales, ENN offers a broad spectrum of engineering services. These include design, equipment manufacturing, and construction and installation for natural gas infrastructure, novel chemical industries, and environmental protection initiatives. Additionally, it undertakes technology research and development, provides consulting, manages equipment integration, and executes project management. Its product portfolio extends to the production and sale of coal, methanol, and dimethyl ether, in addition to supplying bulk liquefied natural gas (LNG) and a diverse range of energy forms such as electricity, heating, cooling, and steam. The company serves a wide array of customers, distributing pipeline natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial users. For residential consumers, it also retails gas appliances, including stoves, water heaters, range hoods, and heating units. Industrial clients are further supplied with building materials and various other energy products. Known previously as ENN Ecological Holdings Co., Ltd., the company officially adopted its current name, ENN Natural Gas Co., Ltd., in October 2020.

Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the manufacturing and supply of a broad spectrum of electrical and electronic solutions. Their extensive product line features various relays, including signal, automotive (with accompanying modules), power, industrial, latching, and new energy types. Additionally, the company provides medium and low voltage electrical apparatus, comprehensive high and low voltage complete systems, connectors, capacitors, precision parts, and automation equipment. Among their low-voltage offerings are intelligent circuit breakers, contactors, motor protectors, and automatic transfer switching breakers. Founded in 1984, the company was initially known as WuHan LiNuo Solar Energy Group Co., Ltd. before officially rebranding to Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2012. Its primary operations are based in Xiamen, China.

Chongqing Iron & Steel Company Limited, along with its affiliated entities, is a prominent player in the steel industry within the People's Republic of China. Its core business involves the processing, production, and sale of a wide array of steel products, including steel plates, structural sections, wire rods, various bar materials, as well as billets and thin plates. Beyond its primary steel offerings, the company also engages in the manufacturing and marketing of coking and coal chemical products, pig iron, grain slag, steel slag, and steel scrap. These diverse materials are extensively utilized across numerous industries, such as heavy machinery, architecture, general engineering, the automotive and motorcycle sectors, shipbuilding, offshore oil exploration, and the production of gas cylinders, boilers, and oil and gas pipelines. The company was founded in 1997 and is strategically headquartered in Chongqing, PRC.

Universal Scientific Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a premier global provider of electronic design and manufacturing services (EMS). The company delivers a comprehensive suite of services, spanning product conceptualization, miniaturization expertise, meticulous material sourcing, advanced manufacturing, efficient logistics, worldwide sales, and thorough after-sales support for electronic devices and modules. Its extensive product lineup includes wireless connectivity components like Wi-Fi modules, alongside bespoke design and manufacturing (ODM/JDM/EMS) solutions for high-performance computing devices, servers, storage units, NAS systems, and solid-state drives.
