This segment also develops intelligent transport solutions, like electronic toll collection and highway traffic management, and provides industrial and material handling equipment, such as forklift trucks, printing, paper converting, metals, food & packaging machinery, pumps, compressors, hydraulic components, turbochargers, and automotive air conditioning and refrigeration systems. Finally, the Aircraft, Defense & Space segment serves both civilian and governmental sectors by providing civil aircraft and engines, aviation equipment, and comprehensive maintenance, repair, and overhaul services. It further designs and produces advanced space systems, including launch vehicles, rocket engines, and space station components, alongside a robust portfolio of defense systems such as naval ships, specialized military vehicles, defense aircraft, helicopters, and guided weapon systems. Mitsubishi Heavy Industries also offers crucial after-sales services and cybersecurity solutions tailored for industrial control systems. Founded in 1884, the company is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

UNISOL Holdings Corporation operates in Japan across three primary sectors: industrial machinery and tools, construction equipment and supplies, and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. In its machinery and tools division, the company supplies a wide array of industrial equipment, including advanced machine tools, press machines, injection molding systems, robotic solutions, and logistics machinery. It also distributes components like screws, hardware, welding and painting materials, and specialized machine tools to steel frame construction firms, alongside turnbuckles, braces, and plumbing supplies for industrial plant plumbing professionals. The IoT segment focuses on offering advanced security and monitoring technologies, such as surveillance camera systems, comprehensive security systems, and access control solutions. Within the construction machinery and materials sector, UNISOL provides both rental and sales services for heavy equipment, encompassing cranes, excavators, specialized foundation machinery, and high-reach work platforms, along with associated auxiliary equipment. Additionally, this division offers machinery rental services that include skilled operators. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Osaka, Japan, the company was previously known as Maruka Furusato Corporation, changing its name to UNISOL Holdings Corporation in January 2026.

Lifenet Insurance Company, based in Tokyo, Japan, offers a range of life insurance products and related services to customers across the country. Their diverse portfolio includes term life, comprehensive whole life medical coverage, cancer policies, and insurance against incapacity and disability. Notably, the company employs a direct-to-consumer model, selling its policies primarily through its online platform. Beyond core insurance provision, Lifenet also handles underwriting, provides asset management services, and operates as a business agency. Established in 2006, the company adopted its present name in April 2008, having previously been known as Net Life Planning Co., Ltd.

ZENKOKU HOSHO Co.,Ltd., together with its various subsidiaries, primarily operates within Japan's credit guarantee sector. The company provides guarantees for a diverse range of financial products, including mortgages, credit card advances, apartment financing, and educational loans. Beyond its core guarantee services, the firm also functions as a non-life insurance intermediary and conducts credit research. Its offerings further encompass services related to contracting, representation, and information processing and dissemination. Additionally, the company undertakes debt collection activities and provides agency support for various back-office operations. Established in 1981, ZENKOKU HOSHO Co.,Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Operating globally, Isuzu Motors Limited specializes in the production and sale of commercial vehicles, including light commercial models, alongside a comprehensive range of diesel engines and their associated components. Their diverse product portfolio encompasses heavy, medium, and light-duty trucks, as well as buses. They also offer passenger pickup vehicles, general pickup trucks, tractors, and sport utility vehicles, in addition to marine and industrial-grade engines. Furthermore, Isuzu supplies its robust diesel engines to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across numerous sectors, such as construction machinery, agricultural equipment, power generation, and commercial marine applications. Beyond manufacturing, the company extends its operations to include extensive after-sales support, specialized repair services for commercial vehicles and buses, and comprehensive leasing and maintenance contract options for its commercial fleet. Isuzu is also involved in the production of various automobile parts and engines. The company's activities further extend to the import, wholesale distribution, supply, and export of vehicles, components, and parts. This includes logistical services like warehousing and transportation, along with the import, assembly, and wholesale of pickup trucks and their variants. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1916, the company operated as Diesel Automobile Industry Co., Ltd. until its rebranding to Isuzu Motors Limited in July 1949.

Honda Motor Co., Ltd., founded in 1946 and based in Tokyo, Japan, is a multinational corporation involved in the development, production, and global sale of motorcycles, automobiles, power equipment, and other specialized items. Its market presence extends across Japan, North America, Europe, Asia, and other international territories. The company's activities are structured into four main divisions. The Motorcycle Business segment manufactures a diverse range of motorcycles, such as sports, business, and commuter models, in addition to off-road vehicles like all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) and side-by-sides. The Automobile Business segment delivers passenger cars, light trucks, and compact mini-vehicles to consumers. Through its Financial Services Business, Honda offers various financial solutions, including retail loans and leasing options for customers, alongside wholesale financing for its dealer network. The Life Creation and Other Businesses segment is responsible for creating and distributing a broad spectrum of power products, which include general-purpose engines, generators, water pumps, different types of lawnmowers (riding and robotic versions among them), brush cutters, tillers, snow blowers, marine outboard engines, mobility assistance devices, and portable battery inverter power sources. This division also encompasses the HondaJet aircraft. Furthermore, the company provides spare parts and comprehensive after-sales support through its direct retail dealers, independent distributors, and licensed affiliates.

Globally, Subaru Corporation is involved in the manufacturing and sale of both automotive and aerospace products. The company's operations are divided into three primary segments: the Automotive Business Unit, the Aerospace Company, and a category for Other Businesses. Its core activities include the production, distribution, and repair of passenger vehicles and their parts, along with airplanes, aerospace-related machinery, and their components. Furthermore, it manages and leases real estate properties. Subaru also offers a range of additional services such as vehicle shipping, land freight, and warehousing; vehicle leasing and rental; vehicle credit and financing; aircraft inspection, service, and maintenance; and IT system development and operation. The entity was previously known as Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd. before officially changing its name to Subaru Corporation in April 2017. Founded in 1917, Subaru Corporation's headquarters are located in Tokyo, Japan.

Koito Manufacturing Co., Ltd. operates globally as a producer and distributor of diverse equipment, with a primary focus on automotive lighting and electrical components. Its market reach extends across Japan, North America, China, the broader Asian region, Europe, and other international territories. The company's comprehensive selection of automotive lighting includes cutting-edge LED, discharge, and halogen headlamps, as well as fog lights. It also provides various signaling and specialized lamps, such as LED rear combination, side turn signal, and high-mounted stop lamps. Beyond the automotive sector, Koito supplies aircraft lighting, encompassing interior and exterior lights and caution warning panels, along with related electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. For marine applications, it develops specialized products like LED marine lamps and destination indicators. The company's extensive portfolio also features the production and sale of electronic components, various electrical devices, and telecommunications equipment. Furthermore, Koito is involved in precision machinery, miniature bulbs, resin metal molds, and specialized railroad car equipment, including control systems and seating. It also manufactures road traffic signals and comprehensive traffic control systems. In addition to its manufacturing activities, Koito provides a suite of services, such as transportation and logistics solutions, insurance agency operations, and the maintenance of traffic signals and safety infrastructure. Founded in 1915, Koito Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Murakami Corporation, a long-established Japanese company founded in 1882 and headquartered in Shizuoka, is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of diverse mirror products. Its core business centers on automotive mirrors, encompassing standard rearview models, advanced electronic mirrors, and specialized concave designs for the Japanese market. Beyond mirrors, the company also develops and provides heated washer systems and various projection-related items. Furthermore, Murakami Corporation offers a sophisticated portfolio of opto-electronics solutions, which includes a comprehensive array of specialized mirrors such as dichroic, half, Ar, Cr, and laser mirrors, alongside a wide selection of filters like UV, IR, dichroic, cold, band-pass, and trimming filters.

Shimano Inc. specializes in the design, manufacturing, and supply of bicycle components, fishing equipment, and gear for rowing. Additionally, the corporation designs and develops a range of lifestyle merchandise, such as apparel, footwear, bags, and related accessories. The company conducts business operations across a wide geographical area, encompassing Japan, Asia, Europe, North America, Latin America, and Oceania. Founded in 1921, its central administrative office is located in Sakai, Japan.

Nagaileben Co., Ltd. is a Japanese enterprise that manufactures and distributes apparel for the medical industry. Their product range includes specialized clothing for hospitals, clinics, and operating rooms. This company was established in 1915 and has its corporate headquarters located in Tokyo, Japan.

Founded in Osaka, Japan, in 1893, Yagi & Co.,Ltd. operates as a prominent textile trading enterprise. The company's operations encompass the comprehensive import, export, and distribution of a wide array of fiber-related products. This includes fundamental raw materials such as cotton and synthetic yarns, various fabrics, and a diverse range of finished textile goods. Its offerings span knits, an extensive selection of apparel (including sportswear, nightwear, innerwear, menswear, ladieswear, uniforms, workwear, children's clothing, and Femtech products), fashion accessories, and home textiles like bedding, interior items, and lifestyle products, as well as specialized industrial fiber materials. Yagi & Co. is also involved in the manufacturing of specific items such as raschel knits, outerwear, and towels, while actively planning and marketing apparel fabrics and garments. Additionally, the company provides essential materials for the automotive, interior design, and general industrial sectors, and it manages a real estate rental business.

AS ONE Corporation, a Japanese company with a global presence, specializes in the distribution of a wide array of scientific instruments, research equipment, and essential products for nursing and healthcare. Its diverse catalog of scientific instruments includes devices for temperature and humidity control, alongside measuring and surveying tools. It also supplies versatile equipment for laboratory processes such as cooling, heating, mixing, absorption, pressurization, and material conveyance. For biotechnology, AS ONE provides microscopes, glass slides, and tissue culture products. Precision work and analytical technology are supported by magnifying glasses, filters, and dispensing apparatus. Essential research facility equipment encompasses experimental platforms, fume hoods, pharmaceutical storage units, general storage solutions, wagons, laboratory seating, and material handling gear. Additionally, the company offers fundamental lab consumables like various containers for samples, reagents, and materials; indispensable glassware and plasticware such as beakers and flasks; hoses, tubes, and connectors; along with practical items like tapes, labels, timers, packaging machinery, tools, and office supplies tailored for laboratory environments. The company also supplies industrial-grade equipment, including dehumidifying storage solutions, organizational and conveyance systems, and various sterilization, disinfecting, and cleaning products such as ultrasonic cleaners, detergents, and drying tools. Its offerings extend to personal protective equipment like safety glasses, masks, and gloves. Furthermore, AS ONE provides specialized items for clean rooms, including specific tools, containers, dust-proof apparel, anti-static products, and essential clean room mats. For the medical and nursing sectors, AS ONE provides hospital and nursing instruments, encompassing PPE like white gowns, masks, and gloves. It supplies rack systems designed for nursing stations, a diverse range of products, supplies, and equipment crucial for hospital nursing or general care, along with sterilizers and sterilization lockers. The company further offers mobility and patient comfort items such as care cars, beds, and a selection of bathing and sanitary products. Established in Osaka, Japan, in 1933, the company continues to maintain its headquarters there.

Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates drugstores in Japan. The company also provides self-care support services, including meal delivery, cancer and other health checkups, specific health guidance, health information, and community comprehensive agreements; health care support, such as medicine support, home-visit dispensing and nursing, prevention programs, shopping assistance, and mobility support services. In addition, it engages in drugstore operation, dispensing pharmacy operation, medical consultation, business in foreign countries, Chinese medicine pharmacy operations, disease prevention and health support, promotion of disabled employment, home visit nursing and elderly home-care support, support for commencement of medical practice, comprehensive staff agency service, and support business for pharmacy operations. Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Obu, Japan.

Nakanishi Inc. operates as an international producer and supplier of an extensive array of goods for the dental, industrial, and medical markets. Their comprehensive dental offerings feature turbines, clinical micromotors, contra-angles, in addition to products supporting built-in and mobile dentistry, oral hygiene, endodontics, surgical needs, dental laboratory work, and general maintenance. Furthermore, the company offers motor spindles and micro grinding tools within its industrial segment. Nakanishi Inc. caters to a wide spectrum of industries, including automotive, micromechanics, electronics, healthcare, die/mold manufacturing, aerospace, and energy. The company was established in 1930 and maintains its headquarters in Kanuma, Japan.

Olympus Corporation, a global enterprise headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, manufactures and distributes high-precision machinery and instrumentation worldwide. The company, originally established in 1919 as Olympus Optical Co., Ltd., adopted its current name in October 2003. Its extensive operations are structured into four primary divisions: Endoscopic Solutions, Therapeutic Solutions, Scientific Solutions, and a segment designated as "Others." The Endoscopic Solutions division specializes in developing and providing gastrointestinal and surgical endoscopes, comprehensive endoscopy systems, and associated repair services. The Therapeutic Solutions segment focuses on products for urology, gynecology, and ear, nose, and throat (ENT) procedures, alongside endo-therapy devices, energy-based surgical tools, and disposable surgical instruments. Within Scientific Solutions, Olympus supplies biological and industrial microscopes, industrial endoscopes and videoscopes, non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment, and X-ray fluorescence (XRF) analyzers. The "Others" segment encompasses biomedical materials and orthopedic equipment. Beyond these core areas, the company also offers a broader array of medical devices, including surgical microscopes, endoscope reprocessing units, electrosurgical tools, and respiratory-endotherapy devices, complemented by system integration and ongoing maintenance services.

Founded in 1939 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Riken Keiki Co., Ltd. is a global manufacturer and distributor of advanced gas detection and monitoring equipment. Their comprehensive product portfolio serves diverse industrial and safety needs, including continuous gas detection and alarm systems, as well as a variety of portable and personal gas monitors. The company's specialized offerings extend to portable gas leak checkers, dedicated toxic gas and oxygen monitor alarm units, and versatile portable combination gas monitors. They also provide optical gas indicator tubes, auto-emission and surface analyzers, and gas indicators specifically designed for medical applications, alongside an entrusted experimental service for measuring leaked gas diffusion and the portable salinity analyzer, SALCON.

Tamron Co.,Ltd. is a Japanese corporation, established in 1948 and headquartered in Saitama, that specializes in the production and sale of high-precision optical goods. The company organizes its operations into three primary divisions. Its Photo-Related Business segment offers a range of interchangeable lenses designed for both mirrorless and single-lens reflex cameras. The Monitoring & FA Related Business segment provides optical solutions such as surveillance camera lenses, FA/machine vision lenses, video conferencing lenses, and various camera modules. The third segment, Mobility & Healthcare, Other Business, focuses on products like in-vehicle cameras, video cameras, digital cameras, drone components, medical lenses, and diverse optical device parts. Beyond these segments, Tamron also produces lenses for IP/CCTV systems and long-wavelength infrared cameras, alongside optical device units and precision injection molds made from engineering plastic. The company maintains a global footprint, conducting business across Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and other international markets. Originally known as Taisei Optical Equipment Manufacturing Inc., the firm adopted the name Tamron Co.,Ltd. in April 1970.

A&D HOLON Holdings Company Limited, founded in 1977 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of measurement and analysis technologies. Its extensive product catalog encompasses sophisticated systems for measurement, control, and simulation, alongside analytical instruments such as FFT, sound, and vibration analyzers. The company also manufactures digital ultrasonic devices for detecting flaws and measuring thickness, as well as machinery for material testing, and A/D D/A converters crucial for semiconductor fabrication. Moreover, A&D HOLON provides a wide array of weighing equipment, including precision electronic balances, digital platform scales, industrial weighing systems, indicators, controllers, and advanced data processing systems for both weighing and general measurement. For the medical and home health markets, their offerings include digital blood pressure monitors for clinical and personal use, a variety of scales designed for healthcare settings, consumer digital scales, and ultrasonic nebulizers. The company's precision technologies further extend to photomask CD-SEM and defect review SEM products, along with specialized tools for roller mold measurement.

Ricoh Company, Ltd. is an international provider of extensive office and commercial printing solutions, along with a broad spectrum of related offerings. Its product portfolio features a diverse array of hardware, including multifunctional devices, standard printers, industrial inkjet systems, garment and production printers, and 3D printers. The company also supplies communication and collaboration tools such as projectors, video and web conferencing systems, and interactive whiteboards, as well as essential components like inkjet heads and modules. Beyond printing, Ricoh diversifies into optics and electronics, manufacturing digital, spherical, single-lens reflex, action, and infrared thermography cameras. It also provides the automotive industry with stereo cameras and precision machined parts, in addition to producing compact, energy-efficient mobile integrated circuits. The company's specialized ventures include producing and marketing thermal paper for various uses such as food labels and tickets, crafting watches, and developing advanced healthcare and sensing technologies. These encompass magnetoencephalography (MEG) systems for brain activity measurement, indoor positioning services, bed sensor systems, automated external defibrillators (AEDs), integrated medical care platforms, and genetic testing materials. Ricoh's service offerings comprise managed print solutions, application and business process management, communication services, intelligent workplace strategies, and general information technology support. The company also participates in the energy sector, handling solar power facility operations and maintenance, and selling electricity. Catering to numerous industries, including manufacturing, retail, healthcare, real estate, travel and tourism, and engineering and construction, Ricoh Company, Ltd. was established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1936 as Riken Optical Co., Ltd., and rebranded to its current name in 1963.

BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc. is a global enterprise dedicated to various entertainment sectors. Its Toys and Hobby division manufactures and distributes an extensive range of consumer products, including traditional toys, collectible figures, plastic models, trading cards, and character merchandise, alongside confectionery, apparel, and diverse sundries. This segment also extends to specialized items like pachinko and pachislot machines, RC and robot toys, and even playground equipment. Furthermore, it manages the import and export of toys and provides inspection and testing services. The Network Entertainment segment is dedicated to digital and online experiences, encompassing the planning, development, and distribution of home video games, online games, and other network content and software. It also oversees live events, operates amusement machines, and provides a suite of online services, including advertising, promotional activities, and platforms for video distribution and gaming, along with communication tools. Through its Real Entertainment segment, the company designs, manufactures, and markets amusement machines. This segment is also responsible for the planning and operation of various amusement facilities, offering comprehensive after-sales support and managing the sale of pre-owned equipment. The Visual and Music Production segment focuses on creating and distributing visual and musical content, including animated productions and package software. It provides audio engineering services, manages affiliated artists and fan clubs, and organizes live entertainment events. This division also produces visual content tied to performances and music, alongside merchandise and ticketing sales. Finally, the IP Creation segment is central to intellectual property development, involved in conceiving and producing animations, music, labels, and events. A key function is the management and administration of copyrights and other related rights. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 2005, the company adopted its current name, BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc., in June 2014, having previously operated as NAMCO BANDAI Holdings, Inc.

Shoei Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells motorcycle helmets for general public and government agencies under the SHOEI brand worldwide. The company provides full-face, system, jet, off-road, bicycle, and trial helmets. It offers its products online. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Established in Kyoto, Japan, in 1929, Nissha Co., Ltd. operates globally, providing a diverse array of products and services across industrial materials, electronic devices, medical technologies, and information and communication. The company's industrial materials and devices offerings are extensive, featuring advanced solutions such as in-mold decoration (IMD) and in-mold electronics (IME), transfer foils, and printed electronics. It also excels in molding, offers CMF (Color, Material, Finish) design sample books, and produces metallized paper suitable for various uses including packaging, labels, wrapping, direct food contact, and innerliners. Additionally, Nissha is a key supplier of sensing technologies, including force and gas sensors, for applications ranging from smartphones to the automotive industry, and provides material consulting alongside finished products. In its medical technologies sector, Nissha focuses on medical device design and manufacturing services, offering complete healthcare product solutions and custom-labeled medical products. The company also supports various communication activities. Formerly known as Nissha Printing Co., Ltd., the company officially rebranded to Nissha Co., Ltd. in October 2017.

Kawai Musical Instruments Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes musical instruments under its prominent Kawai brand, with a particular focus on both acoustic and digital pianos. Beyond instrument production, the company also creates and markets computer music software, alongside business software tailored for small enterprises. Kawai actively promotes musical appreciation through a variety of lectures and concerts. Additionally, its operations encompass the production and sale of precision metal components, wooden goods, and electronic devices. The company further runs educational facilities, including music and physical education schools, and maintains learning centers in China, Taiwan, and Indonesia. Established in Hamamatsu, Japan, in 1927, Kawai Musical Instruments Manufacturing Co., Ltd. continues to be headquartered in that city.
long_name: Kawai Musical Instruments Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

business_summary: Pigeon Corporation is a global enterprise engaged in the creation, production, distribution, import, and export of a wide array of goods tailored for infants, young children, new and expectant mothers, women's wellness, home healthcare needs, and senior care, catering to both the Japanese market and international customers. Its operations are structured across four primary business divisions: Japan, China, Singapore, and the Lansinoh business. The company's product portfolio spans essentials for breastfeeding and weaning, skincare formulations, women's care items, and various other baby and maternal necessities, including larger-sized products for infants. Beyond its merchandise, Pigeon provides comprehensive services such as parenting guidance, professional babysitter placement, event-specific childcare, and early childhood education. It also operates its own network of childcare facilities and preschools. Additionally, the company offers anti-aging and elder care products, complemented by associated support services for seniors. Specific items for infants and mothers include feeding bottles, nipples, personal hygiene products, and specialized dermatological solutions. All its offerings are sold under the prominent Pigeon and Lansinoh brands. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1949, the firm was originally known as Pigeon Honyuki Honpo Corporation before officially changing its name to Pigeon Corporation in 1966.

Nintendo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells home entertainment products in Japan, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It offers home console gaming hardware, software, accessories, and other products. The company also provides various services, such as Nintendo Switch Online; and services and content. In addition, it offers develop IP, including video content and mobile apps. The company was formerly known as Nintendo Playing Card Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nintendo Co., Ltd. in 1963. Nintendo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, Shofu Inc. is a long-standing global supplier of diverse dental materials and specialized equipment, having been established in 1922. The company offers an extensive product range, encompassing everything from artificial teeth, dental porcelains, and various abrasives and polishers to dental alloys, cements, restorative substances, waxes, investment materials, and orthodontic devices, alongside preventative infection control solutions. The organization adopted its current name, Shofu Inc., in 1983, having previously operated as Shofu Dental Mfg. Co., Ltd.

Kokuyo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, purchases, and sells office furniture products in Japan and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Furniture Business, Business Supply Distribution Business, Stationery Business, and Interior Retail Business. It offers office and public furniture, office supplies, stationery, and rear and household goods. The company also engages in wholesale, delivery, and assembly of interior and furniture; notebooks, writing instruments, and art supplies, with the Campus brand; procures and sells interior and lifestyle goods, operating instores and e-commerce stores; work style consulting; proposal and support system for stationery and office supplies; development and sale of creative picture book series and tools for creativity; and document digitization services, as well as spatial design and construction for offices, medical and educational institutions, public offices, and agencies. In addition, it is involved in the transportation and storage of products; sale of paper products; provision of outsourcing services for general affairs and other administrative tasks; furniture and building materials installation; procurement and leasing of office equipment; mail order sales of office supplies; and non-life insurance agency business. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Kokkodo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kokuyo Co., Ltd. in January 1961. Kokuyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Nifco Inc. is a global producer and distributor of industrial plastic components, serving markets across Japan, the rest of Asia, North America, and Europe. The company provides an extensive array of products for various applications, including automotive parts for fuel systems, engines, vehicle exteriors and interiors, and electric powertrains. For residential use, their offerings encompass drawer soft-closers, push-to-open latches, earthquake-resistant latches, and door damping mechanisms. In the consumer electronics and office automation sectors, Nifco supplies items like various dampers, free-stop hinges, magnetic catches, and push latches. Furthermore, they contribute to the fashion and sports industries with fasteners such as side release buckles, cord stoppers, and other buckle types. Beyond its core plastic operations, Nifco also manufactures beds and engages in the import and retail of furniture. Originally incorporated in 1946, the company changed its name from Japan Industry Fastener Inc. to Nifco Inc. in December 1970, and its headquarters are situated in Tokyo, Japan.

ITOCHU Corporation operates as a global trading house, managing a diverse portfolio of import, export, and multifaceted business operations across the world. Its Textile segment manufactures and supplies various fiber and garment materials, fabrics, finished apparel, and industrial textiles. It also imports and distributes lifestyle brands, fashion accessories, and clothing across luxury, casual, and sports categories. The Machinery division offers comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services. It further develops and operates large-scale projects in areas such as water, environmental infrastructure, renewable energy, oil & gas, petrochemicals, and independent power production facilities. The segment also handles the sale and leasing of aircraft and associated equipment, alongside distributing automobiles, construction machinery, electronic systems, industrial machinery, and medical devices. It also owns and charters ships. The Metals & Minerals segment focuses on the mining and global trade of essential resources including iron ore, coal, uranium, various base metals, and minor metals. It also conducts trade in non-ferrous metal materials and processes and sells steel products. In Energy & Chemicals, ITOCHU trades a wide array of products such as crude oil, petroleum derivatives, LPG, LNG, natural gas, and hydrogen. It also deals with organic and inorganic chemicals, synthetic resins, household commodities, fine chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and electronic materials, complementing these activities with power generation and trading. The Food segment is dedicated to the production, distribution, and retail of food items. Its General Products & Realty division produces and markets diverse materials including paper, pulp, natural rubber, tires, and wood. It also engages in the development and operation of real estate properties, such as residential, logistics, and other commercial projects, while providing logistics services. The ICT & Financial Business segment delivers an extensive range of services, encompassing IT solutions, internet-related services, venture capital, mobile telecommunications equipment and services, business process outsourcing (BPO), broadcasting and communications, entertainment and content services, healthcare and preventive medicine outsourcing, and financial and insurance brokerage. Established in 1858, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Tokyo, Japan.

Tokyo Electron Limited, operating globally with its subsidiaries, is actively engaged in the engineering, fabrication, and international sales of advanced equipment for both semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) production. Its extensive market reach spans Japan, Europe, North America, Taiwan, China, South Korea, and various other international territories. Within its Semiconductor Production Equipment division, the firm provides a comprehensive array of tools. These include systems for coating, developing, etching, depositing, and cleaning, which are crucial for wafer processing. For the wafer testing phase, they supply wafer probers, along with machinery for wafer bonding and de-bonding. The Flat Panel Display Production Equipment segment offers specialized coaters/developers and etch/ash systems, indispensable for manufacturing FPDs. This segment also delivers innovative inkjet printing systems tailored for the creation of OLED panels. In addition to its primary equipment offerings, the company extends its services to include logistics, facility maintenance, and insurance. Tokyo Electron Limited, established in 1951, maintains its principal offices in Tokyo, Japan.

E Ink Holdings Inc. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and distribution of electronic paper display (EPD) panels. The company manufactures a wide array of high-resolution modules, which are utilized in e-readers, digital note-taking tools, mobile phone accessories, wearable technology, electronic shelf labels, logistic and luggage tags, smart cards, digital signage, and smart packaging solutions. Additionally, E Ink provides segmented displays for integration into consumer electronics, timepieces, medical instruments, industrial gauges, PC peripherals, smart cards, electronic price tags, and mobile communication devices. Its product portfolio also encompasses electronic ink films, flexible substrate materials, and polyimide and other functional material films. These innovative products find applications across numerous sectors, including reading and writing, computing and peripherals, mobile and wearable devices, retail, logistics and warehousing, healthcare, transportation and outdoor displays, smart home systems, and various design-centric uses. Founded in 1992 as Prime View International, Inc., the company officially rebranded to E Ink Holdings Inc. in June 2010 and maintains its headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

Unicharm Corporation engages in the manufacturing and sale of pet care and related products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Personal Care, Pet Care, and Others segments. It offers wellness care, feminine care, baby and child care products, as well as food-packaging materials, etc. The company also provides napkin-type incontinence pads, pants-type diapers, tape-type diapers, pants-type specialized urine pads, and tape-type specialized urine pads under the Lifree brand name; specialized liners for incontinence care under the Charm Nap brand name; fabric and facial masks under the Chorittai and Chokaiteki Mask brand name; Home care products under Wave brand; and kitchen paper towel under the Cook Up brand name. In addition, it offers pet food under the Pet Dog Genki, Pet Cat Genki, Grand Deli, Best Balance, Silver Spoon, Silver Plate, AllWell, and Physicalife brand names, as well as excrement cleanup sheets, disposable diapers, apparel-like absorption wear for excretion-care for dogs, and Deo-Sand series and Deo-Toilet system products for cats. Further, the company provides feminine care products including feminine napkins, tampons, sanitary shorts, and panty liners under the Sofy and Silcot names; and disposable baby diaper under the Moony, Mamy Poko, Trepanman, and Oyasuminman brands. Additionally, it is involved in recycling of disposable diapers, as well as offering products under RefF brand. Unicharm Corporation was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Toho Holdings Co., Ltd. serves as a leading wholesaler of pharmaceutical and healthcare products throughout Japan. Its extensive product range includes prescription and over-the-counter medications, reagents, medical devices and supplies, and health foods, in addition to offerings for preventive, clinical, community, and home-based medical and nursing care. Beyond distribution, the company provides comprehensive support services like developing and selling customer-focused software, assisting with the establishment of new medical facilities and pharmacies, delivering management consulting, offering medical assistance, and facilitating personnel recruitment. Toho Holdings also operates dispensing pharmacies, manufactures and distributes generic drugs, acts as a site management organization (SMO) to support clinical trials for various healthcare institutions, and supplies specialized software to the medical sector. Among its technological solutions are customer support systems such as ENIF for pharmaceutical ordering, ENI-Pharmacy for streamlining dispensing and prescribing processes, LXMATE HeLios for medical appointments, KAITOS for online medical consultations and medication guidance, ENIFwin for inventory control in large hospitals, the ENIFvoice series for voice-activated electronic medication history recording, and ENIF Nurse for home-visit nurse operational support, along with diverse logistics systems. The company, founded in 1948, is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. (MUFG) operates as the overarching bank holding company for MUFG Bank, Ltd., delivering a broad spectrum of financial services globally, including in Japan, the United States, Europe, and the Asia/Oceania region. The company organizes its operations across several key divisions: Digital Service; Retail & Commercial Banking; Japanese Corporate & Investment Banking; Asset Management & Investor Services; Global Corporate & Investment Banking; Global Commercial Banking; and Global Markets. MUFG provides commercial banking, trust banking, and securities products and services to a diverse clientele, ranging from retail consumers and small to medium-sized enterprises. Its offerings further extend to advisory on mergers and acquisitions, real estate solutions, digital financial platforms, credit card services, lending, fund transfers, and foreign exchange. For large corporations and financial institutions, MUFG offers specialized corporate, investment, and transaction banking services. Additionally, it manages assets and provides administrative services for corporations and pension funds, facilitates loans, deposits, fund transfers, and investments, and deals in various financial instruments such as fixed income, currencies, and equities. The group is also active in the origination and distribution of financial products and provides treasury solutions. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. was established in 1880 and maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings, Inc. operates as a trust bank across Japan and globally. The company delivers a wide array of supervisory services encompassing strategic planning, financial oversight, and human resource management. Its extensive offerings also include corporate administration, optimizing operational processes, risk assessment, and ensuring regulatory compliance, in addition to conducting internal audits. Furthermore, it provides real estate brokerage and consulting expertise to both individual and institutional clients. The firm also specializes in stock transfer agency functions, comprehensive asset management services, and a full suite of retail solutions, marketing strategies, and fiduciary duties. Established in 2002, and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was formerly known as Chuo Mitsui Trust Holdings, Inc. before rebranding to its current name in 2011.

Nien Made Enterprise Co., LTD. engages in the research, development, design, manufacture, and sale of various types of window coverings and related components in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Window Coverings and Other. It offers various types of blinds, shutters, shades, and related components; wood blinds and shutter semi-products; smart drape; cellular, roman, and roller shades; plastic blinds and accessories; and chair covers. The company also designs, manufactures, and sells automated appliances and PVC tubes. In addition, it engages in manufacturing and selling dehumidifiers and air purifiers; the provision of logistics support services and window coverings documentation processing services; and trading and servicing in window coverings. The company was formerly known as Huan Qiu Shi Jing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nien Made Enterprise Co., LTD. in March 2008. Nien Made Enterprise Co., LTD. was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

SBI Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese conglomerate primarily engaged in online financial services and strategic investments, both domestically and internationally. Its operations are structured around three key pillars: Financial Services, Asset Management, and the Biotechnology, Healthcare, and Medical Informatics sectors. The company provides a comprehensive suite of financial products, including online brokerage, investment banking, and internet banking facilities. It offers various insurance solutions such as automobile, health (cancer), property (fire, earthquake), and life coverage, alongside short-term insurance. Further financial offerings encompass foreign exchange (FX) margin trading, online securities, and services related to digital asset exchange and transactions. SBI also manages defined-contribution pension schemes, provides leasing and lending services, and operates a proprietary trading system. Its involvement extends to e-commerce settlement processing, remittance services, and essential back-office support. Beyond traditional banking, SBI is active in private equity and venture capital fund management, offers mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory, and runs savings and commercial banking operations. It provides investment advisory and management services, alongside rating information services. The firm also deals with real estate-secured loans and offers rent guarantees for residential properties. In the biotechnology and healthcare domain, SBI conducts research, manufactures, and distributes pharmaceutical products, health supplements, and cosmetics. It develops, produces, sells, and maintains integrated medical information systems. Furthermore, it's involved in the research and development of advanced antibody and nucleic acid drugs targeting cancer and immunological conditions. The company's diverse portfolio includes operating a fund-raising platform, serving as a crypto-asset broker, and developing, manufacturing, and selling crypto-asset mining systems. It also develops and manages cybersecurity systems, provides blockchain platforms, invests in real estate, and engages in used car exports. Additionally, SBI offers healthcare services, participates in revitalization projects, mines digital assets, and is involved in e-sports and renewable energy initiatives. Established in 1999, the company was initially known as Softbank Investment Corporation before adopting its current name, SBI Holdings, Inc., in July 2005. Its headquarters are located in Tokyo, Japan.

Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd. (JSF), together with its subsidiaries, operates as a diversified financial services entity across Japan. Its primary business lines include securities financing, trust banking, and real estate activities. Within securities finance, JSF provides a broad array of lending solutions. These encompass funds and stock loans specifically for margin transactions, as well as general stock lending designed to facilitate the settlement of trades. The company also acts as an intermediary in the bond market, connecting borrowers with lenders. Additionally, it extends credit for the settlement of negotiable margin transactions, finances bond underwriting and trading, and offers general working capital loans to brokerage firms. Individual and corporate investors can access various secured loans backed by securities, such as the COM-STOCK, business, and safe-keeping deposited loan products. Beyond direct lending, JSF delivers essential supporting services, including custodial services for institutional investors' securities and managing principal and interest repayments for government bonds. The company also offers comprehensive securities trust and banking services. Furthermore, its real estate division is engaged in property ownership, leasing, trading, and brokerage. Founded in 1927 under the name Tokyo Securities Co., Ltd., the company officially adopted Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd. in December 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Orient Corporation, along with its subsidiaries, offers diverse consumer financial services within Japan. The company's operations are structured into four principal segments: Credit Cards and Cash Loans, Settlement and Guarantee, Installment Credit, and Bank Loan Guarantee. Its service portfolio encompasses credit card facilities, cash advances, and various installment credit options, such as financing for vehicles, education, and retail purchases. Additionally, it undertakes credit collection activities and provides credit-related outsourcing solutions. Within its Settlement and Guarantee segment, Orient Corporation supplies guarantees for rental payments and accounts receivable, supports small lease agreements with guarantee services, and functions as a collection agent. Furthermore, the Bank Loan Guarantee segment focuses on securing personal loans extended by partner financial institutions. The company maintains an extensive operational footprint, comprising approximately 111 branches and a substantial network of 832,000 participating merchants. Established in 1951, the company, previously known as Orient Finance, is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ORIX Corporation is a diversified global financial services provider with operations spanning Japan, the Americas, Asia, Europe, Australasia, and the Middle East. The company's multifaceted activities include corporate finance and fee-based services, alongside the leasing and rental of automobiles, electronic measuring equipment, and ICT-related devices. It also offers life insurance, environmental, and energy-related products and services. Its Real Estate division focuses on property development, rental, and management, encompassing residential condominiums, office buildings, and facility operations, further providing construction contracting, real estate brokerage, and investment advisory services. The Private Equity (PE) Investment and Concession segment is engaged in both private equity ventures and concession projects. In the Environment and Energy sector, ORIX delivers renewable energy solutions, ESCO services, electricity retail, and the sale of solar panels and battery storage systems, complemented by recycling and waste management. The Insurance segment distributes life insurance products through a broad network including agents, banks, other financial institutions, as well as direct in-person and online channels. Its Banking and Credit operations offer both conventional banking and consumer finance services. The Aircraft and Ships segment specializes in aircraft leasing and management, in addition to financing and investment activities for marine vessels. ORIX USA provides finance, investment, and asset management expertise, while ORIX Europe concentrates on equity and fixed income asset management. Furthermore, its Asia and Australia segment focuses on finance and investment initiatives. Founded in 1950 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was originally known as Orient Leasing Co., Ltd. before rebranding as ORIX Corporation in 1989.

Sompo Holdings, Inc., established in 2010 and based in Tokyo, Japan, operates globally, delivering property and casualty (P&C) insurance solutions. Its multifaceted business is organized into distinct segments: domestic P&C insurance, international insurance ventures, domestic life insurance, and a dedicated nursing care and healthcare division. The company's P&C offerings cover a broad spectrum, including automobile, fire, personal accident, and marine insurance, complemented by services such as security, risk management, assistance, and warranties. It also provides a variety of life insurance products. Beyond its core insurance operations, Sompo extends into nursing care and general healthcare services, along with comprehensive support systems aimed at enhancing customer security, health, and overall wellbeing. Its expansive portfolio further incorporates asset management, home renovation services, various health support programs (including guidance, counseling, and employee assistance programs), and wellness communication initiatives. The company formally adopted the name Sompo Holdings, Inc. in October 2016, having previously operated as Sompo Japan Nipponkoa Holdings, Inc.

Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and founded in 2000, Anicom Holdings, Inc. operates through its subsidiaries to deliver a comprehensive array of pet insurance products and services throughout Japan. The company's diverse operations also include managing animal hospitals, functioning as an insurance agency, and providing employment placement services. Furthermore, Anicom Holdings, Inc. conducts clinical research in the veterinary medicine field and is actively involved in planning, developing, and operating online services tailored for pets.

MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc. operates as a global insurance conglomerate, offering a diverse array of insurance and financial services. Its portfolio includes extensive non-life coverage, such as policies for fire, marine, personal accidents, and both optional and mandatory automobile liabilities, among other general insurance products. The company also underwrites life insurance and provides vital reinsurance and risk-related consultancy services. Founded in 1918 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the firm changed its name from Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Group Holdings, Inc. to its current designation in April 2010.

Tokio Marine Holdings, Inc. is a global financial services conglomerate primarily specializing in life and non-life insurance products, alongside a variety of financial and general business activities. The company manages its operations through four distinct divisions: domestic non-life insurance, domestic life insurance, international insurance, and a segment dedicated to financial and other services. Its extensive insurance portfolio includes offerings for fire and related risks, marine hull and cargo, health, personal accident, and automobile coverage. Furthermore, Tokio Marine provides asset management, investment advisory, and investment trust services, in addition to staffing, facility management, and nursing care solutions. Founded in 2002 as Millea Holdings, Inc., the corporation changed its name to Tokio Marine Holdings, Inc. in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Heiwa Real Estate Co., Ltd. is a Japanese firm primarily involved in the real estate sector, operating through two main divisions: its Building Business and Asset Management Business. The company's property activities encompass the development, leasing, management, and sale of a varied portfolio, including facilities for stock exchanges, corporate offices, commercial centers, and residential properties. Furthermore, it offers comprehensive property management and real estate brokerage services. Established in 1947, the company maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd., headquartered in Osaka, Japan, is a real estate enterprise primarily involved in the leasing of various properties across Japan. Its portfolio encompasses a diverse range of assets, including corporate office facilities, specialized data centers, commercial establishments, logistics warehouses, and venues for off-track wagering. Beyond its leasing activities, the company also provides comprehensive building maintenance services. Founded in 1948, the entity was previously known as Keihanshin Real Estate Co., Ltd. before officially adopting its current name, Keihanshin Building Co., Ltd., in October 2011.

GOLDCREST Co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and sells new condominiums in Japan. It is also involved in the real estate leasing and management, and hotel businesses. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

KATITAS Co. Ltd. specializes in the acquisition, renovation, and resale of existing residential properties to individuals and families throughout Japan. Established in 1978, the company previously operated as Yasuragi Co., Ltd. before rebranding to KATITAS Co., Ltd. in 2013. Its main office is located in Kiryu-shi, Japan.

Tosei Corporation, a Tokyo-headquartered real estate firm founded in Japan in 1950 (and known as Tosei Fudosan Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in October 2006), operates across diverse sectors. The company excels in revitalizing real estate by acquiring properties with diminished asset value and implementing improvements to boost their worth. Its development division constructs various property types, including office buildings, commercial facilities, residential complexes like condominiums and detached homes, and hotels. Tosei also maintains a substantial rental portfolio, leasing buildings, apartments, commercial spaces, and parking areas. Furthermore, its fund and consulting segment offers comprehensive asset management for real estate funds, corporate advisory services, property acquisition and disposition, alongside investment management and financial instrument activities. The property management arm provides services such as building oversight, security, renovations, and tenant leasing. Beyond these, Tosei engages in general real estate consultancy, brokerage, and the planning, operation, and management of hotels.

Minor International Public Co., Ltd. operates as a diversified enterprise with core activities spanning the hospitality, dining, and retail sectors. The company organizes its business through distinct divisions: Hotels, Mixed-Use developments, Restaurants, and Retail. It maintains a broad international footprint, conducting operations across numerous geographical areas including Thailand, Europe, Australia and New Zealand, the Maldives and the Middle East, China, Latin America, and other global regions. Established in 1978 by William Ellwood Heinecke, the company's central office is situated in Bangkok, Thailand.

Traton SE, a leading global manufacturer of commercial vehicles, segments its operations into an Industrial Business division and Financial Services. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a broad spectrum of light and heavy-duty commercial vehicles, including various types of trucks, bus chassis, utility vans, construction machinery, urban buses, and coaches designed for intercity and long-distance travel. Beyond vehicles, Traton also supplies essential spare parts and associated services. Additionally, under the RIO brand, it manages a cloud-based platform dedicated to freight transportation. Its diverse offerings are marketed through prominent brands such as MAN, Scania, Navistar, and Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus. Complementing its manufacturing, Traton provides a comprehensive suite of financial solutions, which includes financing options for both dealers and customers, vehicle leasing arrangements, and various insurance products. Established in 2015 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, Traton SE operates as a subsidiary of Volkswagen Finance Luxemburg S.A.

Keisei Electric Railway Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of public railway transportation services for local communities in Japan. It operates through the Transportation, Distribution, Real Estate, Leisure and Service, and Construction segments. The Transportation segment is involved in the railway, bus, and taxi businesses. Its Distribution segment consists of stores, department stores, and other retail businesses. The Real Estate segment engages in the leasing of residential properties and an office building, as well as the sale of units in apartment buildings, a mixed-use development project, and commercial facilities. Its Leisure and Service segment develops restaurants, movies, hotels, advertising agencies, and travel agencies. The Construction segment is involved in engineering projects and construction of commercial facilities. The company also engages in the rail car maintenance, insurance agency, and driving school businesses. As of April 1, 2025, it operates 762 passenger cars and 91 stations covering 178.8 kilometers of railway. Keisei Electric Railway Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1909 and is headquartered in Ichikawa, Japan.

Shanghai Mechanical & Electrical Industry Co.,Ltd., based in the People's Republic of China, is engaged in the production and distribution of various mechanical and electrical equipment. Its diverse product portfolio features elevators, air conditioning units, electric motors, precision hydraulic systems, digital printing equipment, other mechatronic devices, industrial automation solutions, and intelligent manufacturing machinery. The company was founded in 1993 and maintains its headquarters in Shanghai.

Based in Osaka, Japan, West Japan Railway Company, founded in 1987, primarily delivers passenger rail transportation services across the country. The company's operations span several key divisions: Transportation Operations, Retail Business, Real Estate Business, and various Other Businesses. It maintains a substantial railway infrastructure, extending 4,903.1 kilometers in total, comprising 812.6 kilometers of high-speed Shinkansen routes and 4,090.5 kilometers of conventional lines, facilitating travel through 1,174 stations. Additionally, it offers supplementary bus and ferry services. Beyond its core transport functions, the company engages extensively in retail, including the sale of goods, food service provision, wholesale distribution, and other retail initiatives. This encompasses the management of department stores, convenience stores, restaurants, souvenir shops, and shopping centers. Its real estate portfolio involves property sales and leasing. JR West also holds interests in hospitality (hotels), financial services (credit cards, electronic money), travel arrangements, rolling stock and equipment manufacturing, electrical contracting, construction, information technology solutions, and advertising.

Tokyo Metro Co., Ltd. engages in the operation and management of railways in Japan. It provides railway passenger transportation services. The company also manages shops at stations and other commercial facilities; develops and rents office buildings and hotels; and provides advertising and IT services, such as advertisements in stations, premises and trains, and an information and communications business that handles licensing of mobile phone communication services, as well as leasing optical fiber cable, etc. The company was formerly known as Teito Rapid Transit Authority and changed its name to Tokyo Metro Co., Ltd. in 2004. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Seibu Holdings Inc., a Tokyo-headquartered Japanese conglomerate established in 2006, manages a diverse range of enterprises predominantly within Japan, with operations also extending to Hawaii. Its multifaceted business portfolio includes urban and regional transit, hospitality and leisure, property development, and construction. These activities are organized into distinct divisions: Urban Transportation and Regional, Hotel and Leisure, Real Estate, Construction, Hawaii Business, and various Other Businesses. The company provides extensive transportation solutions, from railway and bus services to general transit, expressway management, and cruise ship operations. Its hospitality division oversees hotels, golf courses, ski resorts, and a variety of recreational amenities, notably including the ownership and support of a professional baseball team. In real estate, Seibu is involved in developing land for its railway network and strategic hotel locations in urban areas. It also manages the leasing of office and residential properties and spearheads the creation and operation of retail establishments within train stations, shopping centers, and other commercial complexes. Its construction capabilities cover significant infrastructure projects like railway lines and general social infrastructure, alongside hotel renovations, private sector builds, and residential housing. Furthermore, the company manufactures, processes, and distributes essential raw materials such as gravel and sand for civil engineering. Complementing this, Seibu offers landscaping design and execution services and is responsible for the upkeep and operation of state-owned parks. Beyond these core areas, Seibu Holdings provides a broad array of ancillary services, including domestic support (housekeeping, child-rearing), home and urban planning services, insurance and pet care products, and cemetery development.

Sakai Moving Service Co.,Ltd. provides moving transportation and ancillary services in Japan. The company operates in four segments: Moving Services, Electrical Construction, Clean Services, and Reuse. The company was formerly known as Sakai Hikkoshi Center and changed its name to Sakai Moving Service Co.,Ltd. in October 1990. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

Operating globally across Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia, Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd. specializes in a wide array of transportation solutions, encompassing marine, land, and air logistics. Its operations are structured into key divisions: Dry Bulk, Energy Resource Transport, Product Logistics, and various other services. The company's extensive maritime offerings include containership operations, dry bulk transport for commodities like coal, iron ore, wheat, soybeans, corn, woodchips, and pulp, as well as car carrier services. It also manages the transportation of liquefied natural gas (LNG), crude oil, oil derivatives, and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) via specialized tankers. Furthermore, its offshore capabilities extend to support vessels, drilling operations, and floating production storage and offloading (FPSO) solutions. Beyond its core shipping activities, the firm provides comprehensive logistics services, including air and sea freight forwarding, land-based transport, warehousing, and buyer's consolidation. Complementing these are its operation of container terminals, ship management, travel agency offerings, and real estate rental and administration. As of March 31, 2022, its significant fleet comprised 434 vessels, boasting a total deadweight tonnage of 36,959,893. Established in 1919, Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha, Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.

Tamai Steamship Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the ownership and operation of a shipping fleet, with its main activities concentrated in Japan. The company specializes in the transportation of a wide range of dry bulk goods, including bauxite, grain, and steel products, as well as liquid cargoes such as clean oil and liquefied petroleum gas. Beyond its core maritime transport services, Tamai Steamship also provides freight forwarding, crew management, and apartment rental services. Founded in 1929, the firm is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Operating through its subsidiaries, GENDA Inc. specializes in running amusement arcades throughout Japan, predominantly under its well-known GiGO brand. Its operations further encompass the rental of amusement equipment, management of virtual crane game platforms, implementation of sales campaigns, and character intellectual property licensing. The company was established in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation delivers a broad spectrum of logistics services to clients both domestically in Japan and across international markets. The company's business activities are structured into two main divisions: Logistics and Real Estate. Within its logistics arm, it provides warehousing and distribution center operations, as well as extensive truck transportation. The firm also manages port and harbor facilities and offers multimodal freight services via railway, ocean, and air, complemented by import/export customs clearance. Additionally, its real estate ventures involve the acquisition, leasing, management, and construction of properties. Other offerings include ship registration services and related support. The company, initially known as Mitsubishi Warehouse Co., Ltd., rebranded as Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation in 1996. Established in 1887, its corporate headquarters are located in Tokyo, Japan.

MITSUI-SOKO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., together with its affiliated entities, delivers an extensive array of logistics solutions both within Japan and internationally. The company's business activities are organized into two primary divisions: Logistics and Real Estate. The Logistics segment provides a wide spectrum of services, encompassing warehousing and cargo management, port-related operations and transport, global logistics, integrated multimodal forwarding, air freight forwarding, comprehensive third-party logistics (3PL), supply chain optimization support, and domestic land transportation. The Real Estate division is dedicated to offering property leasing services. Additionally, the company oversees container terminals that link sea and land distribution networks at key Japanese ports, including Tokyo, Yokohama, Nagoya, Yokkaichi, Osaka, Kobe, and Moji. It also manages vessel arrival and departure procedures, functions as a ship agent by issuing crucial documents like cargo certificates, and executes conventional shipping duties, such as advising on the most effective handling methods for diverse types of goods. Established in 1909 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company was formerly known as Mitsui-Soko Co., Ltd. before rebranding to MITSUI-SOKO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2014.

Operating throughout Japan, Daiei Kankyo Co., Ltd. specializes in waste management and the recovery of valuable resources. Its comprehensive service portfolio includes waste treatment and recycling solutions, soil decontamination, energy generation from biogas, sustainable forest management, the construction and upkeep of facilities, and expert consulting. The firm also extends its reach into other waste-centric ventures, providing temporary labor and recruitment services, alongside its agribusiness activities. Additionally, Daiei Kankyo manufactures and markets recycled aluminum pellets and plastic pallets. Established in 1979, the company's headquarters are located in Kobe, Japan, and it operates as a subsidiary of Wingtowa Co., Ltd.

NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides building management and operations services in Japan. The company also engages in building management and operation, energy saving and environmental, residential management, real estate fund management businesses. In addition, it is involved in overseeing various public utilities, such as water supply, sewage treatment, and waste management facilities; and managing condominiums. Further, the company provides security; staffing; and payroll outsourcing and consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Kamigumi Co., Ltd. delivers extensive integrated logistics solutions, serving clients both domestically in Japan and across international markets. Their offerings span comprehensive harbor transport, a full range of warehousing services including storage and distribution processing, and various freight options via truck, air, rail, and sea. The company also provides vital on-site factory support, handling everything from the loading and unloading of raw materials from ships to their internal transport, secondary processing, product quality control, dispatch, and environmental management. A key specialization is the meticulous transportation of heavy and oversized cargo, such as transformer plants, industrial machinery, petrochemical equipment, and railcars. Beyond logistics, Kamigumi's diverse operations include constructing residential, commercial, and industrial buildings, as well as the specialized demolition and disposal of large-scale equipment like steel plant rolling mills and extensive conveyor systems. They also design and erect steel structures, build and maintain amusement facilities, and offer machinery maintenance services. Furthermore, the company engages in a variety of other ventures, including apartment rentals, alcoholic beverage production, restaurant businesses, solar energy projects, commercial property development and leasing, parking facility operation, and even tomato cultivation. Founded in 1867, Kamigumi Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated (KEPCO) is a major Japanese enterprise with a diversified portfolio spanning electricity, gas, heat supply, and telecommunication services nationwide. The company operates through four principal segments: Energy Business, Power Transmission and Distribution Business, Information and Communication Business, and Life and Business Solution Business. KEPCO generates power from a variety of sources, including thermal, hydropower, wind, biomass, and nuclear facilities. It is also responsible for the extensive infrastructure involved in power transmission and distribution. Under its Information and Communication segment, KEPCO offers internet and communication services for homes and businesses via the 'eo Hikari' brand, and mobile services through its 'mineo' business. This segment also provides corporate solution services. The broad Life and Business Solution segment includes activities such as real estate leasing, sales, and management, alongside a range of other services like leisure, general leasing, call center management, dispatching, medical healthcare, and home security systems. Beyond these core operations, KEPCO is involved in numerous other ventures. These encompass the maintenance and construction of essential infrastructure, including power distribution and electricity lines, thermal and nuclear power generation facilities, and information and communication equipment. The company also engages in utility pole advertising, the manufacturing, supply, and sale of gas, and the production and distribution of power equipment such as overhead wire hardware, insulators, and structural columns. Additional activities include housing equipment sales, remodeling work, and passenger and freight transportation. Furthermore, KEPCO provides specialized services, including research into nuclear power generation safety technology, civil engineering and architectural survey, design, and construction supervision. Its operations also cover the acceptance, storage, vaporization, and delivery of liquefied natural gas (LNG), high-voltage batch power reception for condominiums, fuel trading and transportation, and corporate settlement services. The company offers environmental, civil engineering, and architectural survey, analysis, consulting, and construction services, as well as public relations and various engineering services. The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
